description:
Magickal monthly subscription box! Curated by witches, for witches 🌙✨ 
We ship our monthly witchcraft subscription boxes worldwide! 🌍
 
About
Witch Casket – a family run magickal monthly subscription service, started by a mother and daughter dedicated to bringing a little magick into the lives of others!

Our Mission
Our mission when we launched Witch Casket was to reach witches worldwide…and we are proud to say we have now shipped our magickal witchcraft subscription boxes to subscribers in over 60 countries! It warms our heart to know that there are so many magickal people across the globe! 🌎

Each monthly Witch Casket is carefully curated and packaged with love and care. And we package our branded boxes in simple, unbranded mailing bags for those who wish to keep things private! 💗🌿

As vegans who care about Mother Earth, we are proud to say the following:
•   All products are ethically sourced.
•   All products are vegan-friendly and cruelty-free.
•   We avoid single-use plastics when sourcing our products.
•   We only use biodegradable mailers and compostable packing peanuts.
•   We plant one tree for each Casket sold.


 Subscribe 
  View Past Caskets 
  Learn More

records.title: The items received from the Witch…
records.text: The items received from the Witch Casket box are magical. Information that helps you understand different areas of magick. They put a lot of time & effort into every box. Witches that help Witches make the world of magick go around. Love & Light to all.

records.title: Excellent gift to yourself!
records.text: I’ve been a subscriber for a few months now and this is a truly special monthly piece of self care and enjoyment. You can tell the team behind Witch Casket thoughtfully compile each box to ensure maximum value for money as well as ensuring a consistent theme and enjoyable box of treasures for their subscribers. It’s amazing that this is a small business - their professionalism and customer care is impressive. Highly recommend this for those exploring craft or wanting a little gift-to-self each month.

records.title: Beautifully designed and wonderfully magical
records.text: I absolutely love everything about this month’s Witch Casket! It is beautifully designed and had so much more than I expected. I can’t wait to get started on getting back to my witchy roots.

records.title: 10 Stars. All the stars!
records.text: I can’t say enough great things about this company. The products are lovely, the caskets are so thoughtfully assembled, and the customer service is next to none. They’re in a league of their own!So grateful for the support I’ve received when I reached out. I’ll be singing your praises to whoever will listen!

records.title: Great business ethos
records.text: Great business, speedy replies and delivery. Never had any issues, runs like a well oiled machine!

records.title: Perfect for all!
records.text: Such a beautiful, curated collection of items! No matter if someone is just starting out in the witchy journey, or a seasoned practitioner, the monthly boxes have some very helpful tools for all. Love that each month is dedicated to a theme, but items can be used at any time throughout the year.

records.title: Best Subscription Ever!!
records.text: Every item is crafted beautifully. The care with which they create each box surprises me every time. I love how they explain the use of each item, in case anyone is unclear how to use them. This is the best subscription I have ever received.

records.title: Witch casket infuses my life with…
records.text: Witch casket infuses my life with magick tools to reinforce my craft. So many inspiring and beautiful goods for magickal enhancement !

records.title: I just love getting my box every month
records.text: I just love getting my box every month. It's obviously curated with care. So many interesting little things.

records.title: Always brilliant items
records.text: Always brilliant items, fast tracked delivery and an awesome monthly treat.

records.title: I love it but download hard to find
records.text: I love it!  Everything is amazing and unique.  The only issue I have is the downloads.  They are hard to find and not very easy to get to.

records.title: The subscription service is really…
records.text: The subscription service is really good, you dont have to worry about getting it yourself as it comes to you every month without any hassle, the content of the 'caskets' vary from month to month and each one has a theme , the products are top quality and you get more than what you pay for . All in all a great team that give you support and send you spells,etc,that you can print off and put in your own book of shadows ....thankyou

records.title: The box its self was amazing
records.text: The box its self was amazing. However it was very delayed getting to me. But it is coming from Europe so I didn’t mind to much, I was just excited 😆

records.title: Love my boxes very awesome goodies…
records.text: Love my boxes very awesome goodies inside

records.title: I’ve enjoyed the boxes I’ve received
records.text: I’ve enjoyed the boxes I’ve received. I do wish there was a way to skip a box if desired. Some months cash is a bit more tight or the theme doesn’t resonate with me, and having to unsubscribe and then subscribe again can be a bit bothersome

records.title: Great items, recommendations for shipping
records.text: Great items, boxes are just excellent. Only feedback is that usps in certain rual parts of North America an be slow. Is there any other carrier you can partner with like UPS or FedEx? I’m sure this is not an originalThought, perhaps it’s been asked prior and I didn’t see it in the threads. I enjoyed everything about the box itself don’t get me wrong. Only grey area was the usps. But you can’t be  a hundred percent accountable for that. So I feel terrible reducing a stat but it seems most fair. Thanks. 😊

records.title: Good subscription box, especially if you're just starting out.
records.text: I enjoy my Witch Casket subscription.  Occasionally there is an item or two that are a little too simple, lack quality, or simply unexpectedly small.  But other than that, that boxes aren't too bad at all.  I think mainly it comes down to personal preference.  I don't particularly care for paper items counting toward the item count and many of the enamel pin designs simply do not resonate with me.  I do, however, look forward to the ritual kits and tools.  More solid items that can be used in my craft are ideal.

records.title: A great experience, every month
records.text: It is always a joy to receive the box in the mail! Everything is always high quality. You certainly get your money's worth in each box- Trying to purchase each thing from a metaphysical shop individually would probably be much more. I enjoy all the little notes and manuals. I've started taping my favorite spells into my BoS which has made it an even more fun project!I do wish it could be a more customized experience, however, or allow for certain months to be skipped, as I don't have use for large portions of some of the boxes. Fortunately I have a friend who is more than happy to alleviate me of anything I don't use, so nothing goes un-treasured!

records.title: Quite lovely
records.text: I had a subscription for almost a year. I really like the cute witchy things you get in the surprise box every month. They also contain spells (although I'm not a fan of the ryhmes). Also you can always cancel the subscription. Unfortunately it is pretty expensive to order it to Germany. I would subscribe again if it wasn't ~50 € with tax and shipping.

records.title: The products that I received were of…
records.text: The products that I received were of excellent quality, genuine and authentic. They were packed with the least amount of waste, almost all the packaging is recyclable. The subscription arrived within a week of leaving the UK.

records.title: correcting original review
records.text: I would like to correct my original review. It took a very long time but the casket box finally came in and my daughter was thrilled. I believed it was a scam due to how long it took and I wasn't receiving any updates on the shipment and it was my first time purchasing one,  but my daughter was so thrilled with everything in it, Her smile was worth the wait.

records.title: Great job!
records.text: I think this is one of the best subscription witch boxes in the market. It is consistent in the line of products they provide. I just miss, maybe, a bit more rare products that can be part of self made spells (coffin nails, rare herbs, smudge bundles, resines, shaped spell candles, sabbath specific oils, wands, athames, etc.). It is great though for altar equipment and utensils. Also for spell and ritual kits and pages. My favourite box ever was the moon magic one.

records.title: It's difficult to open the scrolls…
records.text: It's difficult to open the scrolls because of the sticker. When I try to cut it, the paper take minimal damage, but it's still annoying. Maybe you can design a safe knife or letter opener to use.

records.title: Product compliant not resolved
records.text: I reached out because I was not pleased with one of the products in January’s box.  The wood disk with pentagram wood burning.  The pattern was blurred and a large knot in the wood obscured the top point.  My response was that is the natural beauty of the wood.  I expected we will send you another one out right away.  I guess the policy of we want to ensure you are completely satisfied is just lip service.

records.title: Great boxes
records.text: The boxes never fail to impress me. Delivery can be better that why I  give them a 4 star rating. Not because of them just because of the delivery

records.title: I just ordered this
records.text: I just ordered this, and my bank advised me this is fraud. The box said $39Was charged almost $49.. Of course, I couldn't see what the full mount was during checkout. No tracking number no confirmation... I run a business as well, and that's not good. Sorry, but the truth.  I'm ordering it to see if it's worth the rest of my group to join in. I'm writing to let others know this could happen.  # update 6/17 ... just got notice it's in the US. Wait time is long but they do keep updating.  Raising stars for this.

records.title: Exceptionally good quality items
records.text: Exceptionally good quality items, a little bit pricy but it is worth your cash.Each month you get a wonderful experience.

records.title: I love getting my Witch Caskets
records.text: I love getting my Witch Caskets. It’s a treat every month. The quality is nice but I’ve noticed from past caskets having higher quality of items. Maybe because of the theme of the casket. Not sure. Never the less, Witch Casket has helped this old witch return to the love of Magick. Bright blessings!

records.title: My Witch Casket review …
records.text: I love everything about witch casket just wish, I had a way to track packages. One of mine got sent back and if I knew it was coming in I would have been able to get to the mailman before it was sent back. Besides that I absolutely love receiving my boxes every month.

records.title: Great value for money
records.text: The quality and the amount of items you receive in a box is such good value for money and thoughtfully planned out. The only reason I am rating 4 stars is because I’m in Australia and it takes FOREVER to receive it. It’s late Jan and I only just got the December box. I’d be happy to pay a bit more for faster, trackable shipping

records.title: Nice items but pricey...
records.text: This subscription is a bit pricey for what you get. Although I did love love all the items, it did seem slightly overpriced.

records.title: High price not always worth it
records.text: I enjoy the witch casket, however for the price I feel like it lacks a bit. I expected a bit more for each box especially based off of things I have seen so I was a bit disappointed in the boxes I have received. I want to order more but I am always hesitant because I can't always justify spending over $50 on it when it doesn't come even half full of items. I understand the items are higher quality and so forth, I just guess for that price I wish there would be a few more things included.

records.title: Doesn’t Always Fit the Witch
records.text: I didn’t find much of what was in my casket useful. The tea cup was cute,  but not something that Americans would usually use, so I don’t think there was any real consideration for the different peoples that are ordering the casket. The paper products weren’t useful to me either. In all honesty, everything is still sitting in the box.  I think people should have a little more control over what they get. Perhaps some kind of choice that would fit the kind of witch that they are.

records.title: It's nice but not for me
records.text: There are pros and cons of Witch Casket.* The pros are: well made items, sustaintable mindset and good customer service.* The cons are: repetitive designs (pentacles and "As I will it so mote it be" are way too often on their designs); I'm in Mexico and the box takes one month to arrive and this also increases the cost so it ends up feeling like the content is not matching the price.So in general, it is a nice family business that create beautiful products but after some purchases I've made I have decided it's not for me anymore.

records.title: Lovely box, not all useful
records.text: This is a lovely, well put together box, and something to look forward to once a month in the post. HOWEVER, there seem to be a few items every month which are basically Tat, bits of jewellery, little trinkets. For me personally I felt that if I gave myself a budget of £29 a month to spend in a magic shop I would be able to choose things that were more useful and which I'd treasure, so that is why, after 3 months I have unsubscribed. The effort that has gone into the marketing and packaging is a parent, but month on month the contents are a bit disappointing.

records.title: So far not satisfied...
records.text: My second box arrived with undelivered items which I noticed after the reveal, how is this a witch's monthly subscription box/service and candles and incenses are not included in all the boxes? This should all be made better, I'm still a subscriber and will decide soon whether I continue membership or not!!!

records.title: Support our sisters
records.text: Well you can tell that this is a new business by the items included in both of my 2 different boxes. Some of the items are good but the quality of some of the other items are cheesy and very obviously just stereotypical “witch” items. I’m going to keep my subscription because I think once they have enough money to put together better quality items. This is obviously a new business and I support that. I think there is great potential once it takes off! Blessed be my friends. I support small businesses, family businesses, and I have a feeling from their response that they care about their sisters and put a lot of effort into each one.

records.title: Long shipping time/delays no tracking
records.text: As excited as I was when I first subscribed to this box I was disappointed by how long it took to receive it. Shipping takes a long time and there were cases where I paid for two boxes and never received a box. I had to cancel as well since there was never any tracking number and there are issues with deliveries in my area.  Even now January's hasn't shipped and probably won't get to me until sometime in February. :( My favorite part of the box was the spell kit. Wonderful idea to have all the items needed for the spell.

records.title: Lovely company and casket always…
records.text: Lovely company and casket always arrives on time. Usually very good contents but was a bit disappointed this month. Will continue to subscribe and see what next month brings.

records.title: Needs to be a little earlier in the month
records.text: I really do love receiving my monthly casket, each item is always so magical and well thought through. It's my one little moment in the month where I spend just by my self l, opening my little surprise box.I am however, really disappointed with the time of the month that the boxes are sent out... I would enjoy it much more if I received my casket at the beginning of the month, so that I can do the spells and rituals that corespond with that month... for example, I didn't recive February's casket until the beginning of March, amd it just seemd a little too late to be performing love spells after the month of love has passed. This month is the second time I have received an email to say that my casket will be late, due to an issue with one of the item's. This is why I've only rated 3 stars, as I think timing is a big thing, unfortunately due to this I'm considering cancelling my subscription, I do with all the best thought

records.title: It was great, then it became just ok.
records.text: I like the treat. But the quality of some of the products isn’t great and some bits really feel like dropship/aliexpress type. I feel that popularity has had a much negative impact on the thoughtfulness and overall care and quality.

records.title: The stuff you get is all great quality but
records.text: The stuff you get is all great quality, good differences from box to box. However, they really should be a month ahead so that you get all you need for March rituals, at the end of Feb for example. As the boxes arrive at the end of month chances are you've missed the core ritual date.

records.title: Sadly paying for the packaging, rather than useful items.
records.text: Used them for years and for the majority, I've loved getting them. However I feel like this service is losing touch with what it set out to do. I was very excited about the concept of the "Potions" box this month, after feeling the last couple of boxes were a bit lacking, but was sadly let down by the items. Whilst I can understand and appreciate the hard work that goes into these, I subscribed for witchcraft materials, not "enchanting stickers". My "cauldron" arrived wonky and I wouldn't dare place a tea light on it.I feel the subscription box has become more about looking "Instagram worthy" with the packaging, rather than about the actual content. I know the cost of living crisis means materials are going up, but surely it's not the most cost-effective method to put a paper bag of herbs, inside an extra decorated cardboard box? A label would suffice. I feel like it's not exactly eco-friendly to have this unnecessary packaging produced. Sadly having to unsubscribe, which is a shame cos there have been beautiful boxes in the past. But I cannot justify the cost of this box any longer, for a "magic sticker" to be included as one of the items, a wonky cauldron, which isn't really a cauldron, more an oil burner, 3 small tea light candles, a badly glazed spoon and a small glass bottle.

records.title: Love the caskets but a bit overpriced
records.text: I love the caskets! However I do feel like the amount you pay for the casket is a little much for the amount of items you receive. Some of the boxes seem quite empty compared to the older ones. I think I expected a little more for 34 pounds per month. The items that I did receive were lovely non the less.

records.title: Meh; inconsistent
records.text: The September box was great! Loved everything. And then it got progressively less exciting. I was expecting October’s box to be super special, and it was completely underwhelming in its contents. I was confused; needless to say, I terminated my subscription.

records.title: The boxes were great at first but this…
records.text: The boxes were great at first but this last one. I personally have nothing to do with ouija boards and their accessories because people shouldn’t mess with that it is in no way safe. I was very disappointed to have to throw out the mug, saucer and a washi tape, I haven’t gone over the packaging yet but I’m sure there’s more, I picked your box specifically because it seemed that you had nothing to do with spirit boards, I want to give you guys the benefit of the doubt but if I find one more thing I’ve got to throw away because I don’t mess with spirit boards because I’m not stupid then I will have to cancel my subscription.

records.title: Hopefully quality improves
records.text: I have been receiving this box for over a year. Last year I thought the boxes were amazing and worth every penny. This year, I've only felt that about one or two of the boxes. The quality of some of the items have gone down drastically. Hopefully, this is temporary.

records.title: Really cool stuff, but pricey
records.text: Really cool stuff, love that everythingis themed, but would like to see more items in the boxes. I don't feel like I'm getting enough for the price I pay.

records.title: Returning subscriber... they used to be better :(
records.text: 8/7/24 Edit to Witch Casket reply: I would encourage everyone who is unsure of this to also read the 3-star reviews and below. The feeling that we are getting more and more items that feel like they are from Aliexpress or Temu or just cheaply made in China is repeated over and over. In fact, all my complaints below are repeated many times over. It's not just me, and the over-the-top reply of how 'heartbroken' the makers of Witch Casket are can also be seen repeated in the low-star reviews, which honestly feels a bit like a performance and manipulative rather than sincere. :( I was willing to keep my subscription for a bit longer to see if maybe Witch Casket was just having a few off months, but after reading so many reviews remarking on the same disappointments and loss of quality, I realize it may just be how things are now. Sadly, the dramatic and somewhat unprofessional reply (and then seeing similar replies on many other reviews) tipped the scales for me to just cancel. I hope Witch Casket will actually listen to their customers instead of making excuses and learn from these mistakes. Many of us have loved this brand for many years and have supported them with hundreds and hundreds (thousands?) of our dollars and we have been rooting for them for so long it feels like a big let down when they gaslight us and pretend not to see the same problems we are trying to bring to their attention. For the record, when I received the email from Witch Casket for my feedback, I honestly thought my feedback was just going to be seen by them. I did not realize it was a public review until after, and my comments were meant initially just for their eyes. Now, though, I'm glad it's public. I hope it helps others get a more complete picture before they buy.  Original review:It's clear there is a lot of thought given to the cohesiveness and aesthetic of everything, and I appreciate that. I subscribed to this box couple of years ago for a long while, loved it so much, and then stopped for about a year while I was traveling. I've recently re-subscribed again and I'm finding the newer boxes not as satisfying as they were before. They feel like 'less'. Maybe the same *number* of items, but somehow, I'm a little disappointed each month and not quite 'wowed' the way I was before. The small wooden mortar and pestle, for example, while cute, isn't practical, and feels more like a child's toy than a true Witch's tool. Also, I have a bajillion mortar and pestles, actual heavy-duty ones that work for proper grinding of actual herbs, so it's not even something I'd use even if it was a proper size. One of the highlights I always enjoy are the high quality embroidered or printed drawstring canvas bags- these are treasured and I truly love seeing them show up in boxes, especially when they are large enough for a tarot deck or something else equally substantial. Don't ever stop including these, please!Another one I love are the enameled pins and stickers! These are always a win for me, I love collecting them. Keep those coming!This last month's 'Calming Card Deck' was another big let-down. It gave toxic positivity vibes with sentiments and phrases that sounded A.I. generated. This is not a deck I would ever get any use from. Similarly, the felt bat sewing kit was 'neat' and novel, not something I've ever received in any subscription box (Tamed Wild, Goddess provisions, Witch Box, etc.) so there was something new at least, however again, it felt like a child's craft and while I love to connect to my inner child, it just wasn't a hit for me.One more example of an item that felt like a child's toy, as well as a Dollar Store item (yuk!), was the 'Enchanting Altar Cauldron' that was neither enchanting nor a cauldron. It could maybe skate by as a mini-simmer pot or oil warmer. It looks and feels cheap. :(I truly enjoy the lack of plastic in the boxes. It's one reason I've enjoyed being a subscriber. I strive for zero-waste and appreciate this being valued in packaging. One suggestion I have is to spend less money on the branded boxes and packaging that just gets thrown away and more on improving the quality of the products. The caskets have become full of branded boxes and packaging that gives the appearance of substantial and quality items but strays from that reality and leaves me with a lot of cardboard and paper trash that I can't reuse, and cheap products I just don't want.I realize sometimes that I'm an older more experienced practitioner and many of these boxes are designed to appeal to younger people and beginners, but it does get old when boxes start feeling like a lot of filler and fluff rather than a box filled with practical items I'd actually use. On average, maybe half of the items I'm receiving now in the boxes are items I want to use. That's a lot of wasted money imo.

records.title: rather expensive for the Type of contents
records.text: I feel like the boxes are very expensive for what they are/contain.I oftentimes open them to feel a little scammed or that I could have gotten similar Items at around half or two thirds of the price. Also a bit sad that you can only use the Onlineshop ("emporium") when you are subscribed to the monthly box Service.

records.title: Just received my third witch casket…
records.text: Just received my third witch casket delivery. Although the things inside are packaged nicely and thought has gone into the items, I really don’t think this subscription is worth the money they charge. Thought this right away but wanted to give it a few more chances. I’ll be cancelling now.

records.title: Not for me
records.text: Received my first box which was Novembers and to be honest didn’t thrill me as much as others I have received from other suppliers. I know it was focused on manifestation etc but I can source my own paperwork and journals.  This subscription might suit some but for me totally underwhelming so will go back to ones that I know supply things that are useful to me

records.title: I’ll be honest I was so excited to…
records.text: I’ll be honest I was so excited to receive an actual witchy subscription box for adults little did I know that the items are small as in child size and the majority of the box is actually packaging or printed paper items. I felt it lacked any kind of substance really for adults so passed my two boxes onto my younger children as really that’s the age I felt it was suited for. Very commercialised gimmicky  insta witch feel about it.great if you’re a newbie but not really for seasoned witches

records.title: Nice but pricey for what you get
records.text: The box shipped to US says it’s $36 including shipping. It’s not, I payed $48 for my last one. I think they could include some bigger items for almost $50 a month.

records.title: Cheap, Private Labeled products. Not worth the money
records.text: Ordered a March 23 box and it arrived quickly. I actually just got it today and was extremely let down upon opening. Firstly, the customs declaration sticker lists the value of the box, which came in at 29 GBP. The company claims that the value of each box is at least 50GBP last I checked. The items inside were underwhelming. Cheaply, mass manufactured products that I suspect were privated labeled. There is no mention of any employee names beside the two onwers of this brand. They mentioned the "in house designer" in the monthly pamphlet, but I can't find any mention of artists' names. I paid almost 50 USD for this, and do not feel like I got my money's worth. I highly do not recommend buying from this company. Cheap items that feel geared towards the witchy asthetic vs actual functional items geared towards people who practice. The only good thing about this box was the incense fragrance, but you only get a few sticks, and the description on the box says "honeysuckle and cinnamon" yet the pamphlet says "ginger and cinnamon"? I mean no disrespect to the owners and their craft. The spell sheet I got seems like someone put effort in, but I cannot get behind a box that lies about the value, and then sends out such cheaply made, mass manufactured products with a brand slapped on them. Consumers are not dumb, we can tell this is not worth the money. Immediately canceled my subscription. Really bummed out.Edited to add that the previous responses from the company reps towards negative reviews are unacceptable. They like to claim that they design all of the items and that none are private labelled. Interesting, because in one google search, i was able to find a wooden spoon exactly like the "unique" one sent in this box. All you did was pay someone to poorly engrave a saying on the spoon in question. From what i can tell, this is not a legitimate team of witches coming up with unique and useful items. This is a team of two people private labeling products that fit a theme and putting them in a box to be shipped out. Nothing wrong with that, but you then can't get upset at customers who aren't happy with the value. Customers who know what you're up to, and then say it's our fault because we don't "value the products as highly"Of course we don't! Because they aren't quality products! Your idea is nice and I understand the effot it takes to make these boxes and themes even with private labeled products, but to send us such cheap products is a slap in the face. Your boxes go for 27 GBP in the UK, if I remember correctly. Yet you only value these boxes and content at 29, by your own admission to customs, so you're sending UK members alone a 2 pound value and that's unacceptable. Do better. And don't blame customers for being upset that we figured out your business model and blame us when we aren't the ones ripping people offEdited after the replied. Where did i say you weren't real witches? Nowhere. What I did say is that you guys use private labeled products and mislead because your website literally says you cant find these anywhere else in the world. Well guess what? All it took was a quick google search to find your stuff on wholesale websites that offer personalization. How is that not a lie, when your website says on the landing page that you can't find it anywhere else in the world. Maybe there are more than just two people at this team, but then why not credit your artists and designers with their names in the info booklets? And your reviews may be mostly positive but most consumers aren't gonna go looking for if their products are private labeled or not, they won't question because they trust you as a brand. It's up to you as a company to live up to that trust and misleading people about where you get your products isn't ok. You should strive to do better. But this business model has worked for you for years, as someone on youtube also found evidence of private labelling in your products from 3 years ago. I never called into question your craft's legitimacy, only your business model. I don't appreciate you playing victim.

records.title: Not great, really
records.text: Company ethics are questionable.A lot of green washing.Claim of products being “exclusive” whilst 90% can be found on drop shipping websites.

records.title: This box seemed cheap!
records.text: This, October, box was pitiful and definitely not worth the money! Everything seemed really cheap! It’s “October” I expected more…like Halloween themed! Really disappointed and have noticed a decline in the quality of the boxes! I hope this isn’t true or I will have to cancel my subscription!

records.title: I am here to express my disappointment…
records.text: I am here to express my disappointment with this month’s subscription box. It’s difficult to believe that any time, effort or love was used in the making of this box, as almost every item is hugely disappointing. Let’s start with my favourite (best of the worst) The incense smells like a bin. It smells like a BIN.The intuitive insights oracle cards could’ve been made by a 9 year old and I wouldn’t have been surprised. In fact, a 9 year old can probably do better.The crystal is cheap, the pendant is cheap, the tile symbols are cheap. I was promised quality, and quite frankly, I have been conned. And in case you forgot, the incense smells like the bin.However, what disappoints me the most are the passive aggressive, emoji filled non professional responses to other negative reviews. You are a company. You are going to get things wrong. Improve your quality and don’t be passive aggressive to your reviewers, and you might be okay. Thanks for your time and please don’t send me incense that smells like a bin again,Thank you

records.title: could easily be 5 stars

records.title: I will definitely be buying from here again.

records.title: Trafalgar law manga rare OP05-069
records.text: Purchased the trafalgar law manga rare OP05-069 on Thursday 26th December 2024 at approx 11pm. The card was dispatched first thing the next morning, tracking provided by the end of the day on 27/12/24, and it arrived on Saturday 28th Dec at 08:40am. Damn! I thought Amazon had fast dispatch and delivery! Card was exactly as described, immaculate condition, very well packaged, and extremely reasonably priced. I’m not going to lie I was a sceptic but this purchasing experience was flawless from start to end! Top stars, incredible service, and I will certainly be giving this company repeat business in the near future!!! Thank you!

records.title: Big Orbit cards is brilliant!

records.title: Great company

Also had a quick reply to an email.Looking forward to continuing to use this site in the future, thanks

records.title: Great service! :)
records.text: Quick and easy delivery and ordering on the site, was recommended by a friend and will return when I need more cards in the future :)

records.title: Overall great experience
records.text: Overall great experience. Something unpleasant that did occur to me (but that is to no fault of Big Orbit Cards, I think) was the additional toll (I ordered from Germany).While I do occasionally order cards from the UK, if they arrive in a package instead of a letter, parcel delivery would charge a significant amount of fees.It basically boils down to: Do I want a more secure packaging or do I want no fees on top of my order.

records.title: Pokemon 151 purchased
records.text: Pokemon 151 cards ordered and all were in near mint condition as described at very reasonable prices. Fast shipping too!

records.title: Great company and customer service

Contacted them and they responded and resolved immediately, sending me the correct card straight away. Will always come to Big Orbit Cards for my Yu-gi-oh cards.Thanks.

records.title: Absolutely perfect!

records.title: The order took slightly longer than the…

records.title: Very fast delivery, will use again
records.text: Very happy with the overall service and fast delivery. However I made a relatively large order and one of the cards I ordered did not arrive and appears to have been accidentally mistaken for a different card (which I didn’t order). Website is intuitive and great for card collectors with a wide range of stock and varying conditions on offer so I’m sure I will buy from here again.

records.title: Great service and super fast delivery
records.text: Great service and super fast delivery, I just wish they had all the cards I need at once so I could do one big order rather than a lot of small orders

records.title: i got what I wanted
records.text: i got what I wanted, everything went smoothly.There's WAYYYY too much packaging. I got a die, not a book, but you wouldn't be able to tell before opening the package. (I would be okay with this if it was recyclable or eco friendly)

records.title: Great shipping and delivery speeds
records.text: Great shipping and delivery speeds. A shame that a brand-new listed product wasn't actually in stock and I was only told after shipping.

records.text: Amazing postage time, no waiting around! Only one thing i would wish to improve in an ideal world;Many MTG cards i attempted to order were out of stock, which grew frustrating, however, i understand that some cards are more demanded for than others :)

records.title: Excelent service but...
records.text: The items came perfectly and im happy with my purchase (tough one of the items was unavaible and had to be reinbursed). But the fact that the  store refuses to ship to Mexico forced me to pay extra for reshipping.

records.title: Great prices and cards in great condition
records.text: Great prices and cards in very good condition. My only issue is when ordering larger quantities, they are all packed quite tightly into clear bags that can damage the edges/corners of the cards. If they were divided into a few more bags it would solve the issue :)

records.title: A great place to try!
records.text: Cards came quickly and in good condition, plus I was very happy with the prices! It was also the only place we could find a basic (non-holo) psychic energy pokemon card to truly complete our scarlet and violet set! Only downside was that a lot of cards seemed to be out of stock for various pokemon.

records.title: They have a big selection of cards and…
records.text: They have a big selection of cards and have been both prompt and reliable in sending out my purchases.One small gripe is about their website not the service.I wish the "sets" could be ordered by date as well as alphabetically. There have been a lot of sets now for MTG and I don't remember the names well particularly for the most recent ones !

records.title: Good service and choice
records.text: Great service, fast pick up and cards in good condition, would be 5 stars if the cards were better protected and not just in a bag with my invoice around them.

records.title: Great for cards, could offer more!
records.text: The site is easy to use, delivery and dispatch are nice and fast with out being overly pricey with a good selection of cards.My only problem with the site is that I would have liked to get sleeves and accessories with out having to go to another site.

records.title: Great service and super reasonable…
records.text: Great service and super reasonable prices. I do wish you would stock more super rares though. It's so difficult to obtain them. But overall the best card distribution company I've ever bought from!

records.title: Fast, reliable, and recommendable!
records.text: The cards arrived quickly with the standard shipping and were not left in an outside storage and were posted through the mail slot which is greatly appreciated. They arrived in a cardboard packaging which protected the cards very well, I have had previous orders where the cards are in rigid sleeves and a bubble wrap pack but the cardboard box was rigid enough to prevent damage to the cards. The only issue which isn’t too major is the cards weren’t individually sleeved like I have had on previous orders. They were in a sealed bag inside the box but individual sleeves would be nice to prevent scratches on cards between other cards. Luckily none of mine appear to be scratched though

records.title: Ordered last week but haven't received yet
records.text: Website is easy to use and has good offer and variety of cards. However, have ordered one week ago and still haven't received my order.Thx for your reply. Haven't received anything yet, though. Have you sent to the correct address?

records.title: Good and quick👍
records.text: Some Cards were very lightly played instead of near mint fine for playing with but may put some collectors off. May have also happened in transit. Other than this cards were perfect, cheap priced, have good variety and arrived quickly. Thank you very much for the great service!! 👍

records.title: Fair and Fast service
records.text: The only place I have found that sells cards for a fair price, is simple, easy to use and fast to arrive.  I Literally had the cards I ordered in my hands within 24 hours. The only reason it's 4 stars and not 5 is because they didn't have more of the cards I needed in stock.

records.title: Very nice
records.text: Cards arrived in quick succession from order to door, next time I’d hope that they are sleeved separately rather than in one as this could damage cards and cause scratched which most people may not be happy with.

records.text: Delivery is always fast, the foil lightning skelemental should have been stored in a sleeve as it had signs of wear and wouldn’t have passed for NM in my eyes. Would really have liked the card in NM condition as stated. Overall a great service, please place the rares and foils in penny sleeves!

records.title: Fast delivery, good quality
records.text: Fast delivery, in great condition and easy to use website. Only issue was there was a card in my order that was in stock at the time of me paying, when it was dispatched I was told it was no longer in stock but I got credit for the value which is fine but I would have liked the option to pick a different printing of the same card. Not a big issue at all and otherwise perfect service.

records.title: Big orbit order
records.text: Received the order but some of the cards, particularly the ones I was looking forward to the most, arrived arguably damaged. One had a dented corner and another had whitening on the back of the card, despite being labeled as near mint. The other cards were okay though

records.title: Quick delivery, cards always in good condition

Only complaint is most singlw cards that you'd be after are very likely to be out of stock and hardly ever get restocked if at all, because of this, you'll find yourself having to use other online retailers/sellers anyway.

records.title: Delivery came within 24 hours which was…
records.text: Delivery came within 24 hours which was very impressive. However the packaging was a let down. Cards unsleeved and no top loaders, luckily they were OK but having them just increases risk of damage in the post.

records.title: Nice prices, not so nice website
records.text: Solid place to buy. 4% cash back is basically nothing, but it's a nice touch. Would appreciate if it was 5-6%. The site is a little clunky and there's no way to put in a mass buy list which severely slows down my use of the site and makes it less favourable to use, even if it has better prices than competitors a lot of the time.

records.title: Pack properly.
records.text: Package come in a cardboard like envelope but 1st card was dented. 11 cards wasn’t sleeved, luckily the edge no damage. Trying to use the invoice to protect the cards, but it was loose moving around and wasn’t tape to the cards. Anyway the dented card only a $4 card, never mind then. I guess too cheap no need to sleeve. lol..

records.title: Maybe too fast?…
records.text: Lightning fast delivery. However, I do feel like 3 stars is very appropriate as my order felt rushed and 2 out of the 3 Weiss Schwarz cards I purchased were not even placed in a penny sleeve. Spent £30 and a card worth £20+ I received has quiet a big mark/dent on it. I would tell others to “buy with caution.”

records.title: Quality is good, communication felt rude
records.text: I've been a customer for a long time and as always the speed of delivery (even during the mail strikes), price and quality of cards is amazing.However this time I wasn't a fan of some of the wording during communication. I added a card to my order priced at £0 expecting it to be removed, an obvious mistake  that I thought would be harmless and funny. However the message I received said this "As this card has no price you were not able to pay for the card on cechkout so we have had to remove it from your order."Now while it's minor and is just on interpetation I felt like I was accused of causing a problem by not paying for the card and I was at fault, even though it was marked  at £0. I had just expected "Sorry, our mistake" or something along those lines. As someone on the autism spectrum it felt rather disheartening as a customer to feel this way knowing how long I've gone to them as my first source of cards

records.title: Recieved one wrong card
records.text: Recieved one wrong card.  While I was refunded and told to keep the card I was sent (roughly the same value of the intended card) it doesn't fill the niche I ordered the orignal card for.

records.title: Overall Bad Experience
records.text: The website didn't have correct stock numbers for many cards, being completely sold out (but still letting me put them in my cart when I checked out). This was disappointing, especially for certain Fire Emblem Cipher cards I wanted. It should be regularly updated "in-real time" like other stores.I ended up ordering some Pokémon cards, which I was able to get most of what I picked out. However, I needed to contact customer service multiple times as they gave me the wrong tracking number that didn't update at all (I paid a little extra on shipping too for worldwide tracking, so it felt like I was ripped off). The refund for unavailable cards was turned into store credit instead of an actual refund, but they had no problem putting the money back on my credit card.When they finally got delivered, all the cards were all fine as described, though unlike competitors like TCG Republic, none of them were protected in plastic card sleeves. They were held in a couple plastic bags in a small cardboard box.I don't think I'll order from Big Orbit Cards again.

records.title: Negative roll of the dice with these cowboys
records.text: Spent ages using system to pick cards for trade in. Spent ages putting them in order. A large number of the cards got rejected for reasons I do not agree with but didn’t get a chance to communicate with anyone.  Received an email saying some of the cards had failed and would be returned at an expense to myself. Cards returned within a cardboard sleeve and all 20 or so cards loose inside a plastic bag with no sleeves on the cards even though they where all rare and some worth decent money with high grades. Some cards returned damaged when they where sent pack fresh. Do not use this service they show a total lack of respect. Reply shows how disrespectful these people are. These cards where not damaged when I sent them, you damaged them. Only one was incorrectly inputted a shiny energy inputed as the wrong age, came in a 2022 pack not a 2023 both having similar value. 5.5% of my trade is more than the average sale of your website guessing from some of the reviews. Copy pasted reply with some added dis respect. No attempt at rectifying the problem just shunning, nice customer service.Second reply: still just arguing with the customer.5.5% is you just trying to shame me and make people belive I’m being petty. 5.5% is irrelevant because it could be of any amount. 1 of the cards you rejected would sell on your website for probably £20, you rejected 5.5% of the total amount of cards because I traded in 140ish cards and you treat the customer like this? I hate to think how you treat someone who only trades in a few cards as you seem to care about the amount so much… want to know the stupidest thing? You kept one of the cards you marked as damaged and sent me back a card(worth more) that you marked as accepted. That’s how legitimate your vetting process is. It’s so pathetic how bad you really are.

description:
Craft Supplies
Art Supplies

OFFERS

Inspiring creativity since 1974
We think it should be easy for parents, teachers and most importantly kids, to fulfil their creative potential

with educational play ideas will get them thinking and learning from the very beginning.
We stock a huge range of arts and crafts supplies that make play-based learning straightforward and enjoyable for
all the family. Plus, we have hundreds of free craft projects and fun themed printables too - because we love
helping kids achieve!
 Exclusive Products
With over 75% of products exclusive to Baker Ross, there’s nowhere better to shop for your arts and crafts
essentials or party supplies. Designed with kids in mind, our toys, craft kits and imagination boosting
activities bring fun and learning together so everyone, everywhere can experience the creative joy of arts and
crafts.
Money back guarantee
All products sold by Baker Ross Limited come with a money back satisfaction guarantee. Therefore, if for any
reason you are not happy with your order or a product, simply return it to us within 28 days of receipt for a
full refund of the goods value or an exchange.

records.text: Great kits for brownies! Reindeer Christmas decorations were easy to assemble. Christmas colouring cones needed extra tape to keep them together. Stickers and snowman craft kits to be used in new year!

records.text: Goods arrived but took 2 weeks to arrive because of lack of stock in shop. Waiting for christmas delivery. Missed my grandson’s birthday by nearly 2 weeks. Goods ok as ordered.

records.title: All good.

records.title: When dealing with Baker Ross or any…
records.text: When dealing with Baker Ross or any company check the sizes of what you are ordering . Pictures tend to look bigger. Also if it says kits - don’t presume that the packet will have individual kits that you can just hand out to children. Disappointed with the dangly angels and penguin bracelets - a lot of work to divide them out if you are doing these with a lot of children . Otherwise generally good.

records.title: Average, overall, but an option to consider.
records.text: For the most part, Baker Ross is a good company with fair prices. However, you have to choose carefully, because sometimes you end up with sub-par items. For example, I bought a Craft It Christmas wreath kit and there was a very small variety of foam stickers to use, none of the nice colourful stickers shown in the advert, and they tore very easily when trying to separate them from their backing.

records.title: Good items, poor delivery
records.text: The items were good and as expected, but I paid extra for 2 day delivery and the items took 7 days with Evri.So I would say order from here but not if you need anything in a hurry.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: We have used Baker Ross many times in the past for Christmas Arts and Craft materials/packs, but this year the standard was not as high as usual.  Cut out cards were not good and needed to be levelled off with a guillotine, pom-pom wreaths were a disaster as the adhesive did not hold.  Children enjoyed making them but were disappointed when the pom-poms fell off.  Will see if standard improves before moving to a new supplier.

records.title: Not perfect but ok
records.text: One of the items arrived in perfect condition while the other arrived with tape on it. I ordered a Viking ship set which arrived in perfect condition and also a shield and axe set. This arrived with one part of the shield taped which was disappointing.

records.title: Dry paints
records.text: My order arrived quickly and was well packaged. The wooden baubles were as I expected and my granddaughters were very keen to get painting. Unfortunately, some of the paints were completely dry which, as you can imagine, led to a degree of disappointment. A shame particularly as I have always found Baker Ross products to be of good quality.

records.title: The parcel was absolutely soaking wet…
records.text: The parcel was absolutely soaking wet and I had to dry everything out before using it!

records.title: I'll start by saying I usually love the…
records.text: I'll start by saying I usually love the products from Baker Ross so it disappoints me that I can only give 3 stars for my recent purchase. I bought a variety of small crafty bits from the sale section to use in an advent calendarvand so far, they haven't all been great. Parts have been missing and the quality hasn't been up to standard which is why they are in the sale section I suppose. I haven't been able to contact customer service about these because we are opening them on a daily basis and seeing what we have. I will continue to purchase from Baker Ross but will make sure that it is only from the full priced things.

records.title: Wooden Nativity Stars
records.text: Wooden Nativity StarsThe stars themselves were of good quality but the needles were far too small with tiny eyes that made threading very difficult.  The thread was also poor quality and frayed readily when being pulled through the holes.

records.title: The product l ordered was not up to the…
records.text: The product l ordered was not up to the usual standard. The self adhesive green Holly shaped and red berry shaped " gems" were a mess. 1. The original bag had split and some were loose in the packaging. 2. Many of these had left the sticking medium on their sheet and fallen off. 3. Those still on the sheet were very difficult to prise off AND retain their sticky " pad". Disappointed.

records.title: The bird whistles were cheap and hard…
records.text: The bird whistles were cheap and hard to fill with water to whistle, unsuitable for a 3 year old. Disappointed with the other things I ordered but they were cheap to buy.

records.title: I have dealt with this company for many…Review of christmas decoration product./
records.text: I have dealt with this company for many years and found them to be excellent in products, delivery time etc. However this time I was disappointed with one item.  the t light penguins.  The t lights were not good and only 1 actually lit.  very disappointing for the group of young people.

records.title: Smashing! But not necessarily in a good way
records.text: The shipping was fast which was good, but I ordered ceramic baubles and they weren't packaged very well, resulting in a couple of them being smashed during transit.

records.title: Christmas characters paper chain kits.
records.text: Christmas characters paper chain kits.Bought for school children for an activity at the Xmas Fayre.Lots of pieces to sort through before giving to children.There was no white sticky strips for the snowman, had to use brown and turn inside out.

records.title: Up until this weekend I have had…
records.text: Up until this weekend I have had several good orders from Baker Ross, all good quality products at very reasonable prices, and good quality service, until until this weekend. I paid for next day delivery on an order I which I ordered before 2pm on Saturday 30th November and I only received it this morning 3rd December.

records.title: Package was poor
records.text: Package was poor, bent my product so spoiled end effect also colour run onto the white from the orange which made it unusable

records.title: Problems with delivery
records.text: Items ordered were good.  Choice of delivery company is reason for lower score. I paid for next day delivery, company indicated an evening delivery time but did not come.  As it was a delivery to a church, I wasted my evening waiting for them.  Baker Ross quickly refunded the delivery cost but goods that were required urgently were delayed and a lot of my own time was wasted.

records.title: Dry paint
records.text: I ordered the cracker making kit and a wooden paint yourself Christmas decoration kit. The cracker kit was great but the paint in the tree decoration kit was dry. We ordered 3 sets as my daughter was going to paint them and give them as gifts and the paint in all the kits was dry. Especially the silver and red. Completely unusable. I was going to send them back but with Christmas being so busy I just never got around to it. Luckily we had some other paint in the house but it was still disappointing.

records.title: Quality Products, Questionable Delivery
records.text: Although the products themselves are of good quality, they're delivery packages aren't. Twice I have ordered the same Item - a pack of 2 ceramic flowerpots, once from Amazon and once from the Baker Ross Website  - and twice they didn't arrive safely. The first time around both units came shattered, the second time only one of the units came broken. I didn't bother to order a third time... Or ask to return it again for that matter.The packaging really ought to be better so as to more safely secure the items (I wouldn't mind paying a little more for this). As of now, the packaging consists of just a cardboard box with very little styrofoam that doesn't even envelop the items completely. It leaves a lot to be desired.In conclusion, I'd probably only order from them again if the items in question aren't fragile, as it is pretty much a dice roll weather they'll arrive in good condition or shattered.Nothing to say of costumer support though, they were kind and fast in their response.

records.title: Website showed item available when it wasn’t
records.text: One item that was ordered wasn’t delivered. Notification of a refund came too late to replace with another item. Very  inconvenient (and was showing as available at time of order). When I tried to order a replacement item, Customer services were very slow and despite three emails back and forwards over a number of days (couldn’t find a number to ring) they didn’t seem to appreciate that I now couldn’t use my premium plus delivery due to (now) small order size, so items would not arrive in time. So system failure made worse by slow and unhelpful customer services.

records.title: Thoroughly disappointed
records.text: Have made several purchases over this year and I haven’t been overly impressed with any of it. I kept trying different things hoping to give them a chance as i’d paid for the annual postage scheme. Quality of products not great. The self sticking on decorative items are not sticky at all. Pom poms given with the product fall off immediately. A lot of the stickers you have to make up yourself with tiny fiddly pieces which is not explained in the product info. Not good for a 4 year old and parent with arthritic hands. The speed of delivery was always good though! Customer service were given the chance to keep me as a customer and failed dramatically with lack of empathy, human decency and understanding. Won’t be buying from here again.

records.title: Christmas Sewing Decorations
records.text: Ordered Christmas Sewing Decoration Kits snowman, reindeer and SantaThey looked amazing, thought they would be a great craft for our Beaver Scout !!Instructions did not match what was needed to be done! Safe glue for children could not be used And having ordered them early too late to send back!! I got hot glued 52 partial faces prior to them sewing them I glued the rest!! Labour of love Also several of the parts were missing!! I wills not recommend this craft or order this type of craft again …. Which is a shame

records.title: Full box of smashed lighthouses
records.text: The ceramic lighthouses I purchased for a children's event one box came entirely smashed and unusable. There was no bubble wrap or eco friendly alternative to support them during transport.

records.title: Delivery was dreadful
records.text: Haven't used the crafts yet, but delivery was dreadful.  I ordered on a Friday and Evri tried to deliver to my office on Saturday.  Got an email saying they would redeliver next working day, but nothing happened.  I had to chase Baker Ross who got back to me once and not again. Parcel was finally delivered a week later on a Monday evening to my office out of hours and got rained on.  Not impressed.

records.title: The self adhesive glue would not hold…
records.text: The self adhesive glue would not hold the pom-poms at all.Fortunately we had glue sticks at our Rainbow meeting and had to use them instead.

records.title: Poor packaging…
records.text: 1 of the glass packs had come undone and the glass hearts were all loose in the box! Pretty unsatisfactory plus there were a few glass shards in the box which I hadn’t noticed until I broke the box down for recycling. I then noticed glass shards all over my carpet! Wasn’t impressed.

records.title: Send notification of order being sent…
records.text: Send notification of order being sent out.When the original order was received it was left and wet through box collapsed - items not used. As no notification received a second order placed which arrived promptly.

description:
I am a pet portrait, wildlife and landscape artist working largely in watercolour but also some coloured pencil work. 
I work on a commission basis and welcome enquiries about commissioning a painting. 
Please get in touch via my website or Facebook/Instagram for a no obligation quote. I’d love to hear from you.

records.title: Hugo’s Portrait
records.text: We contacted Esley to paint a photo of our puppy Hugo who we recently had to put down due to illness, we couldn’t have picked anyone better. Esley asked for a photo of Hugo and has captured every detail from the photo in her painting and we couldn’t be happier with the end result. Everything was easy and straightforward from sending a photo over paying and collecting, we will be asking Esley to paint another portrait in the future.

records.title: Pet Portraits
records.text: I’ve had two amazing paintings from Esley, which I couldn’t be happier with. Esley is so talented and provides such a friendly service, I wouldn’t go anywhere else and I would highly recommend!

records.title: Esley managed to squeeze us in last…
records.text: Esley managed to squeeze us in last minute for a Christmas order, once she knew the painting that I wanted was of my brother and sister in laws dog, Ollie who had recently passed away. I was truly amazed by the finished article and fair to say there were tears Christmas day but happy ones, as Esley has captured Ollie forever. Thank you so much, would definitely recommend

records.title: Wow!
records.text: Wow!Esley did two paintings for me as special gifts. The first was of my gorgeous dog Twiggy. The painting is breathtaking! Esley captured all of Twiggy’s tiny details and amazing character! The second painting was of my dad’s prized racing car. The car is exceptional and my dad simply adores it! Esley is an incredibly talented artist! Her communication and professionalism is fantastic and she made the whole process so easy. You really can trust Esley to paint any of your beloved pets/items! Thank you Esley!

records.title: Phenomenal
records.text: We have recently got a portrait done of our cocker spaniel penny. I couldn’t believe it when I seen it. It’s just absolutely phenomenal ! Captured all of the details it’s just incredible. Esley you are so very talented! Thankyou so so much. I can’t wait to get another one done of our new puppy 😁

records.title: Wow wow wow
records.text: Wow wow wow . Received my portrait today of my loved pooch Sox, excellent service from start to finish , the quality is excellent and the talent of this young lady is phenomenal. Thank you so much Esley, i am over the moon and you should be very proud x

records.title: Captured our Patterdale terrier perfectly!
records.text: Esley painted our Patterdale terrier, Baxter, and we are over the moon with the result. Painting a black dog is quite difficult due to the subtleties of capturing depth, shading, and detail, and she did an absolutely fantastic job!She captured Baxter's fur, soulful brown eyes, and distinct personality. She didn't just paint a dog; but painted *our* dog, with all his funny quirks and expression. I wholeheartedly recommend Esley if you’re looking to commission a pet portrait. This portrait of Baxter is something we will treasure forever.

records.title: Winston the shih tzu
records.text: Just received a painting of our lovely shih tzu, could not be happier with it it’s absolutely amazing and better then could have imagined. Really helpful and easy to work with deciding what picture to use and delivered it exactly when she said she would. Would recomend all day long. thank you so much

records.title: An amazing portrait of our beloved 'Gus'
records.text: Esley was amazing to deal with and the portrait she has created couldn't be any better.  We met by fate whilst on holiday with our Siberian Husky Gus, Esley asked to take a photo of Gus and explained she did pet portraits.  We had a lovely photo we had taken ourselves that we wanted to her to draw from. This photo means the world to us as we had just received the awful news that Gus had aggressive cancer.  Gus is nearly 14 and grew up with my son's.  He is everything to us and we will never be able to express how much this means to us all. Her talent is second to none xxx

Shop Craft Machines
