Book a Workshop
Contact Customer Services
About Hobbycraft 
The largest arts and crafts retailer in the UK, Hobbycraft has everything you need for art, knitting and crochet, haberdashery, papercraft, wedding and party, baking, jewellery making and more. Enjoy the best brands, great value offers and crafting expertise every time you shop.
A passion for craft is at the centre of everything Hobbycraft does. This is reflected in creative and knowledgeable Hobbycraft colleagues and a vast, carefully selected range of quality products. Throughout the year, Hobbycraft also host a variety of workshops and demos in stores and online, designed to give everyone the opportunity to master a new craft or refine a beloved one.

records.title: Click and collected an order and I had…
records.text: Click and collected an order and I had brilliant customer service at pick up. Christmas is such a stressful time working in retail and the lady who served me was so personable and her kindness really warmed me. So much so I told my family and friends about it!

records.title: Brilliant as always
records.text: Hobbycraft are always full of high quality products at super prices. Ordering is easy and delivery prompt. I wish that there was a Hobbycraft shop in my area as sometimes some products I would buy are click and collect only.

records.title: E-voucher Christmas gift
records.text: First time ordering online with Hobbycraft and found the experience seamless (no pun intended) Bought a gift e-voucher and were able to choose when the email voucher was sent which is a great option. Would recommend for any crafters’ friends and relatives so the recipient can choose whatever they need 😊

records.title: Art materials for two sub-year old boys.
records.text: The items I bought, art stuff for children, were destined for two very young boys, who have had contact with painting, chalks, pens and drawing previously. The chaos of two sub-five year olds opening their Christmas gifts was magic to watch. They were playing and experimenting with them all day. The quality of the items is high, meaning that they should last for some time in the hands of boys at play. Well worth the time choosing and the price paid. Thank you.

records.title: They have materials you can't get…
records.text: They have materials you can't get anywhere else. Although the prices keep going up every month. It is getting more likely I will be shopping elsewhere.

records.title: Easy online ordering
records.text: Easy online ordering, even when they couldn't source an item staff were friendly and very helpful. Sorted a like replacement and didn't charge me extra.

records.title: I am absolutely delighted with my…
records.text: I am absolutely delighted with my purchase! I ordered canvases, and everything went perfectly. The quality is outstanding – sturdy, well-stretched, and flawless. The packaging was secure, ensuring everything arrived in excellent condition without a single scratch. I was also impressed by the quick delivery and attentive customer service. A fantastic choice for artists who value premium materials. I will definitely order again!

records.title: I will always trust Hobbycraft.
records.text: I will always trust Hobbycraft.I mostly use Hobbycraft for yarncraft supplies, but even for other art supplies, Hobbycraft has always come to the rescue. With comparable prices to other craft stores, they also give back vouchers that have long expiry dates.Always reliable when I need them.

records.title: Excellent.....
records.text: Excellent! A last minute christmas gift needed and was able to collect within the hour! Ideal!!! Worked for me enormously through hectic last minute bits and bobs.Staff were fab, and service was prompt on collection, all nicely ready in a bag for me to leave the store. I will definitely recommend this to friends and family.

records.title: It was easy to navigate and pay on the…
records.text: It was easy to navigate and pay on the website. I was given regular updates when my parcel would be delivered. A really straightforward and good service.

records.title: Perfect but for collection cost.
records.text: In store were brilliant and website easy to navigate.Having to pay £2 to collect from store stings a lot. Just for someone to walk onto the shop floor and grab it - something most companies would do for free.

records.title: Great jigsaw puzzle, bad packaging
records.text: Great jigsaw puzzle. Shame the lid was scratched/indented. Not sure if this was from before it was sent, or due to the uncushioned paper envelope it was sent in.

records.title: Would've given 5 stars
records.text: Would've given 5 stars, but you've withdrawn support for our emergency workers by cancelling the blue light card discount.
Would be 5stars, but Royal Mail lost parcel for several days, before Christmas.

records.title: Products were well priced and arrived…
records.text: Products were well priced and arrived all together within the leadtime

records.title: Experience was okay…
records.text: Lady on the till wasn’t particularly polite. Quite patronising but the lady who fetched my click and collect order was super lovely.

records.title: I had a message saying my order was in…
records.text: I had a message saying my order was in store, so went along to coventry branch, the only thing that was there was the zip. Still waiting for the roll of soft wadding

records.title: An ability to update order would be good.
records.text: In total I ordered 3 jigsaws. On the Sunday night I ordered 2 as the 3rd one was out of stock, however, it appeared back in stock very,very early on Monday morning, this meant I had to pay 2 lots of postage. Both parcelsarrived in same delivery, all be it, in different packages. Ability to update order woul have been a bonus.

records.title: Arrived promptly but had to wash 3 of…
records.text: Arrived promptly but had to wash 3 of the packages at they were so dirty (like been on the shelf for a while) and the fabric bag I got for children to decorate stunk of mould.

records.title: Not every item ordered online made it…
records.text: Not every item ordered online made it into the bag. I didn’t check it thoroughly until a few days later and discovered item missing. Not yet had the opportunity to contact store. ***Thank you to Kristine from Customer Services for dealing with my issue in a quick and highly professional manner. Changed * rating from 2 to 4.***

records.title: Good
records.text: They have variety of things to choose from. But could be more organized cz they forgot to put one item in my online order.

records.title: Reserved items via online.
records.text: Reserved items via online.Arrived at store, collected items in just a few minutes. Items already packaged.

records.title: Hobbycraft... brilliant 👏
records.text: Absolutely nothing wrong with hobbycraft, there service is exemplary. Unfortunately the same can't be said for the delivery company that they use (Royal mail), 6 days to deliver a 48hr tracked envelope in mainland UK is just a bit slow 🐌. Like I said, hobbycraft are brilliant 👏,  Royal mail not so much 🤬

records.title: New customer.                                                  was not…
records.text: Very good quality brush but I was not expecting to pay £2 to pick it up from your store when I ordered it online.

records.title: Helpful staff
records.text: Helpful staff, will help you find what you are looking for. Have not yet opened and used my box of sewing threads as they were a Xmas present.

records.title: Nice black mount.
records.text: My black picture mount was delivered on time and I was happy with it's sizing.  I think that such a 'bendable' item ought to have a strong cardboard backing behind it, so that the post staff do not bend it.  There was a tiny bit of evidence that this had happened but I accepted a very slight fold in the mount as it wasn't visible once in the frame.

records.title: Great price and very quick delivery
records.text: Great price and very quick delivery. Size of parcel box was huge so wasn’t very economical or as eco friendly as could have been.

records.title: I ordered on line and it was a fast…
records.text: I ordered on line and it was a fast delivery. I love doing crafts, and Hobbycraft always has my requirements. The shop in Stanway is my usual place... it's lije Aladin's Cave. Carole

records.title: Happy puzzler!
records.text: Easy to order online and fast delivery. My only issue is the paper packaging on my 3 jigsaws and sewing thread was very ripped on arrival, luckily goods were safe and dry. Pleased that you are cutting down on plastic but perhaps some products need stronger packaging.

records.title: Quite simple to use the website
records.text: Quite simple to use the website, even for Dinasour like me.

records.title: Ridiculous size package for items delivered.
records.text: Ordered some wooden letters and wrap. Delivered quickly and love the products.  I am so disappointed in the packaging though.  A huge cardboard box for 6 rolls of wrap was so ridiculous.  You could have used a box half the size with half the packaging and it would have been fine.  Same for the separate box the letters came in. In a time when we should be so aware of wasting these things I found it appalling.

records.title: Brush problem....
records.text: I bought the Shore & Marsh Pastel Half Pans Watercolour Set 12 Pack.  They look lovely, and I cant wait to try them. But I cannot fathom how on earth to unscrew the brush to load it with water.  I now note that the one review of the product says exactly the same thing.  No instructions on the box and there is clearly a screw mechanism inside but nothing will get it to unscrew,

records.title: It was a quick process to order online....
records.text: It was a quick process to order online and collect at my local store. The staff are always very friendly and helpful there.

records.title: Awkward online form
records.text: I found the process for ordering a voucher online to be difficult as the form did not work properly.  I stated this at the time.  Since then I have received several emails asking me to review my purchase - it was a gift voucher - what can I say?

records.title: They don’t text you when they say they…
records.text: They don’t text you when they say they would ,waited 3 days and eventually went to the shop to get a Christmas present .Although I know they get very busy at Christmas there was no one in the shop staff stood talking .

records.title: I find it most annoying that once I…
records.text: I find it most annoying that once I purchase from hobbycraft, there's no communication. I can't track my items and I'm left wondering where it is

records.title: Please send gift vouchers in plain wrapper
records.text: Please send gift vouchers in plain wrapper. Surprise spoiled  in this household when envelope advertising HOBBYCRAFT dropped onto the doormat.

records.title: Feedback : Unfortunately the order arrived too…
records.text: Unfortunately the order arrived too late for the event it was ordered for. However I was able to travel to the nearest store pick up the same stuff so a crisis was averted. I then took the order to the shop and got a partial refund (it didn't include the delivery charge ironically). So I had two trips to a store which I'd hoped to avoid at a busy time. The customer service staff and shop staff were all helpful but overall not a great experience.

records.title: There was no record of my order on the…
records.text: There was no record of my order on the system at the shop when I went to pick up.Luckily the lady was very helpful and went to phisically look and found it on the shelf.

records.title: Click and collect fee
records.text: Product i ordered wasn't available in store, so fee was part refunded. I was still charged click and collect fee. The store sent me refund later after i rang then to point this out. So watch out for charges if ordering online. I still love the actual physical store, they just need to tweak website operation a little.

records.title: The delivery was very quick
records.text: The delivery was very quick. However, one of the 2 containers of royal icing was broken despite all the padding inside the box.

records.title: Lovely item spoiled by inadequate…
records.text: Lovely item spoiled by inadequate packaging. Jigsaws packaged in thin paper bag so all corners were worn and dented on arrival. Very disappointing as was a gift - looked like I was gifting a charity shop find!

records.title: Fun for kids, difficult to put together
records.text: Fun for kids, torture for parents to put together. The final result looks great but took good few hours to put together.

records.title: Recycled glass bottles
records.text: I ordered 3 glass bottles by click and collect as concerned may break posting. Given to me loose in a carrier bag, no wrapping to protect , on getting home one was chipped/ broken , no loose piece in the bag so had arrived at the store like that ... lovely bottles but disappointed ☹️

records.title: Lovely items bought for a gift
records.text: Lovely items bought for a gift. Slightly disappointed one of the boxes sent was damaged prior to being boxed. Item inside not damaged but for a gift the presentation  box doesn't look very good.

records.title: Absolutely fantastic range of products…BUT..
records.text: Absolutely fantastic range of products and the staff are brilliant BUT I always find myself rushing around to get out as quickly as possible because the music that’s playing is so terrible. It’s the only shop I know that plays poor quality cover versions, and I honestly feel that no music at all would be better.

records.title: 9 draw storage cabinet.
records.text: Delivery was quick, ordering was easy. Nine draw storage cabinet is of poor quality. It was easy to put together, other half checked to make sure that everything was as tight as possible as soon as it was moved the whole cabinet ‘racked’ to the side. When everything was re-tightened it was still unstable. Unable to use it to keep sewing machine on as I had intended. I’m going to have to think of some thing to produce a cross brace to prevent it from falling apart. The cabinet itself only gets one star!

records.title: Great tree Just a little bashed…
records.text: I ordered one of the white branch trees after seeing it in store and regretting not buying it. The box came with the tape dislodged and partly open. Everything had been bashed around. The tree was in thin tissue which had torn and some branches had to be rearranged as they were out of alignment. Perhaps better packaging/ bubble wrap would be advisable when sending out delicate items to customers and stronger tape to fasten the box!. Although I am mindful that couriers treatment of the parcel is out of Hobbycraft conttol

records.title: The website was not easy to follow
records.text: The website was not easy to follow. Fortunately I new what I was looking for,as just browsing is not easy.The parcel was delivered 4 days later than promised by Royal Mail

records.title: Online order
records.text: Ordered early. Went into store twice - petrol and carpark fees & valuable time! - to be told it wasn't in.When Manager investigated it had been in store but not logged in...

records.title: Poor packing & quality; disappointing overall
records.text: Everything was received but house shaped shelving arrived damaged due to insufficient/inadequate packing (arrived in a large box with other items & were wrapped in paper which allowed them to bang/rub together; whereas previous order of same shelving arrived individually boxed). In addition, the quality of this shelving unit has visibly & obviously declined since my previous purchase of the same items. Between the decline in quality and the poor packing, I don’t see myself ordering it again, which is disappointing.Paint is also somewhat lacklustre. Only the silver seems true to colour to me. Other metallic colours look muddy/muted.Air dry clay not opened yet so can’t comment.

records.title: Delivery did not arrive expected time
records.text: Well when my delivery said it would come in the morning it did not arrive until 6pm that evening. I took a whole day annual leave from work expecting it to arrive in the morning and I was very disappointed it came in the evening. Even though Royal mail emailed me telling me it was coming that time.

records.title: Hobbycraft Error
records.text: Firstly, a website error. I tried to add a small item to a Click and Collect order, but although the webpage for the item said it was available for Click and Collect, it was rejected by the Basket which said it was not available for Click and Collect. I tried several times with the same result. So I had to buy the item in store when I collected my order but the staff, who were not overbusy, were not interested in helping me find the item. Not a good response to a problem caused by Hobbycraft itself.

records.title: Poor
records.text: Bothered three separate times for a review - well you asked for it. Click & Collect - Most of the items I bought were fine but a large paper pad was covered with a thick layer of dust and tatty round the edges. You also used a ridiculous amount of packaging for these items. Don't send me emails, don't reply to this and do your own marketing in the future.

records.title: The product was good and a nice shop…
records.text: The product was good and a nice shop but the customer service was not great abrupt and unhelpful

records.title: It's very difficult to move around the…
records.text: It's very difficult to move around the store in a wheelchair. You have to much stuff scattered on the shop floor. The lift is way to small for my wheelchair and I hate using it. I was told to stay in the middle of the store and someone would get what I wanted. I feel like a second class citizen and should not be in Hobbycraft. I wish there was another craft store where I live so I could go to another company. Sadly I feel like an unwanted person in my local Hobbycraft store.

records.title: This company has a nerve having "craft"…
records.text: This company has a nerve having "craft" in its name, they are a joke. Basic crafting items are impossible to get, the choice in what they "do" have is extremely poor and their prices, just as big a joke

records.title: The cork lights are ok
records.text: The cork lights are ok. The fact that the postage cost more than the item is certainly not. Will not be buying from this company again.

records.title: Slow Processing
records.text: I placed an order on the 1st December, and it was still processing on the 14th; it would now not arrive until after the item was required. But the cancellation/refund request was dealt with promptly and efficiently.

records.title: Not In Stock
records.text: Item was shown as in stock at my local store via Click & Collect but when I arrived to collect it wasn't available so I had to settle for one of a different colour. Rather disappointing.Not the store's fault at all as they only have what they have. So the main web site needs to be more accurate in real time to reflect actual availability at its stores.

description:
Movie Figures Ltd. supplies UK customers with the amazing range of movie figures and collectibles from manufacturers around the world. The company was formed with the aim to make it easy for UK customers to locate action figures and collectible statues for popular movie titles. 

Movie Figures works with a number of popular manufacturers based in Japan, USA and New Zealand, researching and sourcing movie items we think you will enjoy. We sell items from brands including Sideshow, Hot Toys, Kotobukiya, NECA, The Noble Collection, Weta, Gentle Giant and more. If there is something you want that we don't sell please contact us and we will do our best to source it for you.

records.title: Absolute stand out service again
records.text: Absolute stand out service and communication yet again from people that genuinely care about and understand us collectors. It’s hard to pinpoint what is best, but the fact you can basically choose a delivery day is really unique and greatly appreciated. Thank you once again Movie Figures!

records.title: Quality as always.
records.text: An exceptionally good company with a huge range of figures and superb delivery options ,very well packaged.

records.title: Liara T'Soni Dark Horse Statue
records.text: Product was delivered undamaged and in excellent condition. Once they had the item in stock, communication was clear and regular. While there were some delays with the product, this was not the fault of the company, and when contacted their communication was prompt and efficient. I will definitely buy from Movie Figures again.

records.title: Most impressive!
records.text: This was the first time I had used Movie Figures and I was very impressed. The price of the figure was good and postage was free even.Communication while I was waiting for my order was very good and when it was ready, it was sent tracked and packed very carefully and securely. It arrived in perfect condition.I would highly recommend buying from Movie Figures. Hope to do business with you again, thanks so much!

records.title: I had a small issue which was my fault…
records.text: I had a small issue which was my fault with a product but Movie Figures answered my emails and were more than happy to other advice which sorted the issue. I am more than happy and would differently order from them again.

records.title: Great company
records.text: I was a bit nervous using Movie Figures as it was an expensive pre-order and I’d not used them before. However Christine’s communication was great so put my mind at rest. When the item was released and made its way to the UK, Movie Figures were quick and efficient in getting it to me safely. I shall definitely be ordering more from them after this experience.

records.title: Perfect.
records.text: I will keep this short as I have already posted many reviews.Perfect.Goods arrive fast when available and in perfect condition.Had zero negative experience on quite a few orders at this point.Highly recommend this company.

records.title: Great customer service
records.text: Great customer service, goods came quickly and I would definitely recommend.

records.title: Great buying experience
records.text: Good site - the filters are good for narrowing down the selection to the categories you want. Purchase process is simple, and the information provided is easy to interpret. Nice that in-stock items are sometimes discounted to a reasonable degree. Packaging is good, nothing has ever turned up with even packaging damage.

records.title: Always efficient and reliable
records.text: Movie Figures are always extremely efficient and they are great at communicating the progress of my orders. They are my first choice for figures and statues.

records.title: Phicen model detail specification.
records.text: An issue with the phicen models on many sites is that it doesn't specify the level of detail or work done on the model. As the pictures extremities parts are censored, and there is no information on this, I ended up disappointed with the item when it arrived as I had to then order art stuff to paint it myself.The item was shipped on the day, I received it on the day they said I would get it, and the price was lower than other sites, so other than the issue shared by other sites, there's no complaints at all and I will be getting from you in the future.I have been able to find several lists online that say which serial number of Phicen models have which kind of detail, it would be next-gen if your site could find a way to apply that information to the items you sell, as it really is a mixed bag with the models with some having vague detail and some being highly detailed.

records.title: 1/12 male TB League figure, small head!
records.text: 1/12 TB League figure took its time to arrive but it was well packaged. Had to ask my husband to put the head on the figure as it was quite stiff. I was surprised and a little disappointed that the head sculpt was smaller than the recent female figure I purchased, same make and size

records.text: Excellent range and good prices very fast delivery options also , a good UK retailer of Phicen TBLeague models that are quite hard to find elsewhere

records.title: Just received the tee….quality looks…

records.title: Very good service

records.title: Great to buy from.
records.text: The only issue for me is how long the figures take to get to you after the actually come out.  But thats not the retails fault.The retailer themselves have great communication, and they pack everything well.

records.title: I have always found this company to be …
records.text: I have always found this company to be one who will answer any queries courteously and in a timely manner, they dispatched the item promptly and it came well packaged.I look forward to dealing with them again also it is good to find a company selling in the UK The only reason I only gave 4 stars was that I never or very rarely give 5 stars on anything as I always think there is room for improvement.

records.title: Great store, will definitely shop there again, but...
records.text: ...packaging could possibly be improved. (The actual item box does have minor signs of wear but I imagine that's from delivery to Movie Figures.)Saying that the overall service is great, and the ability to pay a deposit is perfect.

records.title: Good, but. . .

However due to it being a high end collectable, the "packaging" (rolled in corrugated paper with fragile tape to secure) was in a battered state upon arrival. Being a collector, my worst fear was realised when the art box housing the replica was also creased, and therefore deemed worthless. This said it still stores the replica fine, although better packaging would be advised for future custom/purchases.

records.title: Great customer service!

Recieved very friendly emails on all orders and pre orders, would highly recommend and I will definitely be ordering from movie figures uk again. records.title: good quality
records.text: I purchased 2 models (captain america and Iron man from civil war).  both were delivered promptly and received in good time.  My only complaint is that I had to pay postage for both items, but these ere sent in the same delivery!

records.title: Good item.

records.title: The Reverse Flash got to me in perfect…
records.text: The Reverse Flash got to me in perfect condition, but I was told it was out in December but I didn't get mine till early February, I'd quite forgotten about it.Still, he does look really good.

records.title: Top uk importer of quality collectibles

records.title: wonder woman seated on a horse

records.title: Star ace harry potter & the goblet of fire
records.text: Great figure and plenty of accessories giving you plenty of ways to pose your figure, the tailoring on his outfit easily competes with any top company (hot toys) who makes 1/6 figures, the goblet its self has great details as does the golden egg, there is a rock base that lights up with blue LED, you can place either the cup or egg on it to illuminate it, the broom also has great details, then there is the stand which gives you away to display harry on the broom mid flight or you can have harry stood upright.the sculpt has that life like look but star aces paint work lets it down a bit, the only problem with the articulation is at the ankles as the boots restrict it, star ace offers you a lot for your money and are cheaper than hot toys but they are starting to get to hot toys prices. MOVIEFIGURES.CO.UK is one of the best companys ive come across with its wide range of 1/6 figures and has got fantastic prices so check them out you wont be disappointed...

records.title: My opinion
records.text: Got to say it's fantastic knowing there is service like this online.. Their service  is  2nd to none .. I will be shopping here again..

records.title: Good service
records.text: As usual the product was shipped in good order and well received - only comment is that the product that was delivered doesn't fully match that which was advertised on the site, some of the parts was not included.

records.title: Broken due to bad manufacturing
records.text: I bought the Sideshow Collectibles Batman The Dark Knight The Joker Premium Format Statue at the start of February. The right arm magnetic attachment was weak, and I should have complained at the time as it was clearly faulty but foolishly didn't. Both arms have since fallen off the statue due only to environmental vibration (people walking, etc...), and all the fingers have broken off due to the brittle nature of the fabrication medium, which is incredibly upsetting. This was a manufacturing defect that should have been caught by quality control or, at the very least, by Movie Figures. At the time, it was a £600 limited edition figure that I now cannot replace. It is incredibly upsetting to invest that much money in something only to find that poor quality control and shabby manufacturing mean that it is now ruined and devalued.

records.title: Good figure but…overpriced..
records.text: Good figure, but very overpriced. Was expecting better quality at £134. Head(s) don’t sit very securely once the cape is on. Detail of the lower face(s) not quite as good as advertised, and cape and body felt a little low in quality (for the cost). Still a good figure, but I would say at half the price.

records.title: I ask about delivering to Post Office …

records.title: Delivery

records.title: Bit disappointed with Harley in dancing…
records.text: Bit disappointed with Harley in dancing dress figurine.Head seems too small for body and dress does not fit.

records.text: It took 9 days after ordering to deliver, 4 days after email notification of date and time of delivery. Customer service gave wrong reassurance, their courier finally threw the pacel over the locked side gate and the actual figure container box was battered. A really bad experience.

records.text: Make sure you get metal as plastic is really weak.and  don't bend too good.clothes are poor quality too.

records.title: Parcel Force is a shoddy courier. Use Hermes instead.
records.text: Movie Figures used Parcel Force to deliver the item. I checked the tracking information for my package and discovered that the tracking said that Parcel Force attempted delivery of my package the day before. No note was left saying this. People were in at the time that the attempted delivery supposedly happened. There was a car in the driveway and the delivery person would have been able to see people through the front window. Since it seems that Parcel Force didn't even bother to turn up to the delivery address but marked it as "attempted delivery" on the tracking information anyway, I contacted them. They told me the package had been brought back to the "local" depot, which is miles away and said that I can collect it from there. Since that was unacceptable to me, I asked how to get it "redelivered". They gave me a link to an online form. The date on the card was a required field on the form so I messaged back to Parcel Force saying that I didn't have a date because they couldn't be bothered to leave a card. They just told me to put any date. At no point did Parcel Force apologise during my communication with them. They are a shoddy company and a better one like Hermes should be used in the future. I hope they actually bother to try and deliver my package on Monday now.

records.title: THEY STEAL MONEY EVEN WHEN YOU TELL THEM ITS FOR A FUNERAL LIKE IT WAS IN MY CASE.
records.text: Daylight robbery at its finest,I have now started seeking legal action on this case my solicitor as advised to watch what say in regards to this private matter but due to the facts of my loss their terms and condition shouldn't have stood but end of the day you get greedy people that expect something for nothing at this just another one of them company obviously that's why they are so successful I will be purchasing more item but not from this shambles of a company I have found a much better one.

records.title: Orderd a phicen from these people Back…July
records.text: Orderd a phicen from these people Back in July still not recived, no communication with them at all over 3 months waiting and still no joy with this company they don t answer emails and are obviously not going to give me my money back wich they said they would upon a phone call would advise you not to purchase anything from their web site or on EBay ive gone ahead and ordered directly from China it came yesterday only took 5 days to get here im still waiting for movie figures there a joke

records.title: Really poor service, make excuses for their courier
records.text: The seller is a very friendly person (hence the second star), sadly their let down every time by a dreadful courier, Parcelforce.I have over 200 figures, only bought 3 from Movie Figures and had delivery issues each time.Parcelforce don’t deliver to the delivery address, they’ll sneak up and slip a card through the letter box though.Once again, even given the lockdown, Parcelforce claimed to have left the package at a post office, Movie Figures claimed it was still on the driver’s van!After a week of being messed around I asked for a refund, never got one they insisted I wait for delivery. When it finally arrived Parcelforce had clearly been playing football with it and obviously it was damaged. Now Movie Figures want it return to refund, remember after they refused to issue one after a week of failed delivery.I won’t use the company again and until the get a decent courier my advice would be to avoid them, their more expensive than their competitors anyway.Dreadful service with a joke of a courier!Response to reply from seller.This is an accurate review and reflective of events. You were asked to provide a refund after failed delivery and refused, preferring to back your courier’s bad behaviour. During our phone call today you even stated no refund until return receipt, which I could not have satisfied as you hadn’t delivered it at that time.What reviews I post is my choice, check amazon where I have posted numerous positive reviews. If you wish to make this personal I will publish the entire affair; emails, PayPal responses into the public domain. Don’t cast defamatory comments about my character.Negative reviews, by their very nature are more likely to be posted as satisfied customers often don’t bother!You had a week to resolve poor service by a courier you selected. When the goods finally turned up they were damaged. You were paid a not insubstantial sum of money for an item for a collectible item, which final turned up in poor condition.  Those are the facts!And as a result of your attempt to cast me in such a bad light you have lost another star off my review. You know I’m a prolific collector, sourcing items from all over the globe. I run and belong to numerous groups, forums and blogs. I’d be happy to share this experience and your Trustpilot response there.Thank you for continuing to demonstrate how you conduct business, for vindicating me and justifying me feedback.

description:
World of Wool - a fibre & yarn crafter's paradise! Everything a Felter, Knitter, Crocheter, Weaver, Spinner & Fibre lover could need. All made right here at WoW HQ in Yorkshire.
We have crafting fibres and yarn in hundreds of wools & speciality fibres including Merino, Mulberry Silk, Cashmere, Corriedale, Sari Silk, Alpaca, Yak, Llama & much more.
We also cater for Vegan crafter's with innovative options, including Bio-Nylon, Rose Fibre, Bamboo, Flax, Synthetics & new creations.
Not only are we based in the heart of the wool textiles industry - that’ll be Yorkshire - we’re also old hands at this wool lark with nearly 40 years’ experience under our belts! That’s a lot of wool know-how!WoW HQ was set up by mum and dad and now headed up by son and daughter...with the next generation now well underway too!So what’s our mission? Well, with the help of our amazing customers, we want to blanket the world in woolly goodness and spread the joy of crafting!
We love talking all things woolly, so if you need advice on finding the right fibre or yarn for your next project, we're available by phone, email and live webchat now!





VISIT WORLD OF WOOL

records.title: Speedy & Fibertastic
records.text: I order from the US and I’m always amazed by the speed at which my order arrives! My students love getting the variety and quality materials you provide. Thank you!

records.title: Great service
records.text: Small issue with delay on delivery but it was near Christmas and I'm aware that couriers aren't always timely at this time of year.Contacted WoW and all sorted and delivered. All items were absolutely lovely and as requested... 😊

records.title: Wool
records.text: Everything in perfect order , the wool was delivered beautifully packaged in a design box. The goods are as described and of the quality stated.I highly recommend this shop.

records.title: Well recommended.
records.text: Despite me doing my best to make a mess of my  own order, World of Wool were very professional and patient with me. I would recommend every time.

records.title: Going the extra mile
records.text: Lovely boucle yarn, weaves well and works as warp and weft. Strong colours, as appear on website. I stupidly left my project to last minute, and then found I didn’t have enough to complete the scarf, which was intended as a Christmas present. Ordered more on the evening of Sunday 22nd- parcel arrived on Christmas Eve. Scarf finished in time, the recipient loved it. Incredible service- thank you!

records.title: I needed a crafty present for a friend…
records.text: I needed a crafty present for a friend and this was perfect. Unusual and interesting. Lovely materials and nicely presented. I love that kits are assembled individually-not a production line.

records.title: Yep great service
records.text: Yep great service, quick post and the perfect product, as described.Maybe could have done with a little more explanation of the product, what it's best use is, that kind of thing. I'm new to wool crafts and don't really know what the different characteristics of the differing wools are. But apart from that I'm well pleased. My wadded quilt is progressing nicely.

records.title: High Quality and Comprehensive Felting Kits
records.text: I was amazed at the speed of shipping. Everything was very well packed and protected. The felting kits were incredible. I've purchased other felting kits from other vendors but have never received such high quality, comprehensive kits with clear, incredibly detailed instructions, as I did from World of Wool.  The kits are a tremendous value. I look forward to making the kits I ordered and then ordering more. Thank you

records.title: Everything was perfect
records.text: Everything was perfect. Fast shipping, quality wool and nicely packaged. I will be ordering again.

records.title: World of Wool are one of a kind.
records.text: My order was completed and delivered so quickly. Everything was well packaged and excellent quality. I’ve ordered from World of Wool previously and I’ve never been let down. I can’t wait to start using everything.

records.title: The wool quality is good but it usually…
records.text: The wool quality is good but it usually takes a while to be delivered

records.title: Delivery took longer than expected
records.text: Delivery took longer than expected. I’m not sure if this is because I ordered so soon after Black Friday but it was frustrating. However, their customer service was friendly and helpful.

records.title: Great Service as usual
records.text: Great Service as usual, only slightly disapppointed in the Colour of Elderberry as I was hoping for a really dark shade, even deeper than burgundy in the Merino23 sereies. But colours are impossible to get 100% right all the time.

records.title: Thank you
records.text: Thank you. Everything was GREAT!! except the company that delivered the parcel. Definitely not your fault.I will order again but I was suggested to order a smaller quantity to get it in an envelop. I would like to know , how many grams for a regular envelop.I love your products.Ana

records.title: …wool order
records.text: Spoke to someone to get a repeat delivery out. Was easy to reorder and customer service was great. Was given the total due but didn't realise the delivery was a lot higher than I would have hoped to have paid. Received order promptly.  Good service!

records.title: If you order more than 1 x 50g you will receive your wool
records.text: Placing the order was easy and delivery was faster than expected. However, I deliberately ordered 50g units of wool for my order multiple times rather than ordering in bulk x 100g expecting to receive 50g units of each colour having paid extra for that privilege to receive colours in the weight ordered  eg 350g in one single unit rather than 7 x 50g. I then had to spend time weighing the wool out on receipt. I could’ve saved £ if I had known there would be no difference ordering in smaller units.

records.title: Many thanks for my recent order.
records.text: Many thanks for my recent order.The outer packing got wet somewhere along the way, torn open along 2 sides & was taped all round by the carrier.  However, all was dry when I received it and, on opening, only a small corner of the top was "fuzzed" from contact with the tape where the inner bag had split.   So, in spite of its adventures, my top arrived in very good condition!

records.title: Lovely product
records.text: Lovely product. So thank you. I would love to get free postage or some insensitive when purchasing bulk. (Last order over £90) The discounts you offer are very rarely off what I need when I need them.

records.title: Very smooth transaction
records.text: Very smooth transaction.  The only criticism I would give is that orders for collection can only be picked up Monday - Friday as there is no weekend opening. Luckily on this occasion, I had some days off work but maybe you could put the opening hours against the collection option if it is selected?

records.title: Corriedale
records.text: Consistent products but delivery is sometimes very quick and others not so much although always within the quoted 5 working days.

records.title: Delivery Service?
records.text: Although I can’t fault the alpaca fleece that I ordered, I wish the delivery could always be done by Royal Mail! DPD said that we’d refused the delivery and sent the parcel back to WOW! BUT I will say that the matter was sorted out so quickly by WOW and my wool arrived a couple of days later. So thank you World of Wool!

records.title: Lovely wools
records.text: I have recently ordered two boxes of wools for wet and needle felting. The quality is beautiful. Unfortunately I ordered the wrong micron for the first order but it was very difficult to change.Being able to amend the order prior to despatch would be really useful.

records.title: Some items were left out of my order…
records.text: Some items were left out of my order but they were quickly dispatched. Well done WoW for sorting this out quickly!

records.title: Please ensure boxes are taped up properly before postingI am a regular customer and have always…
records.text: I am a regular customer and have always been more than happy with the quality of service and wool fibres and equipment I have ordered. The parcels always arrive on time. Usually the boxes are always well taped up. The last box I received however was torn and there appeared not to be enough tape on it. Usually when I order 2kg of wool the box bulges but never break. I checked the contents of the box and everything I ordered was in there. This is not a complaint. I simply suggest extra tape be applied on the smaller boxes.

records.title: I am very happy with the wool
records.text: I am very happy with the wool I purchased and the price paid.  Shipping prices seem a bit high, but DHL was very responsive, considering it was as international purchase.  I deducted one star for the strange (computer?) error made on my shipping address, but DHL helped me correct it on the shipment and the box arrived a day earlier than expected.  I was in contact with WoW and I fixed it on my account quite easily.  I will, most likely, be making another purchase soon.

records.title: Order was processed quickly yes
records.text: Order was processed quickly, customer service was very good trying to help with the problem that I experienced. I took one star off for lack of information on website about shipping goods to another country. Would definitely buy from them again if I was in the UK.Sadly I think I'm going to have to buy from Ireland in EU.

records.title: Good product and service from WoW BUT
records.text: The order was shipped promptly and arrived in good condition, I was pleased with the quality received.  My only complaint is the courier DPD.  I waited in all day and at the appointed time slot I was close to the front door, windows open.  I have a very loud bell and no hearing issues.  I was surprised to receive a text during this time period to say I had been out when he called.  No card through the door or attempt to leave with neighbours.  It was then immediately delivered to a post office in a neighbouring village which is several miles away, despite having one within walking distance.  It was clear no attempt to deliver had been made and this was borne out when I made the trip to collect as it appears same thing had happened to many others.  As an older person with mobility issues this was very inconvenient for me especially as I had paid for delivery.  It was also very annoying to keep getting messages saying I had been out when he called, which was not true.  I also discovered it's virtually impossible to reach a live person at DPD just constantly connected to bots.  A wasted day for me.

records.title: The quality of this wool is quite good…
records.text: The quality of this wool is quite good and value for money.  It took over 6 days for the order to be dispatched however so was not happy about that hence the 4 stars. Dispatch times showed after purchase was confirmed, it should be stated clearly before purchase so that a potential customer can make an informed decision on whether to purchase or not given project deadlines.

records.title: Arrived promptly but product pack very poor.
records.text: Arrived promptly and there was a good selection in store. Haven’t opened the kit yet as it’s a gift so cannot comment on it The pack label on the outside of the cardboard tube is wrinkled and coming off so looks cheap and tacky. This is disappointing especially as it’s a gift.

records.title: I am of a certain age
records.text: I am of a certain age , and found it difficult to order different items by email, bringing up 4-5 different items to arrive in one parcel for postage fee. So I phoned and got a nice helpful man who placed my order . I was astounded at the price of cashgora tops, I was expecting a 100 grm pack for £11-40 not £11-40 for 50 grms, feel this should be made more plain as not a lot can be made from a 50 grm pack. And I ended up paying £22-80 for 100 grms wool .

records.title: Love WoW . . . but this order did not stack up :(
records.text: I've always loved my WoW orders, but the last one was disappointing. I ordered 7 of the Mixed Carded Waste bags and thought I would receive 7 (500g) bags of smaller scraps. Instead, I was sent huge quantities (at least 500g each) of the same colors (red, black, pink, and gold) in addition to some smaller scraps of different colors. I had hoped for individual packages and more variety of color.

records.title: Confusing site
records.text: Before I made purchases online, I clicked on the option of the prices including tax. So, I assumed that tax is already included in the price. All prices were looking good. Only after payment the note that all taxes and custom duties are responsibility to pay for the non-UK customers, appeared on the screen. Why this message was not there before payment? I would not make a purchase if I knew it before. Not cheap shipping, plus taxes and duties almost doubled the price of the wool. Moreover, I am not sure if I paid double taxes or not. Very confusing site. This was my first and the last purchase from this store.

records.title: An item of my order was missing
records.text: An item of my order was missing. I have emailed explaining this and  have received polite professional responses.👍The missing item was sent however it is the WRONG COLOUR: Silver🤦(My order was for Angelina Aurora Crystalina x2 plus some other stuff)I've emailed again...Please send the correct item.

records.title: Disappointed. I ordered some curly wool for dolls…
records.text: I ordered some curly wool for dolls hair that said ringlets or tight curls, but what arrived was just a boucle wool, nothing like what was described in my opinion. Such a shame really as there's better boucle than what was sent to me.

records.title: Easy to order
records.text: Easy to order , quick delivery.  Unfortunately some of the curly locks where very poor quality that being said they refunded me straight away .

records.title: Carded or uncarded?
records.text: I ordered a kilo of wool to restuff a pillow and some cushions. Trying to consume in a more sustainable way, I thought this would be a better option than synthetic fibre. I didn't realise that although the wool had been commercially scoured, there would still be quite a bit of debris in the wool. Upon contacting customer services, I found that buying carded wool would have been a better idea. I think the website could be a bit clearer about this and also give some guidance on quantities required. A kilo of uncarded wool is enough to fill one pillow, for example.

records.title: Only three colours in the package
records.text: Only three colours in the package. Orange, yellow and grey. Yellow being the bulk of it and my least favourite colour. Hopefully if I order again there would be more of a mix. Yarn is also finer than I thought it would be. If you like yellow and orange it would be a good buy. 😊

records.title: The products are good quality and i…
records.text: The products are good quality and i look forward to using them. i was just disappointed to get a message in in the middle of the night saying if i wanted delivery in a few hours  I had to pay 22 euro in import tax.  Some warning of this when purchasing would have been good. I often purchase on amazon and have never paid import tax before so was not aware of this.

records.title: Ordered but still waiting due to DPD
records.text: Ordered but still waiting Not really companies fault but DPD’s Bad service from DPD Updated: Have used this company for many years and have always found them very helpful and efficient. Delay was not their fault. I will use them again in the future.

records.title: Absolutely love the products…
records.text: Absolutely love the products. I purchased yarn made from hemp, lotus and bamboo which came to a total of £10.85, which was excellent value.However, I live in Ireland, and by the time the postage (£19.64) and Custom Duty (€13.22), the total cost was a lot more than expected.I would love to order more yarn in the future and was wondering if there was another way to keep delivery cost down?Thanks.

records.title: I loved the product and the speed
records.text: I loved the product and the speed, I was only surprised by that  I had to pay customs through DHL. I knew I had to pay customs, but it would have been nice if world of wool tells you that you will get an email, app from DHL, because at first I really thought that someone was out to trick me into paying something under name of DHL, because I wasn't expecting this. So if you order from th continent, beware that after the purchase you will be asked by DHL  to pay customs.

records.title: I am reminded each time why I don't shop as often
records.text: I absolutely love the products at World of Wool and would love to continue to purchase. However, I keep getting reminded as to why I don't do more purchases with them is because their shipping plus the DHL import duties (whatever) end up costing me more than the cost of the products.

records.title: Poor delivery options
records.text: I ended up coming home early from holiday to deal with the parcel delivery.  It was delivered to non existent neighbours and no-one had any idea where it had gone. When I got home I found the parcel outside my front door.  It could have been there for 5 days and was signalling that no-one was home.  I was lucky it was not stolen.

records.title: Great products but brexit increases the costs
records.text: I like the amazing choice of fibers, even rare and unusual specialities. I like the efficiency of the team and the very reasonnable prices.I dislike the increase of the shipping cost and the custom fees since brexit : now I pay twice the price than before. I know World of Wool is not to blame for it though.I think I'll save my money and sail across the channel once a year to avoid those expensive costs.

records.title: Pot of joy…
records.text: I ordered shampoo as recommended by a friend. That's great. But I ordered a "pot of joy" thinking I was going to get some exciting yarn to crochet some novelty with and received some wool for spinning or felting. Do hence my score, because I was disappointed

records.title: Kapok wasn’t clean but mixed with …
records.text: Kapok wasn’t clean but mixed with  (plant)  debris. Still,  for the price payed I suppose that was not totally unexpected. However, I would rather pay a bit more and have quality kapok instead. Delivery was great. Price okay. NB Cotton comes from seed pods and is harvested without plant debris. I have bought kapok from other suppliers 100% clean. Sorry but this ⬇️ excuse  doesn’t ring true.

records.title: Weaving kit was good but mixed bag of…
records.text: Weaving kit was good but mixed bag of pre-felt was predominantly a coarse grey fibre (at least 80%) with very little of anything else.  I expected a broader range so was disappointed.

records.title: Colour less bright than online
records.text: Delivery was on time. Unfortunately the colour of the yarn was slightly different from that online; it was a bit duller. It is very affected by light. I noticed when I was into using the first ball. Decided not to return because of cost and time. But I will think twice in future about buying yarn that I have not seen personally.

records.title: Parcel was delayed with dpd without…
records.text: Parcel was delayed with dpd without explanation.  The parcel received was not the normal wow box and the packages within were wet.  However the contents were fine.  Issue with courier not with wow.

records.title: Beware of postage on orders close to 1 pound.
records.text: The service and product were wonderful but I made the mistake of ordering too much in one order so I paid almost as much in postage as the product cost.  World of Wool could have sent the product in 2 packages thus lowering the postage cost significantly.

records.title: Delivery was not sent out way passed…
records.text: Delivery was not sent out way passed the 5 day despatch, rang and was told it would be despatched and it still hadn’t been despatched 3 days later. Rang again to be told it was delayed because they were waiting on an item to come back in stock before they could despatch when I questioned why I’d had no communication from them they did not know very disappointing as was highly recommended to me.

records.title: I found it very difficult to buy gift…
records.text: I found it very difficult to buy gift vouchers. It seems to be made complicated by the with/without vat option. I tried to buy with vat, but think I have ended up with ones that are without, so I don’t know how they are going to work.

records.title: After complaining about my felt being…
records.text: After complaining about my felt being cut short I was told I could bring it back to have another piece cut. I would have at least expected to have one sent out by post and given a return label to send the short one back.

records.title: White bamboo fiber 1kg covered in black stains and barely useable
records.text: Ordered the 1kg bamboo only to find it had lots of dirty marks throughout. Unfortunately this was only noticed after starting to cut it for my custom order. Due to short timeframe I used the bits I could and emailed WoW with photos to explain and share my disappointment. After a lot of back and forth they agreed to collect what I couldn’t use which was 800g for a partial refund. The amount refunded to me after receiving a damaged item wasn’t worth it. I wish I’d have kept the faulty bundle and used it in another project. Really disappointed, especially since I’m a retuning customer…

records.title: Disappointed service
records.text: Colours were not what I wanted, but happy to accept, rang to ask if I could buy just one cone of yellow, gentleman said he would check and call me back, he didn't, very disappointed. First time I had used this company, certainly be the last. Very poor customer service.

records.title: Throw is great delivery terrible
records.text: Throw is great. Delivery company DPD were hopeless - missed the house twice, parcel took 4 extra days from scheduled delivery date.

records.title: Shipping and costum costs
records.text: The shipping costs to Germany are extremely expensive (more than 20 pounds), additionally I had to pay nearly 30 euros for custom costs.The wool is good quality tho.

records.title: Really unhappy with the selection of…Botany Lap Waste
records.text: Really unhappy with the selection of the botany lap waste.  Over a third was white and well over 500 grams was acrylic.  The first couple of times I ordered I got the best selections of fibre.  The package was exciting and fun.  The last two times the selection was just waste….and a lot of fibre I will never use.

records.title: Quality is slipping
records.text: Normally World of Wool has excellent fibre. Lately, however, I have found that the quality is slipping. In my last order I found a lot of the fibre had deep creases in it, the top was in multiple pieces and I was sent the wrong type of fibres for some that I ordered.

records.title: Smelly unusable wool
records.text: I ordered a large amount of wool and the core wool especially smells so bad that I can't use it without washing it which causes it to lump together. The other wool I ordered was mostly fine.

records.text: They had the products I needed, and we're cheaper than Amazon.I expected a delay on shipping due to Christmas, but my order went out the next day and arrived sooner than I thought.The items were well packaged and work as expected.I'll be coming back to this company for my Gunpla needs in the future.

records.text: My husband loves anime/model kits etc... and I know very little about this stuff (I know enough brief info to get him presents!). records.title: Ordered an entry-level gundam…
records.text: Ordered an entry-level gundam without thinking too much about the website. They sent a nice gundam sticker with my order, which was a really sweet addition. I'll definitely buy again just for the stickers lol

records.title: Fantastic first order for a new hobby.
records.text: I have only just got into Gunpla, after being an on and off modeller/miniature hobbyist for almost 40 years.  After looking at a number of retailers I chose OEShop after they were recommended by a trusted youtuber (Dave of MSPaints).I placed my first order on a weekend, consisting of 8 various kits and a decal set.  The order was confirmed and ready for RM pickup by Sunday afternoon.  It was collected Monday and delivered in perfect condition on Tuesday.All the kits were nicely packaged into a bubble wrapped block and boxed up.  I appreciate the reuse of random packaging as filler too.I felt like an excited teen again as I unpacked it and checked through the kits, with so many lovely kits to build.  Unfortunately, I then had to split them up, as they are gifts from my family for my Birthday and Christmas.  I do get to keep the bonus Gundam stickers to put on my wet pallette though, so thank you for those lovely extras.I am delighted with the service from OEShop and I already have a growing wishlist of kits to order when I can.Thank you and Merry (soon to be) Christmas.Dave (a different one).

records.title: Speedy delivery!
records.text: My order was sent quickly and it was packaged well. The PG kit that I ordered had no dings and was wrapped in bubble wrap for safe measure as well. I would definitely order again.Some things that could make it even better - more payment options? For some reason - when I was making the purchase it wouldn't allow me to choose the Pay in 3 for Paypal. Also, maybe have additional courier options? It is fortunate that the kit was packaged well (even had a FRAGILE sticker on), when it was delivered by Royal Mail, they threw the box to the ground (gasp!) which was all caught on my video doorbell camera. If I paid a hefty sum for something, I expected it to be treated with care. Not OEShop's fault, it was a Royal Mail issue.

records.title: 30 minute sisters line
records.text: fast delivery just started collecting the 30 minute sisters  line and was nice to find a uk store selling them at a good price well packaged

records.title: Very impressive first order
records.text: I ordered a Dspiase Illusive shadows reciprocating sander for my hobby, what a pleasure to find a company who offers good service, I am really impressed with the communication throughout the delivery process and the speed in which my order came. Thank you for your service.

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service, great prices, speedy shipping just a shame there are no shipping price options/free postage value like many other retailers hence only 4 ⭐️

records.title: Great Service but pricing while good could be better
records.text: Great shop with great service but in terms of pricing, it's okay but not the best for kits as I was able to find the same kits for up to 10 quid less in other shops.

records.title: They're alright
records.text: They're alright. They're not as friendly as the other hobby stores (Kikatek, Gunpla Oasis, Forbidden Planet, to name a few), however, but they seem to get the decent stock around if Gunpla is all you need and being friendly is secondary.However, I do love to support hobby stores that I know are worthy of patronizing. It's subjective, but that's where this -1 star is.It's like getting my guitars: I want to support PMT as they're friendly and nice and thus I got my Ibanez, and Schecter guitars from them. With their being canny and approachable with their customers, means they got my money where other music retailers won't. (I mean, would you give your money to a bunch of losers? Like this is why we're all crossed when delivery happens and we dread to know it's RoyalMail handing our parcels, right? They're a bunch of turds and you're left with no choice but to pay them for the delivery or go collect the gunpla yourself in Edinburgh.)Same principle applies here with these gunpla stores. This is a hobby and probably 1% of the population care, and that's why I want to patronize the shop who is worthy enough, and great enough.That said, the stores I would love to patronize didn't have the gunpla I want (Providence Gundam from G-Seed), thus I got that gunpla from them. I could have gotten the Epyon and Tallgeese (both from G-Wing), and the Unicorn's Banshee, but the Providence is enough. I can get the other gunplas from the other friendlier stores.That said, if gunpla is what you need and you just treat these hobby stores like Tesco where you got what you need, then OEshop has enough gunpla stocks even with all this pandemic chain disruption going around.

records.title: Great for the rarer items/tools not…
records.text: Great for the rarer items/tools not readily available at the more obvious outlets.  However, not the cheapest.

records.title: Swift delivery and arrived safely
records.text: I recently had the immense pleasure of purchasing a Gundam model and experiencing the most exceptional service from a vendor that specializes in the sale and delivery of these iconic mecha models. From start to finish, the entire process was a seamless journey that left me in awe of their efficiency and dedication.From the moment I placed my order on their user-friendly website, I was impressed. The selection was vast, catering to every Gundam enthusiast's tastes, whether they were looking for the latest releases or vintage classics. The website's detailed descriptions, high-quality images, and user reviews provided valuable insights into each model, making it easy to make an informed choice.One of the standout aspects of this service was the speed of delivery. I anticipated a long wait given the size and delicacy of the Gundam model, but I was proven wrong. The seller's commitment to fast shipping was apparent when I received a confirmation email with a tracking number mere hours after placing my order. To my astonishment, the Gundam arrived at my doorstep within just two days, securely packaged and in pristine condition.The packaging was a work of art in itself. The seller had taken extraordinary care to protect the model during transit, using multiple layers of cushioning materials, ensuring that it reached me without a single scratch or dent. They had evidently prioritized the safety and integrity of the purchase.The level of customer service was nothing short of remarkable. I had a few questions regarding the assembly process, and their responsive customer support team addressed my inquiries promptly and comprehensively. This level of dedication to customer satisfaction was truly heartwarming.As a collector and a Gundam enthusiast, I was also impressed by the seller's commitment to authenticity. The model I received was a genuine Bandai product, complete with all the intricate details and high-quality materials that one would expect. I could see that the seller truly values the satisfaction and trust of their customers.In conclusion, my experience with this service was nothing short of flawless. The process from ordering to delivery was swift and secure, and the quality of the product met and exceeded my expectations. I wholeheartedly recommend this vendor to fellow Gundam enthusiasts and collectors who are seeking not only top-tier models but also exceptional service. They have undoubtedly set the bar high for their competitors and have earned my trust and future business.

records.title: A really good website
records.text: A really good website, and fast easy delivery

records.title: Good choice and speedy delivery
records.text: Speed of delivery and a good choice of products.

description:
Welcome to Kent Models, your go-to online shop for those hard-to-find model kits! 

We specialise in unique and exciting car, motorcycle, truck, and film-star plastic models. Not only do we offer rare and limited edition kits from top brands like Aoshima and Fujimi, but we also supply everything you need to build them, from paints and brushes to glues and tools.
Our ever-changing stock is directly imported from Japan, featuring over 1200 different models including cars, bikes, boats, planes, military models, and more. Each kit is authentic, detailed, and a replica of real-life vehicles. We scour the globe to bring you the rarest models for building or collecting.

As the official importer and distributor of Aoshima and Fujimi, along with other renowned brands like Mr Hobby and Tamiya, we ensure top quality. Trust our website for only in-stock items and exclusive pre-orders. Our dedicated team is just a phone call away for all your enquiries. Explore our world of models at  Kent Models 
Visit the website

I'll most certainly use Kent Models again but only with a different courier (or Royal Mail even if there was a consequential slightly higher delivery charge). records.title: I contacted customer services are we…

records.title: Missing parcel

records.title: Confident Choice - Quality Assured

records.title: I needed some organza quickly and went…
records.text: I needed some organza quickly and went to the premises to buy some, after phoning first. The staff there were so helpful and the young man who assisted me was exceptional. He found the fabric for me and helped with a couple of extra items. I have bought from them before, on line, and honestly the order was sent immediately and arrived safely. I can’t recommend them enough. Prices are good too.

records.title: The customer service was brilliant
records.text: The customer service was brilliant. I ordered the wrong item and knowledge of the customer service person was amazing when I phoned to adjust the order.. He was very patient with me.The postage was excellent too. I ordered late Friday and it came Monday. Thankyou

records.title: best products and best service!
records.text: After trying similar but cheaper eyelet press and eyelets on the market without success, the trimming shop came to the rescue!Far superior product than others on the market - helpful staff at the end of the phone that had patience and sound advice - what a joy!  Thank you trimming shop!

records.title: The Items ordered were dispatched…
records.text: The Items ordered were dispatched quickly and arrived promptly. They also  functioned and held together without problem.

records.title: Excellent service from Trimming Shop
records.text: Excellent service from Trimming Shop. The hole punch Gromit I bought for my green press machine worked really well for the first 5 or 6 holes then blunted pretty thoroughly, not sure what to do about that

records.title: Green Machine
records.text: We saw a demonstration of the 'Green Machine' at Alexander Palace and were very impressed, so we bought one online as suggested. It is a superb piece of kit brilliant for eyelets and rivets and we are delighted with it but delivery was not very good. We ordered it on the Sunday with next day delivery as we spent over £100 which we hoped on for on the Tuesday. However it had not been delivered by the following Friday so we had to chase. It finally arrived the following Tuesday.

records.title: The person who served us was very…
records.text: The person who served us was very helpful when I asked him various questions. Nothing seemed a problem. Very much appreciated.

records.title: This was a very smooth transaction, see above.
records.text: This was a very smooth transaction and my package arrived in good time.  However, there were two parts to my order and one bit was missing from the package.  A quick telephone call to a very understanding member of staff who apologised and said he would despatch the missing item that day.  I am hoping this arrives soon as it is the item I am paticularly waiting for.  I will definitely use your company again.  Thank you.

records.title: Fantastic service from David however…
records.text: Fantastic service from David however however I needed to return the item as no cutter available as yet so went back to do it by hand as I have more eyelet and hand cutter and press it made more sense to use these up first. Would definitely recommend this store as service is excellent.

records.title: Useful magnetic clasps
records.text: I actually used the magnetic clasps to stop a mat moving over the carpeting underneath, whilst still being removable. It works well. The only problem was that I didn't pick up on there being many pairs of clasps in a pack, so I ordered 5 packs thinking I was getting 5 pairs. I'll have to find someone who can use all the others.

records.title: Well made products.
records.text: The web site has a huge range of products so it takes a while to go through them to find what you need. I always find the sizing is an issue as I cannot work out which goes with which. I have watched some video's of how to use the dies etc but some written instructions & photos  when the products are ordered would be a help as the pictures help to see "what goes where" when there are 4 dies & lots of backs to sort. Overall a good company helpful orders sent out quickly & well made products.

records.title: Ordered online 10/07/2023 great choice…
records.text: Ordered online 10/07/2023 great choice and The Trimming Shop despatched the same day. As order was over £40 it qualified for free next day delivery with FedEx. Received email from FedEx telling me it would be delivered the next working day 11/07/2023 estimate between 8.30am-12.30, no delivery checked the tracking and it was still in the back of beyond no communication from FedEx and delivered the day after 12/07/2023 with no notice or advice.  That’s not TS’s fault as they despatched when they said they would. Obviously next day delivery not guaranteed.

records.title: Wrong item purchased.  Website not as clear as it could have been
records.text: I searched for a 6mm eyelet die on the site and purchased what I thought was the correct item as it was the first on the list. Unfortunately I didn’t realise the difference between a green or blue machine and it wasn’t glaringly obvious on the website to a newbie.   Customer Service were helpful but a delivery note with a returns section would have been helpful to return the product for a refund. Exchange isn’t available on their system.   I am very happy with the product quality but instructions would be helpful

records.title: press studs…arrived quickly and well packed
records.text: Looked on website  selected press studs going on measurement givenArrived quickly and in good condition Although the press studs part was a different size from what I wantedFitted non the less  seem to be reasonable qualityTime will tell

records.title: Great price and great delivery times
records.text: Great price and great delivery times, the only thing that takes off a star is that I ordered 10m of elastic but the item came in 2 x 5m packets which I wasn't expecting; my other order of elastic was despatched as a 10m length.On the whole would use again though!

records.title: Great quality product
records.text: Great quality product which was well packaged. As someone new to using hardware I could have done with more instructions of how to use everything as I didn’t find the YouTube videos very clear, hence giving 4 stars not 5.

records.title: Stud Machine Dye set.
records.text: I found Trimming Shop where very quick on sending you goodies out. I had a issue with my first order and second but it was down to me and parsley there fault too, but one phone call later and the gentleman who helped me out was very knowledgeable and got it all sorted for me, and the part arrive the next day. Awesome.

records.title: Great shop, will buy again!
records.text: Good experience. Will buy from Trimming shop again. Would improve hardware details. (Length range of rivets once clamped additional to post length, would be advantageous)

records.title: Great products but poor instructions
records.text: The products (Green machine with 2 sets of jigs) are well made and the speed of shipment good. The instructions for using the jigs are, however, poor or non-existent which is a real shame. For instance for the poppers; I had to guess what size hole to cut into the material.

records.title: Good prices and prompt delivery
records.text: Good prices and prompt delivery. Customer service on the whole was very good but I had to follow up with them on an issue instead of them contacting me. All resolved in the end though.

records.title: Great product (unique I think) easy to…
records.text: Great product (unique I think) easy to use and neat finish. Prompt despatch and delivery. Comes in 2 parts of which one was missing from first delivery. Prompt response via online chat and prompt replacement. Check twice, post once :-)Otherwise 5 stars for sure.

records.title: Always be pleased when shopping at…
records.text: Always be pleased when shopping at Trimming shop for green machine dies and accessories good quality item.Only given 4 Stars because I spent that much time trying to and make sure that they go together.The sizing is not the problem.That is usually there if you flip between each component. Unfortunately I did spend a lot of time and still got it wrong,Had to pay postage and time to send back and reorder.Would love to see a better system.I would also like to be able to recognise the dies better or them come in a small box with a set of  whatever they are for.Been dealing with this company for a long time and would definitely recommend.

records.title: Green machine is great
records.text: Green machine is great. I ordered the wrong dies tho. I was told to return then and ask for an exchange. I was given a partial refund instead. I then bought the correct dies. Only disappointment is that there are no instructions with the dies or the poppers I bought. It would be useful to have these
