Some of the screws where damaged, which made it a whole lot harder to get them to screw in. Also a random rivet cap with "Murlon" was in the one of the bags.

records.title: Delivery was very slow possibly due to…
records.text: Delivery was very slow possibly due to the post office & not the supplier.The goods are exactly as described, not issues there, thank you.

records.title: If your a small business owner look elsewhere
records.text: I’m a small business and I have applied twice for a trade account and have been ignored on both occasions.  I’ve had to buy as a normal customer and this company is the only one I deal with that obviously doesn’t want small businesses.  It’s a shame really as we should all be supporting British companies regardless of how small.  Please keep the above in mind if you have to order from them. Maybe there’s someone else out there who is more deserving of your business. Thank you for your reply however I have not received any email with regard to a trade account. I’ve checked my junk/spam also. I have received notifications from you with regard to my orders plus notifications to post on here but nothing else. Can I kindly ask that you please send/forward the original email again.

records.title: The staff were very helpful and patient…
records.text: The staff were very helpful and patient with my queries before I placed the order. I wanted advice so that I ordered the right things.However, although the goods I have been shipped, I have not yet received them. I anticipate the delivery in the next couple of working days. The tracking number also says delivery has not yet been attempted. If sent by royal mail 5 days ago, I had hoped it would have arrived. The shipping is my only issue. Staff and emails were very helpful.

records.title: The delivery
records.text: The delivery - paid for next day but didn’t get it and had to ask for it on the Tuesday as it was bank holiday.  Think this was DOD’s issue though - not yours - just a lot to pay for next day delivery - ordered Thursday - would have been Friday - had to ask for Tuesday as Loading bay not open on the Minday.

records.title: No response when emailing about a problem
records.text: I ordered two lots of the same size gems from this company… I used the first bag and then when I went to use the second realised they were considerably smaller… I then counted the gems out and each bag had 45 gems, rather than the stated 50. I emailed the company two days a go regarding this problem, asking for this to be rectified and I haven’t had a response. Am a little disappointed as I was ready to bulk order from the company.

records.title: These need to be fitted with a tool
records.text: The product is good and the price was fair, but nowhere in the detailed description did it say i would need an expensive tool to be able to fit these eyelets. I appreciate that some people would already know this but I did not and i am sure I am not the only person in this position.

records.title: Room for packing improvement
records.text: Ordering was easy and ok. Shipment packing was very poor. Order includes few kilos of weights but they were packet into much too large bax and without any filling. Luckily everyting was ok anyway.

records.title: Top marks for quick attention to and…
records.text: Top marks for quick attention to and delivery of my small purchase. But unfortunately the zip described as 15 inches in the website was actually only 13.5 inches.  My refund was dealt with smoothly, but of course I had to pay the return postage.

records.title: Bought a zip
records.text: Bought a zip because my local shop couldn’t get matching zips from their stockist. Filled in form, paid money, it arrived. This is the minimum I expect from an online shop. Had it arrived by golden horsedrawn carriage I may have offered 4 stars. You do know with online orders that there is no interaction between myself and the company. Their stockperson could’ve been swearing like a trooper all the time he was putting one zip in a bag or they may have been singing arias. It really is ridiculous to ask for feedback when you’re service is no more spectacular than any other online shop. However as you’ve practically begged for a review here it is and maybe have a think about the horsedrawn carriage. Could be your new USP

records.title: Item very poorly packed and damaged in delivery
records.text: I bought a set of press studs in two sizes and attachment tools which came in a plastic case.  The item was despatched and received very quickly but it had been very poorly packed in a thin plastic postage bag.  When it arrived I found that the plastic case had been shattered and all of the parts were loose and muddled up in the postage bag.  The shards of plastic were only fit for the bin and it took me two hours to sort out the individual contents.  The packaging needs to be greatly improved to withstand delivery.

records.title: Blackcap spring press studs
records.text: I ordered blackcap spring press studs. whilst they do fit together the black caps do not seem to be as well  designed for the rest of the components as the silver caps. They seem to be a more general design, indeed same as the non-sprung press stud caps I have previously ordered. The silver caps have a longer prong, larger diameter prong and are a snugger fit to the other components. Therefore the silver will fit a thicker material and even on thinner ones are neater and more robust. They should not be sold as though the black is just a different colour to the silver. They result in a poorer product on the material.Does put me off them as I can't trust the range offered in any 1 product is actually the same quality.

records.title: Too small for Mah Jongg tiles
records.text: I ordered these racks (due to their length) to hold Mah Jonng tiles. description:
A PUBLISHING COMPANY WITH A STRONG CREATIVE HERITAGE
Hachette Partworks publishes collectable series such as Marvel Graphic Novel Collections, Warhammer 40,000: Imperium, Peter Rabbit Patchwork Quilt and more!
THE LEADER IN PARTWORKS PUBLISHING
We have an outstanding catalogue of both mass market and niche partwork collections, including our hugely successful, innovative craft collections such as Disney Cross Stitch and our exceptionally detailed build-up models such as Battleship Bismarck and Titanic as well as our high-quality book collections including Marvel, The Ultimate Graphic Novel collection and 2000AD: The Ultimate Collection.
With fascinating and inspiring editorial content across a wealth of subjects, and big-name licenses such as Marvel, Disney, DC and Games Workshop, Hachette Partworks create high-quality products across every genre.
Browse Our Website

records.title: Excellent Customer Service
records.text: Reached out to customer services as I received an out of sync order. Hollie responded quickly despite being the festive period and gave full reasons in that they were out of stock of some of my issues and didn’t want me going without! Excellent service!

records.title: Loving Hachete Partworks.
records.text: Hachete is a great company for partworks, I am currently subbed to the Ford Falcon build and am enjoying it so far. Im absolutely thrilled that they're making partworks available to us in the USA. They are very informitve with questions and info. I may start the U-boat build after the Ford Falcon, if it is still available.

records.title: Hachette Combat Patrol and Customer Service
records.text: The Hachette Combat Patrol subscription is brilliant, it's the first one I've collected since I was a kid and I am really happy with the service and value for money. Shout out to Milly in their customer service team who helped me incredibly quickly with a query I had.

records.title: Customer service
records.text: I was speaking with Hollie, and she was very helpful with a problem that was quickly resolved.Each email she was quick to respond.I can’t fault the customer service

records.title: So far so good
records.text: So far so good, I've received the first 2 packs. Looks like next dispatch in a few days.If I had a wish it would be the ability to speed up deliveries. there's one company that allows this.keep up the good work.

records.title: Great Service
records.text: Great Service, monthly invoices, product updates, shipment on time, customer service first class, great products, easy to read instructions, questions always answered.

records.title: Happy Stormcast Collector!
records.text: I have been subscribed to Stormcast for 58 issues.   I have been. Very happy with the subscription.   I have received all of the models and magazines with no missed issues.   I had one damaged issue and the customer support got me a new one no hassle.   I also had my card expire that I was paying for my subscription with.  Their customer support walked me through updating that and made me feel very comfortable throughout the process.    Happy Customer Here.

records.title: Fantastic product and Hollie at…
records.text: Fantastic product and Hollie at customer service was on point and lovely, I have no complaints.

records.title: Great and informative help.
records.text: Hollie helped with my enquiry and went the extra step to inform me of the subscription protocol, giving me timelines and when to expect the subscriptions delivery dates linked to my particular subscription enrolment account number.Great help and saves a lot of going back and forth in the future.

records.title: I've had the best possible experience…
records.text: I've had the best possible experience of great products, great delivery, and great value. Really happy with Hachette and will be subscribing to their other magazine products in the future.Needed to change my address of delivery and it was a quick, painless process.James B was my contact throughout the process and was excellent.Thanks Hachette!

records.title: I had issues with billing and customer service saved the day
records.text: I had issues with billing and not being informed about a late payment. However, despite this unfortunate news the customer service team was helpful and understanding and guided me on what had happed and hour to resolve the issue. I was helped by a James G, who was kind and helpful though out my experience even when I asked him to explain what had happened about 4 times. Overall happy with the customer service and it is one of the best customer services I have ever contacted.

records.title: Minor hiccup. Resolved by the business quickly. Communication could have been better.
records.text: So there was an issue where the next delivery I was meant to get was issues 11,12,13, and 14. But I recieved 15,16,17 and 18. I initially assumed this to be a mistake so I contacted customer support on 21/12 (a non working day) and was assisted by Hollie on 23/12. She explained that one of the issues of the 4 I was supposed to recieve was actually on back order so my normal selection wasn't possible to fulfil. The decision had been made to just send the next set in the schedule to ensure I would still have some kits to build, which is a decision I applaud. I just wish an email or something could have been sent to make me aware this was going to happen. Had that occurred I would have not needed to contact customer support.

records.title: Combat Patrol Magazine
records.text: I have had no problems so far, writing I've had no issues may have given the wrong impression.

records.title: Great customer service from Hollie
records.text: As a whole Hachette Partworks provide a simple way I get a hold of desired hobby kits and have a friendly attitude when it comes to customer support. My only gripe is I think the system in place is abit too simple, I just wish there was some sort of indication when it came to deliveries, like with most courier services they provide a window for when you might receive your package but with HPW it's all guess work. But other that that they're a pleasant service.

records.title: Packaging
records.text: I love the "Stormbringer" publication and associated models/supplies. However, the packaging isn't very protective of its contents. My issues come in a box (with no bubble wrap) or in a thin gray plastic bag. The plastic bag offers no protection at all. The value of my subscription is almost a $1,000.00. The packaging should be better at protecting my investment in this hobby. Thank you.

records.title: Building the U96
records.text: Building the U96. Excellent kit! Each month the amount of work/progress is just right. My subscription is the eight packs per month. They bill and ship promptly each month. Their customer service team is excellent! And knowledgeable if you do have an issue. I gave them 4 star only because they could improve on their packing of item’s . I have received a couple of damaged packs of the subscription because of item’s having no packing materials in boxes other than than zero issues.

records.title: Compelling Products, great customer experience
records.text: I always have a great experience with Hachette. They offer compelling products and have really good service. I've had a few issues with the website and managing my subscription, but I was able to get into contact with customer support quickly and easily with the online chat, and resolutions were quick and friendly. Cheers to Milly for helping me out with my most recent queries :)

records.title: Great starter to Age of Sigmar
records.text: I love that the magazine gives history and lore with each new one but also gives lots of extras from building instructions to painting guides, to play through scenarios.  Subscription comes on time and customer service is really easy to deal with. I would recommend this service to anyone looking to get into Age of Sigmar and the hobby in general.

records.title: Great Value for the Minis
records.text: The overall product is great for what it is, minis that you can create an army with, however all of the fluff (printed materials) that come with it, usually come damaged, warped, and there are way too many to fit in the binder that they are supposed to live in as a sort of reference material. Sheets will either eventually tear from the whole in them as you fill the binder up, or you can't add anymore to the binder.

records.title: Amazing people, iffy website.
records.text: I want to point out that I have received nothing but excellent service and assistance from Hachette and their staff. The reason I give 4 instead of 5 stars is due to their website which, among other things, is prone to crashes, bad links, and other modern maladies.

records.title: Efficient
records.text: The agent who dealt with my request was timely and accurate.  It did take a couple of emails before someone answered

records.title: So good so far
records.text: Other than the speed of the delivery roll out this has been excellent so far. Though the Magazine could do with a little more content on the lore and back ground.Its a shame there are only 90 issues.

records.title: Love the product
records.text: Love the product, would love it more if it included clear assembly instruction as opposed to accessing them on your website.  Overall, am loving it.

records.title: My Experience
records.text: They made some great improvements from when i first started using their services for Stormbringers. Communication is much smoother now and payments are easier. shipments are always extremely fast for me

records.title: I love getting kits in the mail
records.text: I love getting kits in the mail, I just wished the packaging was a bit more secure. These issues are the cheapest thing and I’ve received many of the shipments in a box but lately they are just in a mailer bag. So far I haven’t seen any damages but I don’t get to opening and building the kits right away so if there is any damage, I dont think I would get any replacements or compensation.

records.title: Missing part issue solved quickly
records.text: An issue of the magazine was missing a part, but Hollie quickly facilitated getting a fresh copy of the magazine out to me.

records.title: Age of Sigmar Subscription
records.text: I have enjoyed this subscription. Each month the package has come on time and like clockwork. The only reason I did not leave five stars was due to the binder issue with this subscription. In past subscriptions enough binders, at a fair and additional cost, were sent out to handle all the issues of the magazine. This time, they are only including 1 and not even offering to sell additional binders. 1 is not enough and trying to find a 2 ring binder is not easy. I wish they would offer additional binders or 3 hole punch the magazine instead of 2 hole punch.

records.title: Your product is wonderful
records.text: Your product is wonderful. The customer service from the United States leaves wanting. It’s not bad just isn’t good hard to connect and answers that are vague and taken as condescending.i don’t complain or start any negativity. But you asked . I appreciate you and your company. Looking forward to combat patrol here in the states . Thank you

records.title: Quick and Helpful
records.text: After accidently subscribing twice, I reached out the hachette to try and cancel the subscription.My first help request did not seem to be recieved, so i sent a second message a few days later. This was answered almost instantaneously by a Hollie, who quickly assured me that they would cancel my second subscription.Quick and helpful, with no hassle. Thanks again Hollie.

records.title: Good Customer service.
records.text: Faced a very small issue when placing an order where a confirmation email didn't come through.  I got in contact with customer service, where someone called Milly helped assure me my order had been placed successfully. They were very polite, friendly, and dealt with my issue promptly.

records.title: I didn’t receive a glue bottle with my…
records.text: I didn’t receive a glue bottle with my modeling kit.  I contacted customer support they sent out another copy of that specific issue with clippers and mold line remover but still no glue.  Otherwise very happy with the product.

records.title: Mediocre
records.text: Multiple demands for a review, so here it is.  Placed an order for 4 books.  One arrived, no notification there would be a split shipment, so had to contact them to find out where the others were.  I would have let it go, but they were desperate for me to share my experience so here it is.EDIT: They didn't care before I posted the review.  They cared afterwards.  If you're thinking about using Hachette, consider that.

records.title: I just want a partworks  company to ship on time.
records.text: I just want a partworks company to ship when they are supposed to. My first was shipped on 27th now they have been pushed back to the 4th or later. When they can ship on the 27 with out any excuses they will be a 5 star. The products are great. And arive quickly once shipped. Now just ship my stuff on time No excuses.

records.title: Nice model but incomplete total collection experience
records.text: I am enjoying the model building. I don't like the fact that the magazines are not sent which forces me to rely on difficult to view online material or viewing build videos from other builders. Plus, the collection of the magazines is just as important to me as the building and collection of the model itself.

records.title: Good Value, Bad Packaging
records.text: Product has been great for the price, however the recent switch from box packaging to bags has resulted in delivery services trying to stuff them into mailboxes and damaging the paper products inside in the process.

records.title: At the moment they are average. With potential to be a lot better.
records.text: At the moment they are a 3 star. Time will tell if they get better. I was told my subscription would have no issues ie shipping on time. As stated before I signed up. Due to other part companies not keeping to there word.  This company so far is following that trend. Now there Customer service  is good and the parts are very well made.  Now if they can keep the shipping schedule and not give excuses we will be golden.

records.title: Good value, but not enough folders for storage this time
records.text: The value is good and the product is good, but I was very disappointed to find that unlike the previous Warhammer Imperium subscription, I received only one folder for all of the magazine pages, which is definitely not enough. I expected to get at least enough folders to hold all but the assembly and painting guides (I believe Imperium came with 5). When I contacted support, I was told I could easily buy my own, but 2 ring binders are not commonly available... even through Amazon. This makes me unsure if I want to sign up to future subscriptions, like the upcoming Combat Patrol.

records.title: Is there customer service?
records.text: Still a decent product. Two issues, first some of the contents are now in the legends category and are no longer legal in competitive. Second the packaging is terrible. I have now received multiple broken products. Multiple models as well as paint brushes have been received damaged and unusable. I’ve tried getting a hold of customer service to get materials replaced and have had zero response.

records.title: didn't complete my address properly
records.text: didn't complete my address properly, so the parcel was never delivered. Replacement parcel only contained half my order, so they had to send a third parcel. I did get everything I ordered in the end, but these were unforced mistakes that delayed everything and took time and effort on my part to resolve.

records.title: Variety good - Edition change bad
records.text: It was nice to get a chance to get a variety of miniatures for army building and kit bashing.  The materials to teach how to play the game were really nice too.  Except that before the run had completed (and thus well before an army assembled) GW changed editions.  So what I had been ready to learn and play before is no longer relevant.  So nice minis for the money and look forward to assembling and painting them, but the rest of the selling point (how to play) is null now.

records.title: I subscribed to the U96 Submarine kit
records.text: I subscribed to the U96 Submarine kit. I received the initial kits 1thru 4 without any issues; however, my second shipment 5 thru 12 is delayed due to stock issues. Is this going to be a recurring issue? If the answer is yes, shouldn’t the company initiate a response to each subscriber? Would be great for Hachette to ensure stock age for all subscribers once enrolled.

records.title: Warhammer age of sigma stormbringer now pointless edition
records.text: hi I really enjoyed this magazine apart from the price rise which wasn't clearly stated when the magazine was issues the fact that all the rules are now outdated by the latest edition of Warhammer age of sigma and some of the miniatures appeared to serve no purpose just filler and an extra cost to the consumer

records.title: Good start. Poor finish.
records.text: Pros: Good quality books.Consistent deliveries.Cons: Increase collection size without advising customers (e.g. ordered 100 book series. When book 100 arrived so did 101 and 102. Was advised extension to 130 on query, 130 is due next month. Already 135 on website so will be cancelling. Increased price without advising customers, their invoices each money state they will give 10 days notice before any Increases, then next invoice is £3 more expensive without warning.

records.title: Solid product value – Terrible Binder Policy
records.text: I've loved the product value generally and think it is a worthwhile subscription for what you are getting. As long as you want the models provided, it generally is a good deal.That said, you only ever get one binder for your magazines, and given that these magazines are two hole punched and unusual size, finding appropriate sized binders for the magazines is near impossible in the U.S. This negates almost any value the magazines were supposed to bring since they can no longer be split and assembled in appropriate binders. Until they change the availability of acquiring multiple binders with U.S. subscriptions, I cannot rate the product any higher.

records.title: Service is ok but product is a bit of…
records.text: Service is ok but product is a bit of scam. No consolation for out of date edition. Binder you get can’t fit all the issues, barely half, and they have no remedy.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: Disappointed. Ordered 3 items but 1 was out of stock. They didn’t contact me to let me know and it was only after I called them 3 weeks later that they informed me that one of the items was out of stock and that had caused the order not to be dispatched. If I hadn’t of contacted them, I doubt they would have noticed3/5 though as when i DID call up the customer service girl was lovely and fixed the error quickly and gave me a range of options as to how to proceed with the item that was out of stockSo basically computer systems and checks and balances 0/10, Customer Service team 9/10 (would been 10/10 but it would have been nice to have been offered something as a gesture of goodwill as I was the one to chase up in the missing delivery)

records.title: The packaging is going down hill…….
records.text: The packaging is going down hill as the subscription continues. They started out delivering in boxes well protected. Now they arrive in pretty much Amazon bags with no prediction…….

records.title: I have ordered the Lancaster bomber…
records.text: I have ordered the Lancaster bomber stand 30 days in' and still no sign very disappointing. I have e-mailed but still awaiting a reply.

records.title: Communication could be better
records.text: I've received a notification that I've been charged for this shipment and a survey to ask about the experience but I haven't been provided a tracking number or received the item yet.  2 tips for a better review:1. Include tracking number on the invoice.2. Wait on the item to be delivered before sending the survey.

records.title: Fast, but random
records.text: I'm about 22 issues into the Stormbringer magazine, and while I appreciate how quickly my packages have arrived, it feels like this company just charges you whenever it feels like rather than monthly. If you subscribed on January 5th, for example, your next charge could be February 2nd, then March 1st, and before you know it, March 30th. There is no consistency in when you are charged, so make sure you always have the means to pay your subscription.

records.title: Lack of Binders
records.text: I did not like that I did not get enough binders for the age of sigmar to keep all my sheets on.

records.title: Combat patrol , wrong issues sent out.
records.text: Early into my PREMIUM subscription.  Was expecting issues 7-10 this month. Instead issues 11-14 were sent ‘so I’d at least have something’ their reply to my query said.The response as to if/when I’d get these expected issues was ambiguous yo say the least.When I replied that if they couldn’t supply the issues I was expecting issue, then I’d likely cancel my subscription and expect a full refund and return (at thier cost) all magazines and unused models and paints…..Received what seemed a stock reply , that they were out of stock , not answering my concerns at all.It’s a shame as I am enjoying the magazines and models so far .  Unsure what to do for the best now.

records.title: You got my address wrong.
records.text: You guys put down the wrong address on my package, and it went to my neighbour down the street, and I had to repeatedly go knocking trying to find when they're in so I could get it from them. Lucky that it wasn't an abandoned house, or that they weren't away on holiday for a week. I double checked the address I supplied, and it was correct when I gave it. Really stupid mistake to make that could have cost the package entirely, or been way more confusing if it weren't for Royal Mail providing a photo where I could make out you'd put a '3' instead of a '2' on my house number.

records.title: Turnaround time needs serious…
records.text: Turnaround time needs serious improvement And a bit over priced 12-10- 24 I just received my first stage of this build I've decided to change my rating to a 1star.For the simple reason NO ASSEMBLY INSTRUCTIONS came with this kit

records.title: Assy was difficult due to screws and…
records.text: Assy was difficult due to screws and parts not being compatible. Directions should be included with each set of parts instead of having to go online. The best option would be to provide a physical manual of assy. For the cost of the model, the customer should have been provided materials to make the assy. a smoother experience.

records.title: Reaching the halfway point and I feel the quality is suffering.
records.text: My subscription used to arrive in a box and protected.  There were some hiccups along the way, but overall, I was happy.  I still haven't received the mat from over 10 issues ago, but I am hopeful it will arrive.  Now that they started shipping the magazines and sprues in bags, my magazines arrive damaged and creased really bad and I have had two broken miniatures.  It was simply to fix them so I haven't raised the issue, but I just feel quality has been lacking recently.

records.title: Misleading Free model availability
records.text: They heavily marketed a free model with the subscription that they apparently are out of stock of and continue to include it in the marketing materials.  They also didn’t proactively tell me it was out of stock and I wouldn’t be receiving it.  I had to figure that out on my own when it wasn’t included with the prescribed shipment number.  Seeing your reply below, the feedback is update your website to honestly reflect the sold out status and don’t hide behind the weasel words of saying “while supplies last”.   You know your supplies are gone.   Be honest about it.

records.title: I have had the subscription for the…Disney crochet
records.text: I have had the subscription for the Disney crochet magazine. Too many errors in the instructions which gave me no incentive to make any extra things from it. Increased the price after around number 65 then added another set of magazines onto the end for something else so had to order some of those in order to get the last magazines and then post back.

records.title: The switch from boxes to bags = BAD
records.text: The switch from boxes to bags was a very poor choice. The first shipment in a bag was heavily damaged and trying to use the website for support did not work at all. In addition, when I finally got a replacement, it was not marked in any way as fragile, or that it should not be bent. As a result it was folded and stuff into a tiny mailbox. If I hadn't had salvageable parts from the first damaged shipment to combine with the second damaged (also shipped in a bag) shipment I would have needed another replacement.

records.title: Combat Patrol magazine is a shambles
records.text: Combat Patrol magazine subscription is a shambles. Signed up for the premium subscription mid-August (over £1000 commitment) and have yet to receive anything. Support told me it had been processed, didn't provide any sort of tracking, and told me I should contact Royal Mail (with no reference number!).There are people who have subscribed mid September that have received up to issue 6 which hasn't even been released yet!I've had very slow but reliable experience when buying ad-hoc and the tail end of the Stormbringer subscription but this has been the worst customer experience I've had in quite a while. If nothing turns up in the next couple of weeks I'll be cancelling my subscription.

records.title: Satisfied customer

records.title: Beware - almost impossible to cancel subscription
records.text: I signed up for the watercolor subscription and have no complaints for the quality of the products however there are some unusual penalties to cancel the subscription.   About 4 or 5 months in, I decided that this medium is not for me and I did not like it.  Under the assumption that like other subscriptions I could cancel with notice, I sent an email.  Got a form email back thanking me for making contact and I would get follow-up email from them within a short time.  No follow up emails.  I ended up sending 4 more cancellation request over the next 4 months with the same result.  As my emails became more insistent, I got a different form email asking if I’ve gotten the emails they were trying to send me for the cancelation.  Of course, I had not.   I sent another cancelation notice immediately after I was notified they had, yet again, charged me for another box.  I notified them in the email they could no longer charge me.  I then immediately notified the subscription payment servicer that I did not authorize any further payments.  Craftamo then attempted to charge me the next month.  Of course when the payment did not go through I finally got an email from a person that said that they would cancel my subscription for an additional fee since two upcoming boxes were left.  I have asked for the contract that allows the additional fee and if it’s in there, I will have no choice but to pay it.  I am making this review to let people know that if you sign up for a subscription, make sure you are committed to it because it appears almost impossible to cancel.  And it is definitely expensive to get art supplies you won’t use.  I paint with oils and acrylics and thought it would be interesting to try this but this is not a “try it” subscription service.

records.title: Beware Craftamo subscription services!
records.text: I chose a 6 month subscription of Sarah Burns paint boxes from Craftamo. The product was lovely - but expensive. Note: you actually choose either "6 month plan" or "12 month plan". Then after 6 months my credit card was charged for another 6 months. In contacting Craftamo, the company stated subscriptions automatically renew. Which means, choosing "6 month plan" on the ordering page, is actually 12 months whether you want the product or not for that long. The website is totally misleading; you have to drill down to find this out.  In contacting them the day the charge appeared on my card, they refused to credit me because I did not cancel "in time". Not only was I unaware of this automatic renewal (this factoid could have easily been placed on the main ordering page), no courtesy cancellation reminder was sent to warn you (think: Netflix, PBS, etc. who give you a 30 day reminder).  Please beware of this misleading offer!

records.title: ZERO customer service
records.text: Bought a set of brushes from this company one of which proved defective.  Despite contacting them with photographs they refused to either refund for the brush not fit for purpose or exchange the brush and simply kept repeating the same phrase about stringent tests on their products without accepting any responsibility. They also constantly infer that it is my fault and I did not clean the brushes quickly enough or left them to dry or cleaned them insufficiently which is quite totally wrong and defalamatory.  They wronglu state below I used purple which I did.not it was.blue which is obvious from the photo I sent and now I am being harassed on a daily basis which is very stressful despite previously saying in their reply to this review some of these brushes stained. Despite calling themselves Customer Service of Happiness they make zero attempt to be helpful at all.  Best avoided

records.title: AVOID
records.text: AVOID Great if your products are OK but if you order faulty goods your fobbed off. Purchased bamboo set, not cheap and the handles are bowed, ferrels have huge gaps. And 1 brush hairs all outta shape .. There customer advisor sent me utube instruction how to fix the shape and suggestion of plyers to pinch the ferrels. I asked to return for refund that was ignored. The ombudsman said under consumers rights I can return faulty and get a refund n this is a breach of those rights Shocking service

records.title: Avoid Subscription!
records.text: I bought an annual subscription to the Emma Lefebvre Watercolour box and paid $628 for the year, an extravagant birthday purchase but I was thinking that would be the entire cost (as with most annual subscriptions). However a month in, I received another bill for shipping and was told that shipping costs would be an additional charge each month and you never quite know how much this charge will be....so far it's gone from $13 to $16. This essentially brings the total cost to nearly $800 for the year. This for a set of brushes, paper, and a paint palette over the course of the year (4 paints each month). Not great value, in my opinion. The brush and paint quality is not to a good standard; the number 8 brush bristles started to split after one use. Not great customer service either---apparently they are not willing to allow me to cancel and receive a refund, even after I contacted within 5 days of receiving the first box and expressing my disappointment. Oh, and I loved the quote from the customer service rep when I asked them to provide the terms of service that explained the extra shipping costs--they told me "look at the website, it's not hard". I tried posting a review on their website, which they refused to publish. So I am going to go through my credit card company to file a dispute.

records.title: Avoid at all cost.
records.text: They claim to be ecofriendly even tho they wrap their brushes up to 3 times in plastic. I guess they received complaints because they took their ecofriendliness out of their Instagram bio. A few of my brushes fell apart within not even 5 minutes of using them. A 1€ brush for elementary school children had better quality than the ones that fell apart. So much for their quality checks. They don't reply to complaints unless you take it to social media. I had to make Instagram stories of their products to receive a reaction. I read from another person that her complaint ticket got closed without receiving any help so I feared that I will meet the same fate if I didn't post the story. Their ambassadors are basically their customer service since the actual customer service doesn't reply. They only accept 5 Star ratings on their own site and push their ambassadors to comment under posts of people who had negative experiences how great the products are. If they put as much effort in their service as they put in their marketing they would only get 5 star ratings. When the brushes work, they are fine. For my taste they absorb a bit too much water and don't give back the full amount of pigments. They stay in shape for a long time. The paint on the brushes wood chips quickly. I wrapped washi tape around it because it was uncomfortable. I wouldn't buy again because of my negative experience tho. They could be a good company if they put in the effort.

records.title: AVOID!!!
records.text: Unfortunately they use Hermes as a courier who lost my parcel, claiming it was delayed due to a “major incident.”From experience, I know this means they’ve lost it and spoke to Craftamo to ask that they either re-send the items I’d paid for using either a different courier or Royal Mail, or if that wasn’t acceptable to refund my money. They refused the refund, so I took to social media to see if speaking to someone there would be more successful. They then decided to block me on all forms of social media (and have since claimed I was abusive and said things that were not true, which is an outright lie on their part and utterly ridiculous), which feels extremely shady to me, considering I’m only asking for my money back for items I’ve not received and am not going to receive as they’ve been lost. I’d avoid this company like the plague. Their customer service is appallingly slow (they say they’ll respond within 24 hours and they literally mean it will take that long to send a generic response to you) and when they do finally respond it’s not even close to helpful and when you try reaching out elsewhere, they’ll block you. Avoid, avoid, avoid. I’d give zero stars if I could.(Update: November 4th, 2021: they finally agreed my items have been lost and are refunding me. I’m not amending my review, everything I said stands, especially after the tone taken with me in the last email from “Dan.”)

records.title: AVOID. Emma deserves better respect!
records.text: Being a "student" on YouTube of Emma, I was really looking forward to buying her new line of brushes from Craftamo.  I ordered, received, liked a great deal ... until ... the number 2 brush suddenly lost some hairs ... no big deal ... but, the hairs came from the tip of the brush, and the point is gone.  I wrote to Craftamo and explained.  They were crackerjack at sending adverts, but a complaint didn't seem worth worrying about to them.  I received an answer flippantly fobbing me off, saying "rare event, but brush 'still works'"!  It is not what I ordered, it does not work like it should bec no point!  I wrote again, and still no answer as I asked them to replace the nbr 2 brush, or failing that, send price and I will buy a new one.  No answer.  This is not a very good outfit.  Emma has made them a lot of money, and her followers are entitled to better treatment than that! I hope she finds a better company to promote her brushes.  They are great.  I do very small art and need that nbr 2 brush.  I cannot recommend this company.  Just bec I live in Australia, is no reason to treat it so offhandedly and dismissive.  Paid AUD $100 for these brushes.

description: The Empire Medals brand pays homage to our great military heroes past and present to whom we salute and remain ever proud to serve. The replica medal collections are manufactured in Birmingham’s famous Jewellery Quarter using methods and skills dating back to the very first medals ever to be struck in the United Kingdom. In addition to this we also retail engraving gifts, embroidered clothing plus much more.

records.title: Ordered a frame for Christmas
records.text: Ordered a frame for Christmas. Called them a week before as not arrived ( they are very busy). The person I spoke to was polite, helpful and courteous. My frame was here within 2 days and the recipient was overjoyed with it. Can't recommend this company enough. Fantastic!!

records.title: The item that I ordered arrived…
records.text: The item that I ordered arrived promptly and was exactly as described, it’s a good quality product.

records.title: From start to finish this company were…
records.text: From start to finish this company were very helpful - they even advised me that l had two medals missing, which they identified from the medal ribbon that l sent to them. Overall l am very pleased with the end result with the wall display that l purchased.

records.title: Medal received in time thanks to Eve…
records.text: Medal received in time thanks to Eve Renton , who answered all my queries swiftly & efficiently, thank you Eve & thank you empire for a wonderfully made medal .

records.title: Grateful for my Veteran Badge
records.text: Thank You for my Veteran badge received recently.It is most appreciated and I look forward to wearing it at my next Remembrance Day event.You are a most efficient and professional enterprise and I thank you for this service. Regards from a veteran 😎

records.title: The website is easy to navigate and the…
records.text: The website is easy to navigate and the ordering process easy to understand even for someone who has no knowledge of the different types of fixings. The craftsmanship and quality of the medals is extremely good. Very pleased with my purchase.

records.title: Great service as always
records.text: Used the company many times, never any problems, staff always helpful and communication great, used them this time to get a recently received relations medals mounted and engraved was nervous sending them away but was kept updated on the status of them, so happy with the job that's been done.Thanks Michael

records.title: Honoured in Bronze.
records.text: I ordered a full size engraved death medal in honour of my great-uncle who made the ultimate sacrifice in 1917 in France.The medal arrived safe and promptly along with a Kings scroll .. printed with Arthur Mottrams regiment and burial details. It's a beautiful replica and will soon be on display in a frame along with his medals etc... thank you so much.

records.title: Frames & Medals
records.text: I’ve used Empire to have my medals mounted previously and was an excellent job.  Just had some bespoke framing done by Corane, her work is first class and very professional and helpful, she clearly knows her stuff….. I would highly recommend this company

records.title: Order from Canada
records.text: The ordering process was extremely easy and straightforward to follow.  The order was received in a timely manner in Canada from the UK and was quite surprised on how quickly it arrived.  The medals & ribbon received were of extremely high quality which were to replace some of the lost medals from my father in law.  Now we have all of his medals which we will proudly display in a wall cabinet.  Thank you.

records.title: All well with this order but a little…
records.text: All well with this order but a little bit slow.Still have an with a previous order from a few years ago to be sorted out and corrected. But still a good service from the company.

records.title: They seem busy but are keen to keep customers satisfied
records.text: I read a lot of the negative reviews on this website and so I was really worried when my order did not turn up by the time I had expected it. However, after I contacted Empire Medals by email, Eve Renton (Marketing Director) said she would sort things out. She did and I received my order here in Japan today. The quality of the product is excellent and I am very happy! I think that they are just very busy with a lot of orders. By the way, I do not normally write reviews.

records.title: Empire medals had dispatched the medal…
records.text: Empire medals had dispatched the medal holder several days ago. It was received today, no fault of Empire Medals but Royal Mail. Royal Mail have increased the cost of postage yet take time to deliver. Understanding challenges of post covid times and staff shortages due to annual leave and sickness, contingency plans should be applied. The lady at Empire Medals very helpful and hope to receive my medal ribbon soon as there is a delay due to the Platinum Jubilee demand. I hope the ribbon arrives in time for my next event in London on 29th July this year. Thankyou for good customer service and highly recommend this Company.

records.title: Really pleased with the product
records.text: Really pleased with the product, quality mounting that looks great. One of the few companies doing swing mount for my grandads war medals. Disappointed with the 3 months it took to get them back.

records.title: Happy with quality of the work
records.text: It took longer to receive  the order for my medals to be swing mounted than I had anticipated, although the delay was due to Empire Medals relocating their premises. In fairness they did keep me advised by email when they realised there was a delay. I have no complaint about the quality of their work.

records.title: Good
records.text: I ordered some items, wich were send out shortly afterwards. When i received the package, it contained 2 items short and one wrong piece.I contacted the seller and the problem was solved by sending out a second package with the right and missing items, which i received a few days later. Good customer support.

records.title: Orders from Empire Medals
records.text: have used empire medals for a we while now and were of a good standard but on one order they sent a wrongly made medal ribbon bar using the wrong medal ribbon. they were able to send a replacement one including a returns envelope. the replacement one also had a wrong ribbon but the previous mistake was fixed. i then sent an email and said it was wrong and asked for a new one and they got it right the third time. looks good and professional. all the replacements were free.  but will continue to use them in the future.

records.title: The quality of the medal box was of good quality.
records.text: The quality of the medal box was impressive for the price and the engraving was detailed and finished off perfectly. The only slight downside was the length of time it took to arrive (4* rather than 5*); ordered on 14th April and arrived on 25th April. I realise this is not a significant length of time but unfortunately, I have been 'Amazoned' and therefore did expect it to arrive sooner than it did. I accept that I should perhaps be more critical of my unrealistic expectations rather than of Empire Medals so perhaps the fifth * should be awarded. In summary, the product ordered was well finished and of good quality and therefore I would definitely recommend Empire Medals to others.

records.title: You will get my package back
records.text: You will get my package back. My country Belgium asked for 25€ import rights for a medal ribbon of 5 pounds. Sorry this is ridiculous. Not your fault of course. Thanks anyway.

records.title: Items received just right
records.text: Items received just right . Alas a day late as was going to wear at Alrewas 35th Anniversary Falklands WAR . Packaging and items were just right . Hey ho waited 24 years already as original went walkabouts . Good standards regards to all .

records.title: Completing the set
records.text: Very pleased with my purchase but I wish the medal ribbons supplied were a bit longer.Can't fault the customer service and quality of the product. Communication was excellent and order was fulfilled and dispatched promptly.

records.title: Satisfied customer
records.text: Satisfied customer. After a hiccup with delivery dates this was sorted out to my satisfaction. Medals were exactly as required..thanks. Suggest order confirmations are answered with clear advice on delivery dates.

records.title: The service and finish was great if over time.
records.text: The service and finish was great, just don't give them anything that is needed at short notice. Apparently they are very busy people.

records.title: Great
records.text: Waited a few weeks for delivery from date of order, but worth it. The mounted medal from Empire Medals Ltd looks fantastic. A great replacement medal. Thank you.

records.title: Great quality medals
records.text: Great quality medals, let down a little by the delivery time but I appreciate that you are busy 👍

records.title: Great product, slow service
records.text: The medals and photo are beautifully framed but the turnaround time was longer than stated and I had to chase for delivery.

records.title: Medals are of good quality
records.text: Medals are of good quality. Delivery was reasonably quick, although I had to pay excess postage of £1.50. No major drama.

records.title: Quality product.
records.text: Product as advertised and good quality.Delivery time slow.Turnaround  time from order to dispatch needs to be faster.

records.title: Medals
records.text: I feel this is a bit premature as my dealings with this company is not complete but I did find their site friendly and easy to use

records.title: I only gave it 4 stars for 2 reasons…
records.text: I only gave it 4 stars for 2 reasons the length of time it took I was 3 months waiting on 3 medals to get swing mounted and engraved, plus the engraving which is very light and could do with gouging in a touch the engraving on the back of the 14-15 Star was small and too light. But taking all that into consideration the medals and the mounting are excellent I had to get in touch with Eve Renton the Head of Marketing to push these medals through as I planned to present them to my Grandson on his return from a 6 month tour of the Falklands on the 9th Sept so a big thank you to her.

records.title: Ordered a Ribbon medal bar in October
records.text: Ordered a Ribbon medal bar in October,  was hoping for delivery for Remembrance Sunday. I've emailed but no response,  apparently after looking at their website its a 6 week turnaround? Wish I'd known this, I would have tried elsewhere.

records.title: My own error which I’m annoyed with but…
records.text: My own error which I’m annoyed with but also as a company that engraves military medals a confirmation email before proceeding would of been beneficial as I thought I’d entered my rank correctly but unfortunately it wasn’t

records.title: Very fast service
records.text: Very fast service, can't complain about that. The medal is okayish, certainly not up to the standard of the original that has been missing for many years. I contacted them to complain about the ribbon that is frayed and coming apart and I got a reply from a call centre or something acknowledging my message. I was giving them a chance to make things right, but I've heard nothing since. All in all, I'd not order from them again, if I'd have the need.

records.title: missing items
records.text: Received world war 1 medals only to find the mid oak leaf missing from order, had an email stating medals were in quality control, then they were being dispatched.Someone didn't check the order correctly before being dispatched, and i now have had to post back recorded delivery and will have to wait yet again for them to be returned.. The actual medals are great just disappointed that order was wrong, would of given 5 stars

records.title: It took ages to get medal
records.text: It took ages to get medal. There was no communication at all and we didn't get medal when promised

records.title: 7 x Medals & Miniatures re-mounted
records.text: I took my miniature medals personally into Empire medals to have the Platinum miniature added (Empire medals supplied the platinum miniature) and have all 7 re-mounted. When I collected them they looked great until I put them on the counter and saw that they weren't level, but that was quickly resolved whilst I waited.  I decided that they did a good job and would trust them to add my platinum medal and remount them as well (7 full medals). On collection I was disappointed that the medals were also not level and had to wait again (30 mins) before after 2 attempts they managed to level the medals. They have good customer service but I was disappointed that when they were ready for collection they hadn't properly been checked. I'm just glad that I took them in personally rather than sending them through the post.

records.title: could do better
records.text: Did take some time - 31st Jan to the 10th March.When they did arrive the drop on them were not even (medals not in line) and looked very odd. Expected a quality service - phoned them up and they will re-mount and refund return postage but wish they had got it right first time!

records.title: Quite disappointed really
records.text: Quite disappointed really. Ordered medal frame for a date specific event several weeks hence, and understandably was informed by email that Covid disruption meant a turnaround/delivery timescale of around 28 days. When I chased the delivery date up after 26 days I was told delivery timescales  were 3 months. I would have expected better communication as this was a significant change. I cancelled my order and to be fair I received a refund immediately. I sourced an alternative elsewhere which is to be delivered in 6 days.

records.title: It took far too long to receive from…best not pleased
records.text: It took far too long to receive from ordering

records.title: Due to  you moving it took a bit longer …
records.text: Due to  you moving it took a bit longer  than I thought to get my order  .but you got back to my emails I sent in good order  so wasn't to  concerned .happy with my medals.

records.title: My experience with Empire Medals.
records.text: In October 2021 I sent my medals to Empire Medals to be court mounted and engraved and told them that I needed them back for Armistice Day. They were returned a few days before and were nicely mounted but when I saw the engraving I was appalled because the engraving looked like a child had scratched it on with a nail. I emailed them immediately and, to be fair, they acknowledged that it had failed their quality control but sent them out as I needed them for the day. There was no note or anything to say that what they had done and said they had forgotten to enclose a note to explain. They asked me to return them for correcting. Due to health reasons I was unable to send them back until January 2022 but had been in constant contact with the guy who was dealing with it and I informed him once I’d sent them. After that things went silent, no acknowledgment of receipt of my medals, no estimate on return date etc. I emailed the gentleman in question multiple times but never received a reply. After having my emails constantly ignored by him for so long I was getting annoyed so last month I emailed the company and made a complaint about the lack of communication and information. I got a reply back from a Ms Renton who apologised and said that it would get dealt with immediately, a few days later I received an email from the guy who had been dealing with my account promising to have my medals returned as soon as possible. Fast forward to 1st April 2022, still nothing. I emailed the company again and complained again, within 12 hours I received a reply from Ms Renton saying “I agree 100%. I can offer my apologies but no excuses. The service you have received has been appalling. Your medals will be returned to you tomorrow with the corrected engraving, you should receive them on Tuesday”.  I can say that I received my medals today as promised and, as a gesture of goodwill, she included a set of miniature medals and along with my full size medals which were mounted in a frame. All I can say is thank you very much to Ms Renton, without your help I think I’d still be waiting. Also for the goodwill gesture which is received with many thanks and appreciation. Due to my experience I have left 3 stars instead of the 1 star I was going to leave. If I could give stars for Ms Renton’s help then it would be 4/5 stars.I had not seen the previous reviews about Empire Medals.com before writing this and was surprised at the number of negative reviews.

records.title: Still awaiting my order
records.text: Cannot say as still awaiting my order

records.title: Two medals
records.text: Slight overlap of medals on mount.I could have done it to that standard.

records.title: WWI Medals
records.text: I am impressed with the quality of the medals, the ease of use for the website and speed of delivery. Unfortunately I am less then impressed with the finish quality of the ribbons. I requested the medals "Swing" style. The ribbons are not aligned along the bar evenly, making the medals hang at a slight angle and the pleats are also uneven. A shame as it taints an otherwise good service.

records.title: Took a while.
records.text: I took the opportunity to apply for the free veterans badge that was on offer about 3 or 4 months ago. When nothing came after a couple of weeks I just put it down to a scam of some sort but I hadn't parted with any cash so I wasn't bothered. I did get a couple of emails from Empire Medals saying there was a high demand but it was coming. Well it came in the post today so I'm happy. I like free stuff.

records.title: Very helpful but hopeless
records.text: Although my initial request seemed quite simple, it has proved too much for Empire Medals. It took two months for my order to come and it was not what I asked for. After several emails they sent me another and it was wrong again. I am sure that they are charming people but unfortunately they don't seem to be able to get my order correct.

records.title: Ordered a medal frame.
records.text: Initially communication by email was okay but had to chase up by phone. Waited about three weeks for the frame but was worth the wait, it was brilliant how they displayed my grandfather's medals. I initially asked for a red background but was done in black, a mistake made by not reading the order. I accepted black because I did not want to wait longer. Sadly follow up emails and response for another order/quote has been very poor! Prices appear comparative if not cheaper.

records.title: Not a totally easy experience, due maybe, to my inexperience of medals!
records.text: Empire Medals are experienced in what they do and I have to admit total lack of experience in purchasing miniature medals with a bar or a MiD oak leaf.  As a result I had difficulty understanding their 'jargon' and also I received two medals that were incomplete.   The end result was as I wished, for which I am grateful.

records.title: A Lot to be Desired
records.text: Firstly, there was a lack of info on the progress of the order I had to prompt them on this. The medals were sent to Australia without registered mail (Taking into consideration that people could see the contents - this is risky) The the clasp PIN was broken no doubt because of the flimsy packaging. They should have been placed in a suitable container with bubble rap. Remembering that mail is sorted to day "in all sorts of machines".In all a some what disappointing outcome!

records.title: Underwhelmed!
records.text: Medal arrived in good time. However, I have since discovered that I paid well over the odds and was disappointed to discover that I now have to get the thing mounted - on top of the already high price!!! Needless to say - I won't be using Empire Medals to get it mounted!! Shame. They could do so much better.

records.title: I’d be careful in choosing Empire…
records.text: I’d be careful in choosing Empire medals. I bought a single medal with engraving but the engraving was misspelt on checking the order I had spelt my own name correctly ! They said they would replace the medal but as I was sending in my medals to be mounted we agreed to keep the medal and mount it I ordered the mounting service months in advance of Remembrance Day but as per my telephone e conversation they agreed and I wrote on the letter accompanying my medals that they should be ready 31 October . This day came and went with no sign of my medals so I rang the company they hadn’t even started them !!!   They agreed to start them that day but said I was missing a medal ! Oh no they kept the medal that was a replacement ! After much searching for emails and being asked the name of the person I spoke to ( who remembers that months later ) they finally agreed to supply the medal and mounted it with the others . Eventually I received the medals on the very day I was leaving to go to the Cenotaph in London . In summary, I felt properly messed about and got the impression this was a shambolic company  . I had to prove what was agreed on the phone after they made a mistake then when we agreed to get the medals to me by 31 October ( sending them months in advance) and I reminded them in my letter , it didn’t happen . There are many medal mounting services out there this may or may not have been a one off occurrence for this company but I’d think twice before using them

records.title: Company under stress?
records.text: This company appears to be struggling a bit in recent months. Their website said there was a six-week turnaround for mounting medals, so I ordered a do-it-yourself mounting kit a couple of weeks ahead of November's Remembrance parade, and my payment was taken. I heard nothing for a week and a half, so I followed up, reminding them that I only wanted a do-it-yourself kit (brooch, loose lengths of ribbon and fixings), so no six-week mounting turnaround required from them. I received what I assumed was a generic email, reminding me of the six-week period for medal mounting and telling me that they were experiencing a heavy work load due to Remembrance and recent release of Coronation Medals, and asking me to refrain from following up on orders. Six weeks after placing the order, I had heard nothing more, so I emailed to cancel the order and ask for a refund. Two days later, most of my order arrived, missing one item, but including an printed invoice/despatch note showing the full order. As of 12 December I have had no further explanation.

records.title: This time around the service has been…
records.text: This time around the service has been disappointing. Ordered a replacement GSM in September paid by card and sat back to wait . End of Oct 24 I asked for an update only to be told they are very busy, not recruiting anymore staff and if I'm not happy they will cancel ,refund and I can go elsewhere also please will I stop chasing for update (1x email after 5weeks hardly pestering).  This is disappointing attitude off the company representative can only assume it's stress related as I would not expect this level of poor attitude from a company of this standing. Disappointing service this time around.

records.title: Shocking customer service
records.text: Shocking customer service, ordered on 14th April, 1 email with apologies blaming covid after few weeks saying it would be sent out shortly. Nothing heard or seen since, avoid at all costs. I have asked for a refund and will see how that goes.Have refunded, no apology or offer to send item anyway as they were so poor, so I would reiterate go for another company.They have now sent out item and refunded.

records.title: Long delays
records.text: Ordered 2 medals on 1 Jun, no work required (mounting or anything) just medals and ribbon after a week or so not heard anything and then on 14 Jun finally got a reply via Facebook and then email. Sent out but 4 days later still not recieved them. Understand its busy because of jubilee but I didnt need any work on them and didnt even order the jubilee medal. If I'd have known it was a company that couldn't keep up with demand I'd have ordered elsewhere. 3 weeks to put two medals in an envelope and send them is pretty poor.

records.title: I ordered my medal expecting 48hr…
records.text: I ordered my medal expecting 48hr service, but due to delay in order took abt 10 days missing my fathers 80th birthday. The order confirmation I received detailed my exact order. However on receipt it was engraved incorrectly. I contacted customer service via email and received automatic response. Had to send again several days later and finally got a response 2  weeks later, but no apology. Poor service indeed. I have sent it back and expect a full refund. Very disappointed.

records.title: Three weeks to deliver order?
records.text: If I had known it would take three weeks for my medals to be mounted I would not have used this company. I was expecting my medals to be returned within a week, figuring that this was a realistic timeframe. Only by reading the website's FAQs did I found out that a three to three and a half week turnaround was the norm. This information should absolutely be mentioned when the customer is considering their purchase.Separately, the company did not notify me that my medals had been received, and their telephone number does not work - it permanently goes to a voice mail box, which is full and cannot take any more messages. I also tried contacting them via the website's chat room feature, but again with no luck.I am not impressed and will not be using this company again.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: Took a long time to deliver then when it did arrive the order was incomplete. I have emailed asking for the medal ribbon, wait and see if/when it arrives.

records.title: Customer service needs to be more polite
records.text: Recently ordered jubilee medal ribbons. After waiting 8 weeks with not a single email saying why the delivery was taking longer than 28 days I emailed to ask if there was any update. I’m really hoping that the email I got back was an auto-reply and a human being hadn’t taken the time to write such a snotty reply which included the below:“In the meantime, we respectfully request that you refrain from chasing orders unless absolutely necessary as this is simply taking resources away from completing orders.”This was just rude. How is it unreasonable to question the complete lack of communication from this company when they have gone double their stated delivery time? Also, it assumes that my request wasn’t “absolutely necessary” and that the medal ribbons aren’t required for a formal event.The only reason I’ve given two stars and not one is because they did refund me promptly when I asked.

records.title: medal mounting

I ordered three medals to replace my damaged medals, expecting them to be of a similar quality and finish as the originals this being a MOD licensed company. The medals arrived in a reasonable time and well packaged. However all three medals where highly polished looking cheap and not the same finish as the original medals. The main complaint is the clasp for my gulf medal was not in any way the same as the companies picture( which I can only think was a picture of an original medal )or the original clasp, it made the whole medal mounting look cheap, and makes it so I can not display or wear them, since they do not look genuine. If I had known that the clasp was not as shown on the company's website I would not have placed an order.

description:
Welcome to The Knitting Network! With over 50,000 ‘Excellent’ rated reviews on Trustpilot, we’re proud to be the UK’s favourite online yarn store. We stock over 10,000 items, including knitting and crochet yarns from all your favourite brands, like Emu, King Cole and Sirdar. All orders placed by 5pm are despatched the same working day, and UK delivery is FREE when you spend £30 or more. Returns are FREE and all UK orders are sent via Royal Mail Tracked delivery. Our UK Customer Care team are on hand to help, 5 days a week, by phone, email or online chat. 
We're much more than great products and quick delivery. Subscribe to our emails for exclusive offers on yarn, free patterns, project inspiration, kits, colour packs and more! Everything we post goes out in our eco-friendly, recyclable packaging.
Discover Emu yarns at The Knitting Network! Established over 80 years ago, Emu's vibrant colours and outstanding quality have been appreciated by generations of knitters and crocheters. The Emu family includes 5-star rated Emu Classic DK, with 50 shades of soft, easy-care yarn, perfect for every project. There's also Emu Classic Chunky and Super Chunky, which have a mix of bright, pastel and neutral colours to choose from.

Although the pattern of the yarn makes the little sweater nice and still beautiful, I would have preferred the WOW effect that the brightness would have provide. I should have returned the yarn but I live in Québec, Canada and I thought it would be to much trouble. Anyway, at the end, it's still a very nice buy and I love buying from TKN.
