description: The Model Centre (TMC) is a family-run business centred around customer service. Our close-knit team includes railway modellers and dedicated railway enthusiasts, all of whom endeavour to provide you with the premium experience and expert standards that we are associated with today.

records.title: On time, Every time
records.text: All items are as described in the online advert.  The parcel was well packed and any loose items were further wedged with soft material.  For an overseas address, the items were delivered within a day or two of estimated delivery.  This is the latest of a number of purchases and all have been joyfully received.

records.title: A Great Company!!
records.text: I have ordered from this company before, they are one of the few places here in the United Kingdom where I can buy US models. I ordered the item on the 19th December and it arrived on the 20th, securely packaged and no damage found.

records.title: Good service and products and a great deal.
records.text: I ordered some model railway items when The Model Centre had a £10 off promotion.  These were all items I had been intending to buy for a while, so the extra discount was very welcome.  One of the items was subject to TMC's weathering process and this was carried out to their normal very high standards.  The products were all manufactured by Bachmann so these were also up to their normal high standards.  Overall, I'm very satisfied with the products and service provided by TMC.

records.title: Best I've found
records.text: They have more lines in stock and update availability quickly (even over Christmas, specifically TT gauge). Seem to be the cheapest retailer too, even online.Quick delivery, never needed any specific customer service.

records.title: Top Model Railway Shop
records.text: Fantastic shop to order from. Website is superb and easy to navigate. Delivery is super quick too with full tracking provided. Used this shop a few times now and never had any issues, online shopping as it should be.Highly recommended, 10/10….

records.title: Quick, easy and reliable.
records.text: I heard about an outstanding offer TMC were showing.  I looked, ordered and it arrived in less than two days.

records.title: Happy Customer
records.text: Very pleased with the cost of my purchase, delivery and very well packaged.  Would certainly use TMC again and again

records.title: Excellent staff help & a personal…
records.text: Excellent staff help & a personal service. Delivered in no time at all even a few days before Christmas. Robin Cook.

records.title: Superb company
records.text: Superb company , delivered Christmas Eve at very short notice . Well packed and will certainly use again .

records.title: Easy to use website buying process and…
records.text: Easy to use website buying process and delivered well packaged and on time. Pretty good pricing too.

records.title: Cheaper than most
records.text: Tmc as a grate web site for bargains and a Yorkshire man I love a bargain and in a lot of cases there cheaper  then a shop Sheffield

records.title: QC oversight but otherwise great service and support
records.text: The model was returned with a set of wheels out of alignment. Whilst I was able to rectify, it was a concern that the QC did not pick this up. I brought it to the company attention to follow-up for future with a positive response received. In most instances I have been extremely pleased with the support and follow-up

records.title: Took a little while to come but absolutely delighted with the product.
records.text: Took a little while to come, but I’m absolutely delighted with what I received. Communication was great too.

records.title: Good service but I got caught out &…
records.text: Good service but I got caught out & didn't realise there was the dread VAT to add to the price. Please include with price or make it clear.

records.title: When it goes wrong
records.text: Purchased a DCC Control Starter Set. Arrived quickly. On opening a control board found to have a piece missing. Phoned TMC who immediately arranged a return for the faulty item. All good service arranged by knowledgable staff. I await a replacement or repaired item with confidence.

records.title: The choice of products was good
records.text: The choice of products was good. Purchasing was easy, delivery quick and painless. All worked really well. TMC have some great products and I was really pleased to pick up a professionally weather wagon at a reasonably price. One minor drawback was that whilst I know I was buying pre-owned stock the description didn’t say it was missing a part (one of the eight upright pillars on a bogie bolster). It’s not a big deal but a little annoying.

records.title: Weathered Brakevan
records.text: Ordered a brakevan with added weathering. Model arrived within a couple of weeks, well packaged and undamaged. It looks great.

records.title: I did struggle to find the Monday Club…
records.text: I did struggle to find the Monday Club wagon and I don’t use PayPal apple wallet or google but I called the shop paid over the phone and the staff were really helpful and I paid over the phone the wagon arrived when it was meant to good service

records.title: International shipment from TMC
records.text: Overall good service. International shipping is not the fastest though it was quite easy to do. The model it self came in good condtion.

records.title: Great service well delivered package…
records.text: Great service well delivered package got to me in one piece with 0 damage would consider using again in the future as model railway parts here in Ireland are difficult to find unfortunately

records.title: Good service and high quality weathering what ever level you choose
records.text: The quality of the weathering. I have bought several items now which have been weathered to different levels and they have all been fantastic. Great job thank you.

records.title: One dimension postal options.
records.text: I always enjoy dealing with TMC however I find myself frustrated at the company's continued use of the rather expensive Royal Mail for sending my purchases to Australia.I have requested cheaper courier services before only to be denied this option.The now defunct Hattons used to offer several postal options with the costings for each at the time of purchase but this ideal system seems to be out of TMCs reach. I shall continue to shop with TMC but not as often as I would prefer due to limited postal options. Cheers from Oz.Gaz

records.title: First purchase
records.text: This was my first purchase from TMC. It was a reasonable wait for the weathering to be done but once posted, arrived in good time in perfect condition and is a fantastic addition to my layout.Thanks

records.title: First time buyer with TMC
records.text: I chose to go with TMC as the prices for the items i wanted were all very good and they had everything in stock. Delivery was very quick and all items in good condition.Only thing that stopped giving 5 stars was that some of the product descriptions were basic and the photos were small and low res. I ended up checking details in other websites before going back to TMC to order which wasn't ideal.

records.title: Excellent service from TMC but the…
records.text: Excellent service from TMC but the courier service poor

records.title: Great service
records.text: I’ve bought a few things from the Model Centre and always find them to be friendly, helpful and knowledgeable.Their shop is a joy to visit with a good range of models on display.The website is well laid out and easy to navigate, and the buying experience is always a good one. Prices are competitive and delivery is always quick. Great service

records.title: Service was good
records.text: Service was good, I thought everything was in stock, it was only when I received email indicating that everything would be posted together I realised 1 item was not in stock. The website says payment will only be taken when posting, but my payment was taken right away. However everything arrived and was well packaged.

records.title: Item delivered in good time as usual
records.text: Item delivered in good time as usual. However I was expecting it to be held for delivery with another pre-ordered item later in the year. This cost me £4 p&p. I suspect a minor slip up in communications between departments. I've had excellent service over the past few months for which I'm grateful.

records.title: Try not to bear a grudge.
records.text: I have no real complaint about TMC but I remember that, a few years ago, I was supplied with a weathered, sound fitted loco where the loco controller details had been omitted from the parcel. The quality of their work was otherwise excellent. I smarted for a long time after that! I have only good things to say about recent purchases.

records.title: The product (DCC Concepts Rolling Road)…
records.text: The product (DCC Concepts Rolling Road) is very good. It just took rather a long time to fulfil the order. Also, I felt rather bombarded with advertising which I didn't feel I could 'Unsubscribe' to whilst the order was still outstanding.

records.title: Sending to France
records.text: When sending items to france it would be nice if they were sent IOSS or have the duty collected at point of entry.  Not have the delivery person call at an ungodly hour for a check.

records.title: Address
records.text: Shipping time was overall pretty decent. However one major isssue was the fact that my apartment number was left out of the address despite me having it in my saved address.

records.title: Lovely models and order eventually…
records.text: Lovely models and order eventually sorted out after having received someone else's goods. Took several phone calls to resolve. Previously TMC have always been so good!

records.title: Long lead time for custom weathering
records.text: Very slow in delivering a custom weathered model, but the weathering job was good (ordered October 8, delivered November 29 - nearly 8 weeks). International shipping via Royal Mail was also slow - would prefer quicker options for international delivery (eg. DHL).

records.title: Bachmann Ref: 39-175G - Mk1 BG NDA
records.text: I feel that communication could have been a lot better, as my order was delayed by about 2 weeks, and I was deeply concerned that my order was not going to be fulfilled - I had to chase the order up myself to find out what was going on!

records.title: The model is
records.text: The model is, in places, poorly assembled, presumably by Rapido Train's manufacturer with particularly unsightly gaps where the steam pipes connect to the cylinders, and the joint where the chimney upper half locates. The whistles were askew and one was loose, needing careful re-fixing. The weathering by TMC is why I chose this particular model and is quite good overall but in a few places paint had scuffed off the body revealing the metal underneath, again easily fixed but shouldn't have needed to be. The smokebox was entirely matt black and the limescale staining on in the steam pipe area was clumsy, unsightly, and had got onto the buffer beam area. I have been able to address these issues myself but was disappointed that I felt it necessary.

records.title: Average value for money
records.text: I consider the weathering on the model to be just ok.Do not consider the extra money £40 for heavy weathering good value for the money.

records.title: It quite a a long time for delivery to…
records.text: It quite a a long time for delivery to be made and I found the model to be smaller than I thought it would be, difficult to see much detail

records.title: Great shop website might need work
records.text: The process of buying and receiving the order was completely faultless great service. However as of recently on my android phone the website UI is buggy at best with the search bar not working and being very hard to click on my basket. Everything else great though.

records.title: Work superb; delivery time appalling
records.text: The detailing on the loco was superb so no complaints there. I paid upfront with my credit card when they came into stock but it took four months to be delivered. It was purchased on behalf of a friend so I ended up with 4 months interest. Sadly, I'll really have to think hard before I place further orders.

records.title: No problems
records.text: Can't comment as I can't remember what was purchased and it didn't list it in the email.   Only completed this to stop reminders coming through.    Must all have been fine as I don't recall any problems.

records.title: The loco failed within 5 minutes due to…
records.text: The loco failed within 5 minutes due to loose gear on the motor. This is a common fault and often doesn't show straight away. Easy fix for me but not for some people. I suggest a longer period of testing is used for locos. Otherwise no problems.

records.title: TMC has a good service to supply model items.
records.text: TMC has a good service to supply model railway items, although I have reservations about the weathering service.  The basic weathering is not an attractive finish to steam locomotives, and I will probably not use it again.  I think it just ruins a perfectly good locomotive.  Its possible that the higher levels of weathering might be better, but its too expensive to use.

records.title: Both the locomotives had some form of…
records.text: Both the locomotives had some form of damage As they were in a sale I have accepted their conditionNot impressed however compared with previous orders I have had from TMC

records.title: The loco I purchased was faulty and and…
records.text: The loco I purchased was faulty and and a replacement was agreed and forwarded.  The score given represents  my disappointment and the replacement could have been quicker.  TMC were easy to contact and work with.

records.title: Shopping was great but there could be some improvement
records.text: The shopping experience was great, but the shipping process could be better. What I mean by this is offer more around the world shipping like DHL

records.title: Asked for Royal Mail but got DPD took…

records.title: Delivery is good..but the weathering…

records.title: Not great weathering that took one…
records.text: Not great weathering that took one month to achieve. Normally very good on other purchases so not a one star but 3.

records.text: Ordered 'coarse' ballast. That received could not have been finer !

records.title: TMC are getting very greedy now
records.text: TMC are getting very greedy now, wanting to be the Hattons champions but there are ripping of their customers!Weathered Presflo wagons, now on site at £36 each (£41 on ebay), I purchased 2 back in July 2024 for £25.00!What has changed since then, nothing apart from the  greedy retailers of which TMC seem to be the market leaders and the next Hatton wannabees.AND NOW TMC ARE LABELLING MY COMMENT AS DEFAMATORY< JOKE!!! 🤣🤣🤣🤣 GROW UP, LOOK AT YOUR POOR REVIEWS AND SUCK IT UP!!!Even Trustpilot can't decided whether my comments are defamatory, email at 23.32 it's fine the content is not defamatory.23.40 has been flagged for containing harmful or illegal content, absolute pathetic 🤣🤣🤣🤣

records.title: You sent me an invalid money off voucher
records.text: Last week I bought Heljan 47555 from you, when my loco arrived you enclosed a £10 off voucher on any purchase of £100 or more online, the voucher is valid for 1 week from the 25th November. Today the last day the voucher could be used I went to buy Bachmann 47435 for £138.00, I added the loco to the basket, I entered the voucher code into the box at checkout but it said this code is not valid. Why send me a money off voucher if at checkout it cannot be used, very disappointing and tomorrow the voucher will be out of date. Not a happy customer.

records.title: Poor communications & difficult to deal with
records.text: Wanted customisations including one that wasn't on their website (so couldn't be added to web order). Told by email they could do that. But when I asked them how to proceed and pay, silence.Tried again, when they announced a new customisation available for loco I'd ordered, and which they were still working on, and was told they hadn't got parts and had no idea when they get them.But apart from that, no updates as to where my loco was in the process, until I got the delivery advice.Then, when it did finally arrive, it was in the thinnest cardboard box any model shop has used for posting anything to me. So thin, that it had split, but thankfully the Royal Mail took care of it, and it arrived undamaged. Better packaging for expensive, delicate goods would be better.Weathering requested was competently done.  Maybe you have to pay the premium for Deluxe Weathering over Heavy Weathering to get something really impressive?One final thing that leaves a sour taste, is that I asked for crew to be fitted to my diesel. £15 for one figure feels a bit steep, given that it's the same price for fitting crew to a steam loco, which is surely two figures?  Maybe the extra cost for diesels it to reflect the time taken to open it up to fit them?  They could, however, make that clear, e.g. by saying how many are in the "crew."  And anyway, why the extra charge if they're already fitting a decoder/stayalive?  Just a bit of clarity would have cleared up that sour taste.Very unlikely that I'll use them again.

records.title: I used the trunk service an absolute…
records.text: I used the trunk service an absolute disaster. I asked for all items in the trunk to be sent 0n 29 October. The order was delivered on 30 October in two parcels . On unpacking although addressed to me one of the parcels which should have contained 9 yards of tt track actually had a kit for a destroyer the invoice with the kit  showed this should have been sent to someone else. This was returned to TMC on 1 November.  Furthermore opening the other parcel showed that one of the orders in my trunk had not been sent . On contacting TMC it was discovered that the missing order was still in the wharehouse. I eventually received this on 4 November.  The missing track is out of stock at TMC and the person it was inadvertently sent to has not returned it to TMC .  As it was urgently required  I have had to source this from another supplier at a higher price. Moreover I had to order 13 yards and not 9 13 yards being there minimum order . Furthermore

records.title: Poor dcc fitting.
records.text: Sorry to have given only 1 star.But I sent 2 engines to be dcc fitted.Took nearly a month and once recd, neither worked !Have had to be returned for rectification.On the plus side.the value weathering was very good.

records.title: Model arrived broken
records.text: Model arrived broken, sent back and is still wrong. Fitted incorrect parts, had to by own parts to get it fixed, They also were rude on the phone when I phoned, had to keep emailing to chase them so in the end bought replacement parts.

description: We're a Family Run Toy & Model Store based in Somerset, England! With over 8,000 awesome Toys & Models we're sure to have something you need in your life! We consider ourselves Specialists in Scalextric, Hornby Train Sets, Plastic Models and LEGO - but also carry the full range of many other renowned brands such as Sylvanian Families, Playmobil etc. This page pays testament to our fast and efficient service, with the odd mention of our competitive product and delivery prices. If you have any problems please do not hesitate to to contact at using the information on this page.

records.title: GREAT SERVICE AGAIN
records.text: GREAT SERVICE AGAIN. Super fast delivery for an order placed during the Xmas shutdown. Fabulous  company to deal with, either via the website, on the helpdesk or in person if you meet some of the Jadlam team at a model show.

records.title: A good  selection of Scalextric layouts
records.text: The selection of Scalextric layouts was useful and why we bought from Jadlam. I felt that Jadlam knew what they were doing. The only downsides are that you don’t get to choose the cars you want (as it happens ours were fine, but a choice would have been better), and you don’t get a custom sized and printed box with slots for the gear. Not the end of the world though. Would buy again.

records.title: Super fast service at a seriously busy…
records.text: Super fast service at a seriously busy time for Jadlam, for not the biggest of orders - wanted to try out a few of the new AKM Interactive paint pens.I happily thought the team would send them after the Christmas break, but no they arrived on the 23rd December having only ordered them  a couple of days before.You cannot ask for better than that. That is why I keep returning for more things!

records.title: Chopper bicycle scale model
records.text: Extremely quick delivery, well packaged, great product. Some very interesting and different products on website and am.looking forward to have a good browse and decide on my next purchase

records.title: Delighted with your service
records.text: I ordered my kit just before Christmas, it arrived a few days later. Well packaged, and the price was very competitive for this particular kit that I’d been looking for for some time.I’m delighted.

records.title: Good customer support when there was an issue
records.text: Due to no fault of Jadlam, a new, sealed kit which had been well packed arrived with multiple broken parts (Revell packing sprues too tightly into too small and flimsy a box?).  This was sorted out efficiently and fully by Jadlam customer support, at a busy time of year.  It is when things don't go right that you find out whether a supplier really has good customer support - Jadlam passed this test.

records.title: Great service and value
records.text: Great service and value - will always choose Jadlam first when I thinking of getting a new kit or accessory.

records.title: Quick Service
records.text: Quick Service.  Ordered my Scalextric borders just before Christmas and they got delivered on Mon 30 December, which given the Christmas holidays was both unexpected and most welcome.  Many thanks.

records.title: Great service again from Jadlam.
records.text: Aware of a product that came back in stock by an e-mail and ordered straight away. Received within 2 days of ordering and with free delivery. Jadlam becoming one of my favourite online stores and my go to for my modelling shopping.

records.title: JADLAM experience
records.text: I have used JADLAM for a couple of years now and have never been disappointed with there service great people great experience all round .

records.title: First kit went missing in the post…
records.text: First kit went missing in the post (Royal Mail's fault). Jadlam sent a replacement but the package had been opened? This kit looks ok, but a bit worrying that someone is tampering with their post!

records.title: Excellent price
records.text: Excellent price , excellent service, would have been 5 stars but one of the boxes damaged, I had taken one out of box and repackaged for friend, he loved the car and was not bothered. Excellent

records.title: Missing item but resolved quickly
records.text: Great prices, free delivery and had every item I needed in stock. Would normally give 5 stars but on this order one item was missing from the order. However, an email to Jadlam was actioned by return and missing item to be sent. Will always use again.

records.title: Excellent service product very good…
records.text: Excellent service product very good value well packaged and delivered on time

records.title: All ok and the book got delivered BUT…
records.text: All ok and the book got delivered BUT please put books in card packaging and not a soft envelope. Small damage at corners, ok but should arrive pristine. Kits I have had ok, but this was the first book and disappointed with the packaging.

records.title: Received my order very quickly despite…
records.text: Received my order very quickly despite being a very busy time of year. Dissapointingly only half my order arrived but I had received an email apology from the company explaining thecreason for this and a few days later the refund was credited to my account. The level of communication has been excellent and I would definetely order from them again.

records.title: I love Jadlam
records.text: I love Jadlam. I love their store in Glastonbury and I love their staff. Courteous, helpful and seem to enjoy what they do. SO why not a 5 star review? Their website leaves a lot to be desired. I've been purchasing a lot of paints and accessories and whenever I place an order online, all the items are in stock, when the order is delivered one or two are always unavailable and a refund has to be made. Annoying as, its usually, one of the colours that I need to progress my model. As well as the stock level discrepancy the website is so slow once there are 10 or 20 items in the basket. Needs a refresh. Other than that - I love Jadlam!

records.title: The ease of ordering and thespeedy…
records.text: The ease of ordering and thespeedy delivery were excellent! However lcannot comment on the quality of the kit l order as it is a gift for my grandson for Christmas and he has yet to construct it!

records.title: Slight hiccup with delivery
records.text: Don’t know what happened but delivery was not as fast as normal.placed this order on same day as another,both despatched on same day one with tracking number the other without?but only one order arrived,chased the rolls which did  arrive three days later.On day of their response to me.But these things happen , that’s life and It has not stopped me using them as a great company to deal with.

records.title: Extremely good as always on time and…
records.text: Extremely good as always on time and always very good price

records.title: Great outcome
records.text: Great outcome, problem with stock but all sorted out quickly.Great service as usual.Thank you

records.title: Scalextric BMW. …
records.text: Scalextric BMW received was as shown and described by Jadlam. Order dealt with promptly and delivered to timescale by R M. Order placed was as a result of receiving Jadlam email "Hot Scalextric Car Offers". Price charged was different to that advertised. However, Jadlam subsequently refunded the difference.

records.title: Perhaps I'm expecting too much
records.text: Perhaps I'm expecting too much, but it doesn't matter whether you go for free delivery or pay for the next day Royal Mail delivery. Either way, it's generally 48 hours until the item leaves the retailer. Yes, it arrives 24 hours after leaving Jadlam. You can't fault Royal Mail. Why, though, does it take Jadlam 48 hours to get your item out of the door? Most retailers when you pay for next day delivery will do their utmost to get shipped that day. Other than the shipping issue Jadlam are excellent.

records.title: Always great service
records.text: Always great service. Last order was wrongly packaged ,but replacement sent free and fast. As always a pleasure to do business with.

records.title: Good Service and Keen Prices ... But ...
records.text: Although Jadlam offer keen prices, I've noticed they have an annoying habit of declaring items 'In Stock' which turn out to be on 'Pre-Order'. This is what happened to my latest purchase; they sent an email to say the item was back in stock, which I responded to straight away. It then became obvious that the item was Pre-Order only, which resulted in a three month wait for this 'in-stock' item to arrive.

records.title: Slight error from an otherwise faultless company
records.text: 3 models ordered, 1 was the wrong model and had to return the kit in return the replacement should be set out.  Second class postage was sent via email to return the parcel rather than 1st, so already another delay in getting what I ordered swapped, but two days after returning the model, nothing heard about the status of the swap out.Have ordered previously from Jadlam without an issue, but as this was an error on there part, 1st class post to cover the mistake rather than 2nd class would have been appreciated.

records.title: Corrected original delivery where Royal…
records.text: Corrected original delivery where Royal Mail had “lost”contents promptly with 4items replaced. I would not hesitate to order from JADLAM again

records.title: Package arrived in VG condition
records.text: Package arrived later than expected, but do understand it was probably delayed due to volume of sales with Black Friday and double points offers.  Items well protected, and package arrived in VG condition.

records.title: Jadlam dealt promptly but carrier slow
records.text: Jadlam dealt promptly with an order made on Friday such that it was with their carrier, Royal Mail, on Saturday.  Royal Mail indicated they expected to deliver Monday morning but sat on the order and delivered Wednesday.

records.title: Great deal, shame about the packaging.
records.text: Goid website.  Good price.  Swift delivery.  Unfortunately, the Stuart box arrived with the top crushed in and the Westland Wasp box had been pushed into it, breaking its corners. Not enough cardboard packing-about the worst packaging I’ve seen from a model shop.

records.title: Christmas delivery times
records.text: It would have been helpful if the website had made clear that because of Christmas the 1-2 working day rule would not apply (I was hoping for delivery on 24/12).

records.title: Decal sheet packaging
records.text: The decal sheet arrived in a timely fashion, the price was fair, however I deducted 2 stars for poor packaging, isted of just folding that has caused some creasing it would be better to roll into a tube and put into a cardboard tube thus making a safer method for postage. Richard  North

records.title: Issue but resolved
records.text: Order included 0.5mm brass rod, 30.5cm lengths. The rods were bent to fit a box that had only 27cm diagonal measurement. The rods stayed bent after removal from the box. Contact with Jadlam resolved the issue. New, straight rods being supplied. Matt and Joe very helpful but packer needs better training to learn that brass does not bend and rebound and appropriate packaging needed.

records.title: Major account menu issues
records.text: There is a good range kits, and payment/packaging also fine. The website has major problems with regard to managing my account. Using primarily my 8" tablet in landscape ( probably other devices too) it is impossible to see if I am logged in! The person icon, top right, gives no indication of who, if anyone, is logged in. Clicking on it from an already open tab logs me out. There is code for an account menu page (can't remember its tag) which may appear on a Windows desktop, but on my goto device. Your responsive design site is not, and needs work.

records.title: Easy to order.
records.text: Easy to order.A good price, well packed and arrived on time.If it ain`t broke, don`t fix it.Keep up the good work.God bless you.

records.title: Boxes all broke and cemented all together as bottle of cement everywhere!
records.text: Boxes all broke. One box fully open and pieces missing!!!! Absolutely devastated ordered two weeks ago and just arrived today! Gutted as I order all the time but this time really really un happy! Also a bottle of the cement all over the package! Now having to buy all again as there for my son for Christmas! Poor poor service

records.title: Could do better!
records.text: Well I am sorry to say I was so disappointed whan I opened the parcel to find a plain brown cardboard box, with the lamp inside in pieces that had to be put together, it didn't say that in the description on your website. Also the directions to put it together, were on a tiny piece of paper, and very limited. I had bought this lamp as a Christmas present for my 79 year old brother who loves making models but has poor eyesight. I am worried about giving it to him as it doesn't even look as if I had given it much thought. If it had been in a nice box, perhaps advertising your company, and with full instructions it would have looked so much better.

records.title: Poor packaging
records.text: All very good except the flimsy cardboard wrap and poly bag the model kit was shipped in which inevitably failed to prevent some damage to the kit box.  Disappointed as this was my 1st on line order and likely to be my last solely due to poor packaging.

records.title: Needs better packing for an international journey.
records.text: Parcel arrived with a big gash in the side.  Not a lot of interior packing and no bubble wrap at all.  Luckily Hornby know how to package a wagon properly so it was not damaged.  Please add more packing for future shipments.

records.title: I ordered and I got reasonable time…
records.text: I ordered and I got reasonable time just as I expected.

records.title: Inadequate Packaging
records.text: Packaging of item was woefully inadequate. Model box had several large dents in it. Fortunately nothing appeared damaged inside the box itself.Unfortunately I won't be purchasing any further models from you as it's not worth the risk.

records.title: Dispatched, but not dispatched
records.text: Sadly, after dealing with an amazing company, it took them one day after the product had been shipped to let me know that I wasn’t getting one of the items that according to the shipping list had been dispatched the previous day.  Whilst I was informed, for this reason I am unable to give my usual 5 stars.

records.title: Jadlam Good, Packaging Poor
records.text: Jadlam is a company to deal with, their prices are very competitive, the thing that let's them down is the packaging of the Internet orders.I have just received a model kit from them, and it was just put in a polythene posting bag, with no additional protection for the kit box.These models are not cheap, and poor packaging can cause damage to the item. This time I was lucky, the only damage was to the box.

records.title: Great range of products shame about lots being out of stock
records.text: Great range of products, only problem is lots of the products are out of stock, otherwise I would have given 100%

records.title: Paint Issue
records.text: Not suggesting this is Jadlam's fault but I ordered paint from them and 8 days later I still have not received the ordered items.

records.title: Website a nightmare.
records.text: The range of models OK, delivery reasonable, but the website makes managing my a/c a nightmare. Using my 8" tablet I can't access the menu that covers my activities etc., If I go to my basket for a purchase, I can't even navigate anywhere to find my order history, and so on. The list of issues goes on........... A seriously bad experience trying to deal with you.

records.title: Missing items from order.
records.text: Ordered a kit and some paints - paints arrived (minus one) in a very small packet but clearly no kit The shipping email (and account details) suggested the full order had been shipped - although the enclosed invoice annotated the missing items "LM" (?). Waited a week but no further comms or missing items. So raised a query and the missing items were sent promptly with apology. A lesson here maybe for me to place separate orders for multiple items.

records.title: High quality but very slow dispatch
records.text: High quality branded items at fair prices.   Arrived very well packaged.   Jadlam's loyalty scheme is generous.  However I placed the order on 14th September and it was only passed to Royal Mail on 20th September.   In 2024 this is not acceptable.   I don't pay for express delivery - why should I?   But in my view 2 working days is the maximum acceptable time between payment and dispatch.   Very disappointing customer service - and no explanation for the delay.

records.title: Okay but could do better.
records.text: One item was stated to be in stock but wasn’t, so had to be refunded a week later.  Despatch took longer than we are used to these days, then Jadlam unfortunately trusted Royal Mail with delivery.  Royal Mail ignored our delivery instructions again and left our parcel out in the rain instead of leaving it where we asked…

records.title: Factory seal broken …
records.text: Received Spektrum battery which had been opened and factory seal broken … complaint handled well by Hannah and currently awaiting replacement so hopefully that’ll be correct (ie new!) but have lost over a week

records.title: Overly thorough packaging
records.text: The product was dcelivered promptly. but was packaged with thick corrugated cardboard wrapped arounf the box. i think this was an attempt to keep the box safe. But it was wrapped too tightly and has actually squashed the box, creasing the end flaps. While I apreciate this was an attempt to keep the box free from damage while in transit, it has not been wholly successful. I have not opened the box as it is intended as a gift. I hope the contents are not damaged. I will follow up in more detail if that is the case.

records.title: Lack of proactive customer relations, slow to dispatch
records.text: Made an order for 5 items on 3rd of the month,  no contact or dispatch notification until chased on 10th of the month Order dispatched, arriving on 13th missing one item shown as to follow on the invoice but also then receive and email refunding me for the item. Lack of proactive customer relations, slow to dispatch. If I had known items were out of stock I could have gone elsewhere and saved money on delivery overall.

records.title: You sent the wrong items in the order.
records.text: You sent yhe wrong items in the order.An item I've ordered was not delivered. The courier failed to deliver and miss two deadline days raising me to wait in and waste 3 days un total.Boxes were bashed up although inside parts are fine.You have failed to complete the correct order.You have completed the order yet.It remains incomplete.

records.title: Great shop, POOR customer service
records.text: I use this shop often and am usually very impressed but the customer service side is very poor. Numerous emails were ignored, then phone calls not being answered but after a few days of trying to make contact they did sort out my issue.

records.title: Goods arrived as advertised and…
records.text: Goods arrived as advertised and quickly. However the ply was damaged quite badly in transit.

records.title: I ordered a Dambuster Lancaster and it…
records.text: I ordered a Dambuster Lancaster and it arrived quickly.Sadly the box is covered in dents and I cannot use it as a gift as intended.The cardboard sleeve and plastic outer packaging does not offer much protection.

records.title: HAD WANTED I WANTED BUY SOMETHING BUT…
records.text: HAD WANTED I WANTED BUY SOMETHING BUT NOT BUYING. Why? payment system is hopeless. I don't have a mobile nor a paypal account. So can't pay, only too happy to have paid. SO SAD. THEN NO RESPONSE TO PHONE1

records.title: Hit and miss ordering
records.text: Put order in and received an email saying an item that was listed was actually not available, would be refunded eventually. Bought the same item from them off eBay at a higher price

records.title: Nice kit shame about the box state
records.text: Don't know where or when but the kit boxes where roughed up some.  No damage to pieces or any other kit items. There is a musty smell also perhaps indicating long storageBut good looking kits and great price.Shame about box state otherwise would be a much higher review.

records.title: A lack of communication
records.text: A lack of communication, No confirmation e-mail. No reply to my e- mail asking for a date of delivery. The parcel arrived on Saturday 31 August, One week after my order was placed, Even allowing for the Bank Holiday Monday. You normally perform much better than this.

description: Modelsport are the UKs largest online stockists of R/C Model Cars by all the major manufacturers including Tamiya, HPI, Traxxas, Axial, FTX, Arrma and many many more.

records.title: Excellent service
records.text: Excellent service. Cannot speak highly enough. If you want your items delivered fast then choose modelsport. I have used a few different shops multiple times and hands down, the quickest to deliver is Modelsport. Very competitive pricing . Not necessarily the cheapest on everything but certainly very competitive and in line with the competition. Would certainly shop here again and again.

records.title: Simply the best RC store in the UK
records.text: When I want RC cars or accessories theres only one place I go, Modelsport, why? Trust worthy, fast delivery, I live here in Northern Ireland Uk and my last order was very impressive, close to Christmas and living in Northern Ireland and the brilliant lads in Modelsport had my order sorted and in the post fast, reaching me in time for Christmas, Brillant company that sets the example! Well done Modelsport

records.title: Great remote control car
records.text: Great remote control car, works very well. My husband was very happy with this on Christmas morning. Minimal effort required for putting together and was great fun to use. Delivery was super quick too, so would definitely order from you again.

records.title: Fantastic service
records.text: Fantastic service, fast delivery.I was let down by my local model shop so I decided to order from Model sport. I placed my order the Friday before Christmas with the idea my order would arrive after Christmas. My order arrived on the Saturday. A little over 24hrs from when I ordered. Amazing.

records.title: Faultless service.
records.text: Shipped my items incredibly quickly a few days before Christmas. Received 2 days later even using the free delivery option. Can’t fault Modelsport.

records.title: I made my original purchase from…
records.text: I made my original purchase from another online shop.For multiple reasons I canceled my order and then found modelsport on Google.I purchased a car that arrived within 24 hours.I've since purchased additional battery. These are the people I shall now use for all of my rc related items.Thankyou

records.title: Bought my first RC car from Modelsport
records.text: Bought my first RC car from Modelsport. It unfortunately came with a dead ESC unit however customer service were quick to respond and send out a new part. Would highly recommend these guys for any RC purchase.

records.title: Brilliant team
records.text: Brilliant service, really quick delivery and a great price for the item.I bought one of the small Tamiya kits which I didn't know you could get outside Japan currently. Item arrived next day in perfect condition.

records.title: Excellent customer service
records.text: I ordered vouchers online which were received within a couple of days. They were a good quality/design which does make a difference.

records.title: Emporium of FUN!
records.text: I've bought RC cars, spares, paints etc from modelsport for several years. I keep coming back, because the service is excellent. The prices are competitive, and the accessory bundles give you good quality equipment needed to get going. The range of models, spares and accessories is huge, so you can more than likely get whatever you want. Just bought a HPI savage x flux and Tamiya bbx, but in the words of some actor, "I'll be back". ,😁👍🤝🤘😁

records.title: Overall good service
records.text: Overall good service, the tool kit had a slight crack in the case, a bit disappointing.

records.title: Well packaged lots of stock always…
records.text: Well packaged lots of stock always despatched in time.

records.title: Thanks for apologising.
records.text: Thanks for reply, apology accepted. There ARE issues though with DPD, leaving parcels unattended on door step in full view for this four hundred pound purchase. No option on their app to "leave it in the grey shed".... I would prefer, but instead, it must be left with a neighbour I don't know. DPD also boast on their page that any item cannot be left safe...WOW!! Imagine leaving a 1.7k order on my doorstep!! That's their version of a delivery. Quite a few issues I think.

records.title: Modelsport remains great
records.text: Modelsport remains great, and good value in the market.  I rang up for a chat about my recent order to modify it a little and they were most accommodating.  Sometimes its best to be clear on stock available from supplier vs unavailable (long lead) to make sure you get what you need when you need it.

records.title: Very quickly dispatched
records.text: Very quickly dispatched, reasonably well packaged although one of the body shells I ordered was badly dented and cracked (probably in transit but impossible to tell. Also the fixing screws from that shell were missing, might have been from supplier so not holding that against seller, just an annoyance. Will use again and hope for the perfect experience.

records.title: Great service and very knowledgeable
records.text: Great service and very knowledgeable. Would definitely recommend them and use again. Would have given 5 stars on the overall experience however wasn’t pleased with the service from their courier DPD who simply left the parcel in broad daylight on the door step when nobody was home.

records.title: All round great service
records.text: All round great service could only supply me with one or two items that I ordered, but it was addressed and rectified.Pleasant people, great communication.Thank you

records.title: Great website with good stock
records.text: Great website with good stock. Postage is expensive compared to other sites selling similar products. The spend £100 to get free postage doesn’t work!!! It takes it off your basket but as soon as you click checkout it gets added back on again with no way of changing it!!!And I can’t see why you continue to use Royal Mail when you know full well they are striking!! There are plenty of other services on offer that are cheaper.

records.title: Good service and good prices
records.text: Good service and good prices Fast delivery very happy Lost a star for standard delivery cost which is to high for tiny items that go in a envelope So I usually try and bulk order Would order more with better price structure

records.title: I bought "HPI Bullet MT 3.0 RTR 2016"…
records.text: I bought "HPI Bullet MT 3.0 RTR 2016" from model sports. their service was excellent, apart from UPS's sluggish  delivery. I have to stay at home for complete two days before my model was actually delivered to me. I would like if model sport review its contract with UPS

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service, Great delivery times, Great prices.Just a petty delivery charges are being added to goods £90+ u'd expect that to be free but U can't have it all now day's so they still get a massive thumbs up in my book

records.title: Accountsnstuff.
records.text: Your website is good, your response and delivery time is good.  From past experience, I know your knowledge and helpfulness are good.  The one unfortunate is that, since I tried and failed to create an account, to continue with my purchase, I had to order through Amazon, rather than directly.  It would be helpful if you ditched the account bit 'cause some of us just want to buy stuff and sometimes, pick your brains.  All said, though, a great product and quick service - thanks.

records.title: I've used Modelsport a few times and…
records.text: I've used Modelsport a few times and they always dispatch products in time.  if something isn't available they let you know and potential lead times so always aware of the progress of your order.I only rate 4 as I have never had F2F customer experience with them but as an online retailer they are good!

records.title: Recently pre ordered an FMS K5 Blazer…
records.text: Recently pre ordered an FMS K5 Blazer from Modelsport. Sadly yhe delivery date kept changing which I appreciate may not have been their fault, but by the time it arrived, there were other sellers offering the same product cheaper. However, the truck arrived in perfect condition and I've been very happy with it indeed. I still rate Modelsport as a go to seller and happy with their customer contact response to my emails. Thanks Guys 👍🙂

records.title: Modelsport already has a wonderful web…
records.text: Modelsport already has a wonderful web site. Set out really well with lots of choice. This gives the buyer a fair chance of obtaining different opportunities for products. I am a Systems Analyst as well as a Researcher this choice of ( Trustpilot ) is not always the best way to go. Results come from real people with their experiences. Also delivery's from a good company, ( DPD did a wonderful job ) and I rate them highly. I gave both parties good reviews. I always fill in requests for feedback and tell the truth.

records.title: I ordered a truck for my grandson and…
records.text: I ordered a truck for my grandson and it said ‘ready to go’. But it wasn’t as I needed to buy a ‘power pack’ costing another £70 plus. This was not highlighted very well in the truck details. There were various options, again I didn’t notice them, which included the power pack and truck for a special inclusive price. But if the end result means I have a happy grandson on Christmas Day then it was worth the hassle.

records.title: Went the on a Saturday!
records.text: Went to there shop to get new parts for my TRx-4 they went above and beyond letting my bring my mountain bike inside while I was there so it didn’t get stolenI got new bumpers and a bumper mount they let me have a look at them first which is what I like not only that but the parts were of high build quality and as the products description described Awsome place!!!

records.title: 2 Absima cars
records.text: Bought 2 absima cars for the kids. Delivered fast great, cars are excellent.Knocked a points of because even through the cars were the same model, different controllers arrived one has a throttle trim and one doesn't? Also one of the batteries looks like it's been wrapped poorly compared to the other so the compartment cover bulges out which stresses the screw and has a gap which i worry allows water in. Kids love them though

records.title: Recent order
records.text: Excellent service from model sport only let down by courier who made no attempt to deliver parcel on two occasions. Otherwise would have been 5 stars

records.title: good stock,
records.text: site is well stocked, checkout isn't the clearest so make sure you click all the right dots before you check out, if your willing to pay vat separately then can be found cheaper

records.title: car looks good but the battery that…
records.text: car looks good but the battery that came with it 1800 is rubbish so got a bigger battery 5000 and it lasted 10 mins

records.title: I found it very hard to order this time…
records.text: I found it very hard to order this time one thing went wrong sorted that then something else went wrong very long time to sort it out. I rang up about my order I wanted to order over the phone which I have done before but was told you don't do it, the person seemed quite abrupt I felt he really did not want to help so it took some time but finally got the order done but was pleased at how quickly it was delivered.II know I only  once or twice a year but are big orders to tell you the truth I'm dreading ordering next time

records.title: Great shop but poor delivery
records.text: Great shop, but new delivery company is a pain (DX Courier). Have to be in to accept and can’t leave instructions to be used for every delivery. Only option is to wait for failed delivery and then you can reorganise. Not as good as DPD that they used to use.

records.title: The courier let them down
records.text: Great company I use them regularly got no problem with them. But the courier they use are not good the box came through battered and one corner was sliced open. Nothing was missing thankfully but boxes inside were damaged which disappointed me.

records.title: Fast delivery
records.text: Fast delivery. Free next day on £100 + orders. My experience was somewhat short line on two orders Maverick Quantum flux was terrible so tried Maverick Phantom and snaped it into two on second battery cycle. records.title: These are tribute coins, not issued by Royal Mint
records.text: I won't go as far as saying they're deceptive, but they should certainly make clearer that many/most of the sovereigns they offer are not issued by the Royal Mint, and are therefore not even legal tender (as Royal Mint sovereigns technically are). The coins are simply what are known as "tribute coins". However, for the prices they charge one could be forgiven for thinking they are "legitimate" coins. Buy tribute coins if one must, but be clear that they are not official British coins of any description, and I can't imagine any serious coin collector being remotely interested in them.

description:

Uk Carp Tech was the very first carp competition page to hit the scene back in 2019 and was created with one idea in mind and that was to give carp anglers like yourself the chance to win as much fishing gear as possible for the fraction of the retail value!. description: We provide deer and wildlife management services, We Train and Equip Deer Stalkers with industry recognised courses delivered by experienced, qualified and accredited Instructors and we also offer tried and tested equipment though our online shop!

records.title: Becoming an Ethical Meat Eater
records.text: Wanting to take more responsibility for my meat consumption and get closer to nature in general by getting into deer hunting had been on my radar for many years, but I didn't know where to start. After meeting Ben at the Gone Wild festival I knew immediately that I had found my guy. Stepping into the world of Deer Stalking, thanks to Ben, has been a positively life-changing experience.Having gone on a few guided stalks and now attended the Deer Stalking Level 1 Certification course, this is now firmly a part of my life. I don't think there is anything Ben doesn't know about these beautiful creatures, and his professionalism and conscientiousness in what he does are 5-star.

records.title: Excellent Customer Service
records.text: I purchased a torch from fenixtorch 9 years ago. Last week it stopped working after use on 12 hour shifts 4 times a week. I contacted customer support at fenixtorch to ask if they do repairs/if there would be any warranty. I received an email within an hour or two with instructions on how to fix my torch as well as how to do some general maintenance. I would have purchased a new torch from them however despite losing a sale they have kept my torch going hopefully for another 9 years.

records.title: Well pleased.
records.text: Very fast delivery (actually would have preferred slower but cheaper). My second of these torches, they're pricey but well made and unlike the cheaper ones the contacts seem to last. I particularly like that the sequential mode is dim-medium-brightest rather than brightest first. This is because nine times out of ten the dimmest is all you need, so you don't have to cycle through the other modes to get to it as many of the competitors' do.

records.title: Nice and light
records.text: What a great strong beam of light! Arrived perfectly on time and in perfect condition. I love the ability to recharge rather than having to change batteries. The buttons and charge lights take some getting used to but its definitely not too complicated. Will be testing the durability and water resistance in some wet caves next week. Excited to see how long the beam lasts.

records.title: Review for a Fenix HM65R-T Head Torch
records.text: Review for a Fenix HM65R-T Head Torch. Head torch is excellent, so bright. Normally use Petzyl Swift RL but the Fenix is in a different league, 1500 lumens. Really swift delivery, I also order a spare batter a few weeks later just as a back up, I wasn't sure which one to order but was given excellent advice by Fenix.

records.title: Absolutely outstanding head torch.
records.text: Absolutely outstanding head torch.I am an ultra runner and device is comfortable, extremely bright and most important,  long lasting.Very well built and the Boa system makes it so easy to adjust on the hop.Delivered swiflty.Highly recommended!!!

records.title: I am in mountain rescue and needed a…
records.text: I am in mountain rescue and needed a small waterproof light for water rescue. For some reason I've been using led lenser for years and another teammate had a fenix and I thought I'd give this a go. Absolutely faultless and a brilliant bit of kit. I will now slowly change all my lamps as this company are the mutts nuts.

records.title: Was honest about the better battery
records.text: Was honest about the better battery, (I think)

records.title: The most sensible design…
records.text: The most sensible design for a head torch. Remote battery that lasts ages. Multiple options for spotlight or floodlight or both at the same time. Comfortable to wear. Only one thing lets it down. The cooling. The metal case gets VERY hot when in use for a long time. The fins on the body are too wide and too shallow and don't offer any cooling advantage. The body might as well be a flat sided box. The fins need to be much thinner and much deeper to catch more cooler air. Take a look at an air cooled motorcycle engine. Otherwise it is faultless.

records.title: I am a keen sea angler and having a…
records.text: I am a keen sea angler and having a good headlamp is essential. This headlamp is vert good pretty much does everything I need it to.This headlamp is great for walking at night all the different functions help out in all weather conditions. The only downfall I have with this light would be the search beam I would like to be able to adjust so I can zoom in to the fish as they come in from the water.

records.title: Great torch
records.text: Great torch. Very bright and resilient making it a great EDC. Accessories for putting on a rail were a little disappointing since the rattled too much

records.title: Fenix hm65r-t head torch
records.text: Very good company. Fast delivery .The strap could do with being longer. However this is the brightest torch I've ever had without being blinding. The flood and spot light are perfect. I'm not sure I'd get 12hrs out of the 400 flood light though. I've used it every day and the battery does drain quicker than I thought.

records.title: Excellent kit
records.text: Excellent kit. Wanted to talk to someone reference a problem. Just got an email response

records.title: Very Prompt delivery
records.text: Very Prompt delivery. Best price I could find

records.title: It is superb and very very bright for…
records.text: It is superb and very very bright for its size. On the other hand rechargeable battery is sold separately at the cost of £12 but you won’t need any charger for it as you plug usb cable right to it and led light will tell you when is fully charged. Torch itself gets extremely hot when operated at full power it’s almost impossible to hold in your hand as it is wet small under 2” long.

records.title: Fenix headband and soft filter
records.text: Speedy delivery and the headband works just fine. It's a bit frustrating that it comes with bits I don't need and will just throw away: the battery case, which is the wrong size for my torch batteries, and the 2nd torch mount and extra strap for across top of head. Would be better to have just been able to buy the bits I needed. I hate waste!

records.title: No Hassles
records.text: Placed quite a large order recently, several torches and a charger. The charger unfortunately developed a fault soon after purchase, I emailed Fenix Torches and got a reply within a few hours advising me to post the charger back. I did this and they sent out another the same day.  Only improvement could have been if they had some kind of return postage system.

records.title: Fenix E20 2014
records.text: I purchased a Fenix E20 2014 model direct from the company. The product is first class and was despatched extremely quickly.My only niggle is that delivery prices are not displayed prominently on the website until the last step in completing your order. This makes it difficult to compare prices against those of other suppliers.

records.title: Good quality all round
records.text: Very fast delivery, well packaged. I got a bit worried when it failed to work when I switched it on, but it was full of condensation after being in the post box so either it was a protective circuit or some other unknown reason, but after a second try it worked fine. Very happy with the beam strength even with standard aa battery.

records.title: Fenix tk15c ultimate
records.text: This is review of fenix torch.co.uk purchased tk15c ultimate grey, very nice I like it, good weight, nice tough grey finish & probably more bright than il ever need! I chose the cr123a & using Duracell lithium batteries for now til I get to know their burn time but if they not good enough il try the rechargeable batteries. Although I'm happy with fenix torch & my product I'm disapointed that some of the accessories on their main page weren't on the British page ie the storacell 123 battery carrier

records.title: 2 out of 3
records.text: The first one of these Fenix torches I bought was the TK10 and  was so good but stopped working after 2 years.   I purchased a TK11. This was a problem from the start as I had to keep pressing the on off but so many times to get it working. I complained the Fenix who said it just needed the button inside the on off switch tightening. This didn't work so I returned it to them with them just returning it to me. I had this problem from new and it was never corrected. I have now purchased a TK12 and I only hope this one is better. I still like the Fenix and think its a great torch.

records.title: Would have given 5 stars except it …
records.text: Would have given 5 stars except it cannot be stood on its tail as the previous model could. Big drawback when working alone. Apart from that - it is the usual excellent quality build and superb brightness.

records.title: spot on
records.text: Ordered on a Friday morning.  Turned up (nicely packaged) in Saturday post.  Very happy with this company.  Unfortunately for them, the product looks so good, I don't think I will ever have to buy another.

records.title: The Fenix PD12 is a big torch in a tiny body!
records.text: I bought the PD12 after losing my trusty PD35.  I tend to lose torches so thought I'd try spending less but retaining Fenix quality.  This torch is just the job.  It's half the size (and half the price) of the PD35 but still more than adequate for my general use.  It's full power is not as bright as it's bigger brother but I tended to only use the lower 2 of the 4 brightness settings anyway on the PD35.  This little PD12 wouldn't do for heavier purposes such as hunting but it is excellent for general all round use.  Also great for keeping in the glove compartment in case of car breakdown.One thing - the PD12 is not recommended for use with rechargeable batteries. It runs on one CR123A (which is why the torch is so small).

records.title: Great products
records.text: I had the last LD41 which was a really good torch for night time jungle birding, so when I saw there was a 2015 model with 960 lumens and a 300 metre range I decided to upgrade. Fenix torches are not cheap but they are a quality item. The four brightness modes and the fact it uses AA batteries really sold it to me. You can use it to navigate forest on low brightness to conserve battery power and then use the really bright range to find night birds in big high trees. I've used a similar model to photograph owls without the need for a flash, the light being bright but not coloured. AA batteries are cheap and most countries sell them even in small villages. All in all an impressive torch with the added bonus of an SOS mode which is reassuring on some of the more adventurous jungle ventures.

records.title: Good so far
records.text: The product range is good, was in stock as claimed and sent out quickly and arrived in good condition. Yet to try the lantern as it is a Xmas gift but would order again from them.

records.title: At last- a properly designed head torch
records.text: Make sure Fenix can service the torch in future with a spares of the waterproof on/off button cover and head band.Great idea - removable, 2 battery types, stainless steel clip.

records.title: Good but not great
records.text: Torch is well built but I’m not sure it’s worth the £60+ price. I was a bit disappointed to find that you have to dismantle the torch to charge it as the micro usb connection is on the top of the battery not the outside of the torch case. However this was my fault for not reading the description carefully enough. I like the ability to lock the torch to prevent it switching on accidentally in a bag or pocket.

records.title: Not as before
records.text: I have had 3 of these now and I initially thought this higher power lamp was a good product. However this version is not anything like as good as its predecessor. The battery pack is not watertight resulting in a defective circuit board. Had to be thrown out. I've bought another and will see how it goes

records.title: Purchase of Fenix TK75 torch online
records.text: Excellent product but it was not obvious that the charger and batteries were not included. I have since had to order the rechargeable batteries and charger seperately. This meant that I did not necessarily end up with the best batteries for the torch.

records.title: Ceramic  knife sharpener
records.text: I found the advert on the search engine very misleading as I wanted an item that sharpened ceramic knives and not a ceramic sharpener that sharpens domestic steel knives. Therefore I have not got what I required.

records.text: Fabulous torches rendered virtually useless for me as they do not make 24mm red filters and so can't be used in the field

It is just a pity that lousy intermediates such as Trustpilot get between products and the public.  To be unambiguous: the Fenix torch and service are great.

records.title: Uttings are a class act
records.text: Uttings are a class act. I ordered the wrong item, sent it back for a swap and got in touch with customer service. It's the Xmas period, and the gentleman dealt with my queries/issues (I also messed up the return form) in the most attentive way one can imagine. I felt the person I emailed took a personal interest in my issue.

records.title: Recommended.  As good as ever.
records.text: Easy to use website.  Good search facility.  Decent prices.  Prompt despatch and good packaging.  I have been using Uttings for many years now. Still operating up to their high standard.

records.title: Excellent, up to the point of delivery.
records.text: The  Uttings website is very good and their price for the Snowbee rod I wanted was fantastic.  Communication was good and it was promptly dispatched. Unfortunately by DPD whom I have absolutely no faith in and sadly they lived upto expectation. Despite my instruction that in the event that we were out when they called the parcel should be left with our next door neighbour or their nearest Service Point. But no, the person left it propped up in our doorway for the whole world to see. Just that day I received an email with videos of people having goods swiped off their doorstep highlighting the issue. But for that I would have awarded Uttings five stars. I have little doubt that I will look to them in the future, taking note  of my delivery options.

records.title: Good quality product
records.text: Good quality product. I had ordered the jacket through Amazon, not realising that there was a zip in fleece available to go with it. Got the fleece through Uttings at a very good price. Prompt delivery and I now have a warm and weatherproof jacket.

records.title: Good but pricey
records.text: Excellent customer service (as ever), huge range, & a good product quickly & efficiently packed and dispatched. Uttings is a longstanding favourite of mine, for good reason.BUT15% (actually £15, when postage is included) more expensive for this item than it’s readily available elsewhere online. That’s quite a markup, and just a touch irritating.

records.title: excellent.
records.text: The experience I have had has been 1st class. From the ordering which was very easy to the delivery which arrived on time I am very impressed.

records.title: Ordering was easy and goods sent out…
records.text: Ordering was easy and goods sent out straight away e mails keeping informed. Slight delay in arriving but that was the courier not Uttings. Had a problem with the product being faulty and got swift replies and action including a different product replacement and the faulty goods collected. Service good shame about the product.

records.title: Date of birth proof was not requested
records.text: Date of birth proof was not requested initially holding up the sale process but after that the purchase went through faultlessly.

records.title: Overall good
records.text: Overall good. DPD delivery is great in that it provides an hour slot to you early, on the delivery day. So you don't have to allocate the whole day.Would be nice to have an estimated day of delivery before you place the order, also, to have this updated once the order has been processed. No formal invoice is provided. Only a delivery note with the parcel plus a payment processing confirmation receipt and an order acknowledgement.

records.title: Fast delivery
records.text: Fast delivery, good service when I had a question.My sightmark 4k max was OK, but.Don't like the rotary menu  & it's operation.The little rubber plug covering the memory card slot is too loose, & falls out regularly. The sliding clamps on the sight mount were sticking, on inspection, had burrs from manufactute  , had to trim & polish.The unit is very heavy.That's all the negatives.The sight picture is extremely clear, & in night mode it's superb.The x magnification is very easy to use, & even at high magnificatu9n gives a great picture.Has a problem with short battery life on first charge,  but this has resolved itself, & batt is fine.Apart from all the niggles  it's a good sight.Regards        Brian

records.title: Cuttings dispatch and delivery was first rate but a bit disappointed it was imperfect.
records.text: The vest was dispatched quickly and in line with what they said. It was the cheapest around by a few pounds. But when it arrived a press stud was missing on one pocket, and this was known as there was a red arrow pointing to the fault. So why was this not identified before dispatch??  It is not a big deal as most people would have the pockets open anyway. But for full price it should have been identified, or identified that is why it was cheaper.

records.title: I ordered a set of MDT scope rings from…
records.text: I ordered a set of MDT scope rings from this site and had them to mount my 34mm tubed scope within three days as suggested by Uttings.  An excellent service.  Well packaged too!

records.title: I bought ten tins of Wasp .177 pellets
records.text: I bought ten tins of Wasp .177 pellets.  They came with 5 in shrink wrap and undamaged and 5 individually wrapped but damaged, 3 badly.  Fortunately there weren't too many damaged. A softer pellet would not have faired so well.  The damage could not have been sustained in transit due to good wrapping and must have been selected damaged and put in the box otherwise they too would have been in a 5 pack.  I'm a little disappointed with the experience. I have photos but no way of uploading them to this review.

records.title: great buying experience; could product description be better?

Also shoulder strap restricting. Website pictures help in these areas, though. It was inexpensive and ultimately fine for my purposes

records.text: Ordered air rifle pellets.  Delivery was prompt.Goods were wrapped in cardboard but top & bottom was exposed, causing one tin to be damaged.  Fortunately the lead pellets were undamaged.Recommend better wrapping on the goods.

records.title: Wrong Advice

And I felt that they should be aware of the issue, to avoid any future customers being given the same advice, as there are some adjustable half moon type mounts which are far more suited, to guns with a cocking aid. I also didn’t receive a reply from Uttings, to this end.

records.title: I ordered two Caldwell Accumax Carbon…
