records.title: Appalling delivery service from DPD
records.text: Appalling delivery service from DPD - the driver couldn't find my house so took the package straight back to the depot. Uttings / DPD have my mobile number so why didn't he ring to get directions?

records.title: poor delivery
records.text: they were very fast in sending the item, but the delivery by DPD was appalling, left the parcel on front step ,even tried to claim I had recieved the parcel at 14.07 when in fact I was out all day and did not get home until 11pm anyone could have walked of with it, so excellent on their speed of service but need to find a more reliable courier , i had changed delivery date!!

records.title: Ordered 4 shooting jackets
records.text: Ordered 4 shooting jackets, decided to keep 3, but trying to return 1 is not the easiest thing I’ve done. Spending this sort of money, you should get a free returns. Just an idea.

records.title: DPD rung door bell left parcel on door…
records.text: DPD rung door bell left parcel on door step and went a £400  parcel left on door step not very good DPD not impressed by your delivery service.

records.title: Frustrating and avoidable
records.text: I have already left a review but after recital refund I’ve been asked to review again, faulty goods purchased (I accept that’s not Uttings fault), requested replacement, requested they check replacement to make sure it wasn’t a batch issue and that the replacement was ok which they said they would do, replacement arrived, same problem. I have had to take 2 days off work to receive and despatch the faulty reels, they have had £200 of mine for a few weeks, I have no reel. Customer service was good to a point but they should have checked the replacement, the problem was blatantly obvious and they said that they fully understood the problem as they had seen it on different reels.

description:
Welcome to Minimum World, the online dolls house superstore, where you'll find everything you need to fill your passion for all things miniature!

So whether it's a dolls house, furniture, accessories or little people with big personalities you're looking for, we have it all!

Our dedicated team are always on hand to provide you with exceptional customer service by emailing info@minimumworld.com.

records.title: Great item
records.text: Fantastic product well made and true to picture .came on time and well packaged .Already on line writing my next order thank you

records.title: Excellent
records.text: Excellent, received today and really pleased with my purchase...although royal mail were a complete let down as usual, that's not the sellers fault tho ! Bought some bits for a Christmas present and really pleased, considering how cheap they were they are really good quality lots to choose from, easy website to navigate and was posted quickly,will buy from again and recommend 🫶👌minimum world please change your courier,

records.title: What a fantastic company
records.text: What a fantastic company. I bought a dolls house for my granddaughter some time ago and we have thoroughly enjoyed choosing wallpaper from this company and enhancing the house. The wallpaper ( including roof tiles paper) is beautiful and excellent quality. I underestimated how much I needed so advise people to order more then they think they need. But the delivery is swift so it hasn't slowed down our "renovations." Really impressed with the company

records.title: Great service
records.text: Great service. I have purchased many items on several occasions and the items have always been delivered quickly and well packaged. Customer service are quick to respond and very helpful

records.title: Well done Minimum World
records.text: I have been meaning to write a review for a while now as I have made several orders over the last few months. Each order has arrived promptly and has been beautifully packed. The items have been lovely and of good quality. They are all competitively priced. I would not hesitate recommending this company as my experiences with them have been very positive. Thank you to all concerned.

records.title: Just love Minimum world
records.text: Just love Minimum world! Great products so very reasonably priced. With two dolls houses built my late Father for my children years ago they have now been transformed into showpieces befitting his talent thanks to Minimum world. A corner shop and living accommodation plus a 4 story Georgian house in my lounge are just wonderful testament to their wonderful miniature products. Orders always packed so beautifully and carefully  for safe deliveries.  Love to receive them , Im like a child again ! So thanks for that and the joy your products bring not only me but my many friends & family who are always keen and ready to view your wonderful miniature pieces Thank you so much.

records.title: Faultless
records.text: Faultless. Ordering was easy, the quality of the items very good and delivery was as promised.

records.title: Fast delivery and excellent quality…
records.text: Fast delivery and excellent quality together with very reasonable pricing makes this my go to company.

records.title: Always a good day when I get a delivery…
records.text: Always a good day when I get a delivery from minimum world. So many lovely miniatures to choose from. Always well packaged and swift delivery.

records.title: Affordable quality!
records.text: Ordering many pieces to set up dollhouses for my six girls this Christmas. Everything was SUCH good quality. I’m used to the dollhouse options at places like Michael’s or hobby lobby, and these pieces are so much more sturdy and affordable. Will definitely be shopping again!

records.title: Everything has been good
records.text: Everything has been good Easy to order and navigate the site Thank you. Happy New Year 🥳

records.title: No one to talk to…
records.text: Paid for next day delivery which was slightly longer.  My bath has arrived with broken tap and there is no way of contacting the company as they not manning the phone.  So i’ve now a wait to sort out something I wanted quickly for a present.  Inconvenient for me

records.title: Delivery service is not good
records.text: I am really not happy with the delivery service, I have ordered many times from this wonderful shop, and this is the second time I've had problems with delivery . I ordered my miniatures on the Friday, and paid extra for the next day delivery service. I didn't expect it to be delivered the next day, being the weekend. I left a note for the delivery man saying that I will be home, but there was absolutely no attempt to deliver my parcel to my address, so now I have to go to matalan and collect my parcel myself.. Please be very cautious when paying extra for next day delivery. . I will still continue to buy my dolls house items from this site but I don't think I would pay the extra again for next day delivery at a cost of 5.99.

records.title: Great variety easy to order on line and…
records.text: Great variety easy to order on line and great products ,good delivery . Only one snag getting confirmation about when the order is sent out sometimes don't get the emails to let me know when you have dispatched my order .

records.title: Unfortunately one item was damaged.
records.text: Everything I ordered was well packaged and as expected. Unfortunately I had one cabinet which was in it's own box but damaged, I have emailed and waiting for a reply. Shame the returns process isn't a bit easier.

records.title: Fantastic experience
records.text: It was a tad dificult to find some of the products i had pre selected for purchase but nothing to worry i had time and pacience that day, the overall was just a fantastic experience. It arrived sooner that i thought, carefully wrapped and nice bags, very good quality of the miniatures. I am still selecting my next purchase things but it will be soon.

records.title: Quality service
records.text: My first  time dealing with this company has been very positive. The goods arrived in tact and within an acceptable time frame. I appreciate the personal service provided with regard to stock availability and the prompt response to emails. Also appreciate the accurate description of items, including sizes and dimensions.  It was nice to deal with real people rather than an algorithm.

records.title: Ordering was simple and I got a quick…
records.text: Ordering was simple and I got a quick response to my order. The package was beautifully packaged when it arrived.

records.title: My mother loved it
records.text: Well packaged and arrived safely with no damage.  My only complaint is the tracking updates. I know overseas shipping takes awhile,  but updates were several days behind.

records.title: Most items well made and enchanting
records.text: Most items well made and enchanting. However, the sleigh bed cannot be described as mahogany, or even mahogany effect, it is red!

records.title: Order arrival
records.text: My order arrived promptly and well packed. However one piece of furniture sent was the wrong piece. When I messaged Minimum World the reply was that it could be sent in my next order! I am not ready to order another $100 yet. I am not happy with that response. The other items were perfect.

records.title: I gave 4 stars because they have to…
records.text: I gave 4 stars because they have to send my pkgs to the USA. The packing is usually received bent, broke or smashed. They need to update the way they pack. Other than that perfecto

records.title: white towels
records.text: the towels ordered were glued together which was not obvious on the picture, otherwise the other items    fitted perfectly

records.title: My review
records.text: A good choice of items, orders don’t take  to long to arrive and are well packed. If there is a problem it is resolved quickly

records.title: Prompt service
records.text: Prompt service, quality of products.  Good sales.  Have been a customer for many years and only buy from you.  Just wish I could visit.  Merry Christmas to all the staff.

records.title: In general very good
records.text: In general very good. Would like to see a mid range, between the cheap things and the expensive range.

records.title: Good reliable company
records.text: I'd say they're pretty good. Been happy with most items I've received and always delivered promptly.

records.title: Very pleased with everything I’ve…
records.text: Very pleased with everything I’ve ordered

records.title: Busted light fixture
records.text: I absolutely love the minimum world nd was slightly dissapointed when I ordered some lights last christmas and the ne light, it was wired, I checked the connection on the plug, and the one light on it did not work. A short while later the whole thing broke.

records.title: Received order in timely manner
records.text: Received order in timely manner. Disappointed to find out the ceiling gas lamp is not working

records.title: I ordered a fridge for my dolls house
records.text: I ordered a fridge for my dolls house.   It came scratched and door was hanging off.  I did email and they did offer me a refund.  But she said it come from their cheaper range.  It doesn’t matter really.  I know it was cheap but shouldn’t have been broken

records.title: Mixed items ordered
records.text: The items are all very good quality and a good selection. However, a few items described as 1:12 scale were not and had to be returned which is very annoying. What was to scale though was very good.

records.title: The products are good and beautiful but…
records.text: The products are good and beautiful but unfortunately I had to pay 42 € in customs fees

records.title: The lamp post I ordered doesn't even function
records.text: Ordered a bunch of stuff but was most excited for a light up street light post and it doesn't even work

records.title: Unacceptable service
records.text: Whilst some items were as described and acceptable, the balloon chairs are made of plasic not wood as described. Therefore they look and feel tacky and cheap. On raising this issue with them they insist they are wood! At over £13 each this is far from acceptable! No doubt they were manufactured in China/Taiwan for a few pence.They refuse to send me a prepaid label and expect me to pay for postage, tracking and insurance to return goods which are not of "satisfactory quality" .I shall never purchase from this company again.

records.title: m                                                                                                   I ordered a cash register for my dolls…
records.text: I ordered a cash register for my dolls house shop but unfortunatelythe drawer was missing I contacted minimum world but NO RESPONSEvery disappointed!!!!!!!

records.title: I ordered walnut 6 mm dowel and you…
records.text: I ordered walnut 6 mm dowel and you have sent 6 mm oak dowel

records.title: excessive wait
records.text: I am still waiting for an order that I placed in June--about 10 weeks ago.  I think that's an unreasonable length of time to wait.

records.title: Disappointed
records.text: Have ordered £95 pounds worth of things nearly 2 weeks ago.  Get a recorded message to say use E-Mail address.  Have had no communications.  Payment money has been taken for the order.  Really disappointed and worried.  Cannot complete the Dolls house we have just made for our Granddaughter.  Have now missed finishing it for her Birthday.

records.title: FAILURE TO ACCEPT PAYMENT
records.text: Sunday of Black Friday week. I've just spent all day as a dissabled person with very limited energy putti g my order through. Some 69 items at just over £140. Minimum World has NO ACCESS TO PAYPAL. Srsrly?! I can't waist more of my energy and time. It's opening hours. PayPal is working with no problem. I have the necessary means to pay. If they can't be bothered to run an efficient buosness I'm looking elsewhere.

records.title: I ordered one Oil lamp from this…
records.text: I ordered one Oil lamp from this company and when it arrived, it didn't work. I contacted the company to inquire about getting a replacement and was told "It was working when it left the facility and we won't replace it" REALLY ??? I wouldn't recommend this company to anyone... First time I ordered from this company and the last.....Customer service is horrible and they don't stand behind their products..STAY FAR FAR AWAY FROM THIS COMPANY

records.title: tried to contact your company and no response
records.text: I ordered a month ago and got a notification my order was shipped one week after the purchase. my invoice was incorrect I have had no communication and when  I tried to contact your service over a week ago there was no response. So dissapointed at the service

records.title: Items marked sale are actually not really cheaper
records.text: Items marked sale are actually not. I bought a 3 tulip chandelier much cheaper. Now it is sale again but the price is 2 pounds higher.Regarding the answer of the owner, I can post the pictures of the same items, but useless. The fact I caught them claiming on sale but the same items and not new ones.

description:
We specialise in the sale of the "Hardest Kit on the Planet" - excellent kit at great prices.

From Multitools to Eyewear, Rucksacks and Binoculars, Sleeping Bags and Firelighters - if we sell it, you can depend on it being of top quality.

We too shop online, so we understand the importance of a reliable supplier. We are that reliable supplier - we are real people, who want you to have a no-hassle shopping experience at heinnie.com.

We are based in a real office in Barry, near Cardiff, with our stock on the shelf in our warehouse, ready to go.

We ship our products using either Royal Mail or UPS, which ensures that they'll get to you swiftly.

If you have any queries about our range of products, give us a call, or send us an email.

We're here on the phone (033 0300 0400):
Monday - Friday 0900 - 1730

Our email support (support@heinnie.com) is always available - you'll get a speedy answer during office hours, or the next working morning if you mail us in the evening or weekend.
Reliable shopping at heinnie.com

records.title: First class items and service from Heinnie Haynes
records.text: Purchases a number of items before and after Christmas. Quality of goods are first class, especially the carinthia and triple aught design clothing. These items as just class! Heinnie Haynes service was amazing from start to finish. Delivery was prompt. Would highly recommend.

records.title: Great Products and Service
records.text: As always Heinnie Haynes have delivered. I bought 2x Grade C knives from a collection. Expecting some wear, when they arrived the knives were in absolutely mint condition except for wear and tear on the old cardboard boxes. Shipping was fast too!

records.title: Speedy delivery of good quality goods
records.text: Very pleased with the quality of the goods and delivery service from this company. Very quick, especially near Xmas.

records.title: Christmas voucher
records.text: This was a gift voucher for my son. He is always happy to receive it as he really values the items he buys and considers everything to be high quality and wearable.

records.title: My No1 choice for outdoors and EDC
records.text: HH always stocks great quality items, with accurate item descriptions which truly reflect the item helping to make that all important informed decision.When it comes to getting the parcel out the door and on its way they are second to none.Can’t fault them.

records.title: Top service and quality goods
records.text: Honestly I put a bad review in and the team was more than willing to sort the issue which was neither fault of there's or mine. So since then I have ordered and they are fast and efficient. Looking forward to my new equipment coming soon and a batch of videos reviewing and testing them. so far had the gerber affinity copper, the HH solis, the fox baby core and now waiting on the mora companion carbon and crkt spew.

records.title: Excellent quality
records.text: This knife was purchased as a present. It was exactly what the recipient wanted and I found the price and quality excellent. Very quick delivery and well packaged.

records.title: Fast, Efficient, Service
records.text: Safe, well laid out website, you can find what you're looking for, order it and know that it'll be reliably sent in super fast time. Always a good service from Heinnie Haynes.

records.title: The shop is very good
records.text: The shop is very good. Very good and prompt service. The problem is with the courier. Here in Romania, UPS is considered the worst. Because of him the parcel was delivered 2 days later than scheduled.  The delivering agent lies to your face that he called you and you didn't want to answer. If I can avoid them I will do it every time. The pleasant experience I had with the store is minimized by the ugly experience I had with the courier.

records.title: Usual great service from Heinnie
records.text: Brilliant choice of products. Delivered very quick and arrived in perfect condition. I've bought quite a few items now and will continue to do so as they are ultra reliable.

records.title: Always a pleasure to deal with
records.text: The order process is very simple, prices are good and shipment quick.The online support via mail is good and answers into a short time.The only downside is at returns no shipment label from the seller and this can eat up your savings by paying the post and shipping fees.

records.title: Great knife, poor packaging
records.text: Great knife and have been an avid enjoyer of these products for a long long time, my previous blade has lasted well over 13 years of abuse and still going strong and remains sharp. Ordered a new one as a gift, really impressed in the quality. 4 stars due to the packaging being battered and there was absolutely NO checks at the door, the knife was posted through my letterbox without any checks or even knocking.

records.title: Shame about the courier
records.text: Good quality product. Easy to order. Shame DPD let retailer down by claiming they missed me 5 mins into the delivery window, so had to rearrange delivery.

records.title: Nice quality
records.text: Nice quality of the items but the box’s for them  we’re all smashed up (wouldn’t usually be a problem but I bought these as gifts)

records.title: Service review
records.text: Good service and wide range of productsWould of given 5 stars but disappointed that I keep getting far to many emails to keep doing reviews this I find quite annoying

records.title: I was pleased with all my purchases
records.text: I was pleased with all my purchases. My only quibble is that when I returned an item, the refund didn't include the original postage. Perhaps if HH could provide free postage labels for returns.

records.title: Updated review….I received my new Big…
records.text: Updated review….I received my new Big Beowulf Fixed blade today! Very nice knife. Prefect size for my needs! FINALLY some makes a knife sheath that I don’t have to modify. Knife came razor sharp. Craftsmanship is excellent as all of my Midgard-Messer knives. I love it enough that I’ll probably order another.  I gave 4 stars because unfortunately the blade came with 2 small chips! I am going to try and work them out but still was disappointed that they were there on a brand new knife. Somehow slipped thru un-noticed I suppose. Shipping was slower than expected but arrived safely without issue!

records.title: Thanks Gang for another amazing…
records.text: Thanks Gang for another amazing shipment of shiny toys.It is the perfect tool for what is needed.

records.title: Would have been 5 stars but the parcel…
records.text: Would have been 5 stars but the parcel arrived 3 days early, so was pure luck I was in, but that's more the courier tha HH...otherwise all great.

records.title: Change courier
records.text: Arrived promptly and quite well packaged so not damaged even though the courier left it in a difficult to see place in a flower bed in the rain.

records.title: Fast delivery...easy navigation of…
records.text: Fast delivery...easy navigation of website.....The product is as described visually....That having been said it needs constant sharpening for something advertised as a high carbon steel Bushcraft knife ....I would perhaps not be taken in by  the item description as much next time and would research the product separately....🤷

records.title: I have no issues with Heinnie Haynes
records.text: I have no issues with Heinnie Haynes, they are great. I do however have an issue with DPD who they use as the carrier. Despite DPD providing delivery slots, they failed to deliver as advised and I ended up paying additional fees to get my order.

records.title: Quick delivery
records.text: Quick delivery, good  product.Only downside was a little confusion about having provided age-appropriate evidence, which was then requested again on my mobile.Otherwise - great stuff.

records.title: Good service and product
records.text: Good service and product

records.title: Great selection and service but needs…
records.text: Great selection and service but needs cheaper shipping options.The shipping fees, even for orders that don’t require age verification, are pretty steep and put me off ordering more often.Still, impressive range of products and no complaints on the service. Very prompt dispatch.

records.title: I was pleased with my service very…
records.text: I was pleased with my service very quick.  I stopped using Heinnie Haynes a about 10 years ago when I did not get any support when a cold steel product completely failed on first use and I was told this was nothing to do with Heinne Haynes and I had to go back to cold steel direct. Well at least this is an indication of some customer service now.

records.title: Great service and delivery but I've had…
records.text: Great service and delivery but I've had to send two items back due to cosmetic issues. Always sorted it for me though, but good idea to check things before being sent out.

records.title: Great Delivery, but Rust Spots on Blade
records.text: Excellent Delivery from HH as per usual, v quick. However, the Martindale Paratrooper Machete arrived with 2 x small Rust spots, 1 on either side of the blade, and, leftover gum from label /sticker removed from the wooden handle. Not serious, but a lack of Quality Control, and because I've never before received a blade from Online Sellers with Rust spots, can only give 4 Stars. HH please take note, Thank You.

records.title: Nearly perfect
records.text: I ordered two items from Heinnie Haynes, I’ve used them before and rate their products and service. My order arrived a day earlier than expected and was complete. The only thing stopping this being a 5 star review is that the torch that I bought has been opened previously as the packaging had obviously been open before. Possibly used as a demonstrator but there was no discount for this.

records.title: Well built knife with a lot of character.
records.text: The slip joint knife I bought is very solid well built and symmetrical. There are a few very minor rough spots in the Micarta and back spring. This knife has a great character/story and would undoubtedly be an excellent tool.My knife was promptly shipped however it did arrive 6 days later than the time estimate. Overall I am happy and would do business again.

records.title: Cool items, packaging not great
records.text: Cool items. Packaging not great. Axe has scratches on it, which I know will eventually happen with use, but it’s for a gift so looks unsightly. When box arrived it had been ripped right open. Items were still inside but only a thin bit of brown paper to stop it all rattling around during delivery.

records.title: You were great, delivery company weren’t
records.text: You were great, as always. The purchase was made unfortunate by the delivery company. I made you aware and your service department sorted it really quickly.

records.title: HH great site, Fenix bad filter cap
records.text: HH great site, quick and easy as usual. I bought this Fenix E28R torch as it had a red filter cap. £5.95 for the cap, more for the accompanying torch. The Fenix AOF cap is plastic, quite thin flimsy plastic at that, white light escapes from the base where it joins the torch. And the torch gets hot as its an LED and metal body. The plastic then starts to get soft and a melting/burning smell begins. I wouldn't recommend buying the red filter for any of the torches it fits. I think I'll be returning both as I only bought the torch for the red filter cap.

records.title: Great customer service poor delivery
records.text: great customer service and product came as described. Delivery took a while but no fault to the seller.

records.title: Quality products
records.text: Quality products, very keenly priced. Best of all a very fast and efficient delivery, even with standard delivery.

Lots of interesting inventory. Quick dispatch. Only complaint is they seem to send out a lot of returns/damaged/ex display. For the money you're paying you'd expect brand new/factory sealed items, not pre opened/ex display stock.

records.title: Better delivery options needed
records.text: My review is not so much about the products I ordered, but the confusing delivery options at checkout. When placing my order, I confirmed my shipping address to be the same as my billing address, pretty standard stuff.The default option however was a UPS collection from a local trading estate. Delivery cost £8. The items were small enough to fit in a standard envelope and could have easily been posted to my address via Royal Mail for that amount, probably less.Clearer delivery options at checkout would be a big improvement, and better value delivery for small items would be an advantage as well. The morning I received the delivery confirmation from UPS, I called the local vendor where the package had been delivered. He said the items had arrived a few days earlier, i can’t think why it took so long for the notification to come through. The items are fine, this was a one off purchase, just watch out for the delivery choices. Home delivery is not as standard, costs a premium and UPS inform you 2 days after your items arrive.

records.title: Great company who are now using a dreadful courier company
records.text: Great company who i have bought items from before .... however .... i am waiting at home for the 5 th day in a row for an item i bought last week .... the delivery company DPD are totally hopeless .... H.H. gav up using Royal mail earlier this year so customers are at the mercy of private couriers who in my experience are totally unreliable

records.title: Nothing wrong with Hiennie it's the…
records.text: Nothing wrong with Hiennie it's the Morons they employ to do the delivery's. Failing to ask for proof of ID for bladed items, too lazy to wait for a Disabled person to answer the door, leaving purchases outside when there are signs on my door telling them not to. Sick to death of the whole delivering farce. "Delivery driver wanted must be complete idiot to qualify for the job. No initiative required here."

records.title: Fast delivery, beautiful pocket knife, quality control could be better
records.text: The knife was dispatched very quickly, ordered on a Friday morning and delivered Saturday afternoon which is excellent! A beautiful little pocket knife. My only issue is that it arrived with a small chunk in the blade…Quality control could of perhaps been better.

records.title: Asking twice for rating on parcel that have not arrived for two weeks?
records.text: Well, 4 days delivery is now two weeks delivery and I have not received the package yet. I texted the seller. They responded, with the same information that I could see on the tracking :) I'm patient and I believe that the package will eventually arrive, but not the best customer care I've seen around. Sorry.

records.title: The logistic of the company is very…
records.text: The logistic of the company is very good, good comunication and fast delivery, maybe a little better check on the knife before shipping.The large blade on the RR old southwest canoe has a lot of side to side play, I probably was never going to use the knife as is beautiful just to have, but it's still a bit annoying.Thanks

records.title: All are nice but failed at UPS access point
records.text: The knife is great. The despatch is fast. But the access point of the UPS was not opening as stated. The UPS drop off was unsuccessful on Friday due to the access point was closed and they could only make the 2nd attempt on next working day, I.e. Monday.On Monday, I tried to pick up from the access point in the afternoon but it was closed again. Finally I picked it up on Tuesday morning.

records.title: Usually unbeatable for service
records.text: Usually unbeatable for service and advice, however my recent purchase of two matching knife blanks I wasn't made aware there was only one and they just sent me something vaguely similar. If I'd have known I would have waited to get the two matching items.

records.title: I have a locking version of this blade
records.text: I have a locking version of this blade, it’s a solid carry knife. This one, doesn’t lock and is less than 2.5” which makes it legal to carry in a lot of areas, it has a solid steel choice, and is nice and lightweight. The H&H version, as of 1-17-2023 has not been received by the carrier yet so I do not have it in my possession, this is the only reason for 3 instead of 5 stars

records.title: This isn't really fair at all - issue with courier
records.text: This isn't really fair at all - the item is a present for my brother so haven't opened it.Reason why rating so low is because DPD let you down - badly.  Gave mother's address as knew she would be in on the date given as ETA.  DPD then arrived a day earlier and had an issue, no idea what it was.  The next day, I made sure mother's gate was unlocked, wide open ready for the next attempted delivery before I left for work.  Delivery failed again, and again, no reason given - just a photo of the Lane down which she lives.  Suspect the driver didn't want to mess up his targets by going down the little lane as when changed the address to my own (as by this time it was now a WFH day), no problem at all.  So, DPD, who I usually rave about, absolutely let everyone down as didn't have my brother's gift in time for his birthday.  Vaughn was the driver's name for the Wednesday and Thursday deliveries.

records.title: Bad quality
records.text: The product is not executed as expected. Feedback to maker could solve the issue. Grind of knife is symptomatic. This is an issue that can be fixed without any problem, but it is not what it should be considering the hight price. You should address this.

records.title: The kit is good but could do with some…
records.text: The kit is good but could do with some more hardware — I have plenty of paracord remaining. Also, the instructions are far from clear. I had to search the internet for guidance until I understood how to make the braid.

records.title: Samura 67 kitchen knife - not Japanese.
records.text: My order was acknowledged promptly and despatched and delivered more quickly than expected which was impressive.  The knife feels good in the hand and is very sharp. Time will tell how well it keeps its edge and how well it sharpens.The knife is described as Japanese on the website so it is disappointing to find that according to the package it was made in China.  I suppose the price was a clue.

records.title: UPS failed to send a correct locker…
records.text: UPS failed to send a correct locker code. Their customer service was useless. The item was stuck in the locker for several days before being returned to Lorax.However, Lorax have re-sent the parcel to my postal address via a different carrier. Great service from HH as usual!

records.title: Product not as advertised.
records.text: Product not as advertised. Photos were different online, and on closer inspection it looked as though the item had been used, with scuffs and scratches all over it. They offered a free return however which was appreciated.

records.title: As usual UPS is a nightmare
records.text: As usual UPS is a nightmare. Even when i changed the delivery date to Monday they still kept trying to deliver it throughout  the week and when they attempted their last delivery on Monday the box was ripped open as if somebody was playing football with it. Even with heinnie's quality packaging  2 white light sticks were missing, thankfully nothing more expensive. I wish heinnie used royal mail, they'd just leave the parcel at my house and be done with it.

records.title: Work out the "age thing" before the transaction is complete
records.text: After I PAID for my purchase, I was bombarded with nagging threats to "verify" my age.  This was done when the purchase was made. It's been there since the 27th of Sept (it's now October 3rd).  Disappointing.

records.title: I recently purchased a Higonakami…
records.text: I recently purchased a cheap Higonakami which was returned to sender after two unsuccessful delivery attempts. Heinnie Haynes sorted this issue promptly and without fuss. Unfortunately the item I ultimately recieved has a slightly blunted tip which I may or may not sharpen out. I shouldn't have to do that and I'm not returning it as it's a birthday gift which I don't wish to be overdue. Heinnie Haynes are a good company on the whole and can't be expected to check every item they send out but in this instance my two star rating reflects my disappointment.

records.title: Usually good service, but not this time
records.text: I've purchased from their website several times, and had never had a problem until now.One of the items I ordered was a titanium flashlight (in grey, with blue paint), but the one I received had a shiny chrome finish. It was labelled as the item I ordered, but looks nothing like it.I decided to keep it anyway to use it as a stocking filler at Christmas, and re-order the item for myself, but it is now out of stock.So I tried to submit a message to customer services, but every 30 seconds or so, I was forced to complete an anti-bot test to prove I'm human (despite being logged into my account), and in the end I gave up

records.title: Still no delivery of order…
records.text: Having ordered over a week ago with next day delivery indicated…I’ve still not received my order. DPD have been the problem, they seem to like my order more than me. Sorry 24 hr delay, sorry we are running late, No attempt to deliver, then claiming they couldn’t verify age…I’m long past looking younger than 21….I’m 56. Apparently the item is back with the seller…no idea when I’ll see it.

records.title: Charging £10 postage on a £32 knife
records.text: Charging £10 postage on a £32 knife. After years of being a loyal  customer and spending a lot of money as a knife collector I feel this is too much. It has left me disappointed in what was a good company to deal with. I am sorry to say I will take my custom elsewhere.

records.title: I do not usually have any problems with…
records.text: I do not usually have any problems with Heinnie Haynes but on this occasion their choice of delivery partner is the problem. I bought a CRKT carabiner knife UK LEGAL. They didn’t even attempt delivery( pic taken of a house not even in our village).Couldn’t contact DPD.Thankfully I phoned Heinnie Haynes direct. The fella said he’d send it Royal Mail. Still to receive item!

records.title: Packaging for transit is an issue.
records.text: Packaging for transit is an issue.Jiffy bags do not provide the level of protection needed to ensure branded box arrives intact.An outer cardboard box (with shredded cardboard filler) is used by Moonraker Accessories, which not only gives more than adequate protection, but is also more sustainable.I will be using Moonraker Accessories more in the future.

records.title: Knife sharpening kit ,tightening screw…
records.text: Knife sharpening kit ,tightening screw doesn't tighten ,chips and dings on frame ,Devon this has been returned after replacing .This is the only complaint ever about Heinnie ,all other guys have been 1st class.

description:

description:
Established as a business in 1970, Terrys has successfully grown to be a significant retailer in the home furnishings space, online and in-store.


Terrys continues to be a family owned operation with the principles of great service, expert advice and high quality products at its core.


We have a strong bias for sourcing local with the vast majority of our suppliers based in the UK.  In addition, we have key international partners to help ensure that overall we provide the highest quality at the best prices.


Terrys is one of the biggest fabric stores in the UK, with over 4000 fabrics available as we speak.


All of these fabric by the metre products can be ordered as finished custom made blinds and curtains through our bespoke making-up service.


And if that was not impressive enough we have thousands of dedicated made to measure blind products in Roman, Roller, Vertical, Venetian, Vertical, Day/ Night and Wooden Blind formats, plus Curtains in various headings, made to your exact requirements.


We also have a huge range of stocked Ready Made Curtains, Bedding, Cushions and Homewares, available now through our speedy and efficient delivery service.


Without our valued customers, Terrys would not be where it is today.  Sincerely thank you for all your support and we welcome your important feedback whether that be about a great experience or if you are telling us how we can improve.

records.text: Fabric took a little longer than I expected however it was a lovely print, stupidly I didn't expect it to be a print, thought it would be woven

records.title: Lovely product
records.text: Lovely product - just as expected.Service great and speedy delivery But one concern is the company delivering has a habit of dropping parcels on a step half way up in block of flats,and leaving all doors open to building when  leaving. Sometimes deliveries at door of 86 year old ladys flat and not going upstairs to leave delivery at correct flat.

records.title: Lovely curtains from trusted supplier
records.text: Pretty Catherine Lansfield curtains bought for our granddaughter’s room. They arrived promptly and were as expected. Have previously purchased items from Terrys and have always been happy with the curtains. Highly recommend this company.

records.title: Material great
records.text: Material great , delivery on schedule and well pakaged -unfortunately sent to wrong address no. 48 instead of 46 - not sure if it was my error or the company! However neighbour went out of her way to find me so all's well that ends well.

records.title: You get what you pay for.
records.text: Curtains are thin  with an odd print error but you get what you pay for. Very good delivery time.

records.title: A bad start that ended well
records.text: It started badly as the wrong shade curtains were sent and being a pensioner I found it very tiresome to have to phone, wait, go through all the online procedure to explain and book a return, photocopy the necessary papers and then return them to a post office and be told more had to be ordered so would not arrive until after Christmas.  I then researched and found they did have what I wanted under pairs of curtains instead of door curtains, phoned and paid again and was pleased that they arrived in less than a week so in time for Christmas after all.  The curtains are heavy and lined and a very good price for such reasonable quality.

records.title: Products are as described
records.text: Though it takes about week to receive my order, still fine.  Fabric is good, as what described.

records.title: Good product
records.text: Good product, well made and as expected. Slightly wider than anticipated but still workable. Also arrived in a timely fashion. I would recommend Terrys

records.title: I 'googled' for Catherine Lansfield
records.text: I 'googled' Catherine Lansfield.  Terrys responded and I did not double-check!  After hols I opened package to discover NOT Catherine Lansfield - which I bought previously - and definitely wrong shade as its too blue not clear cherry as I require.  I have now emailed Terrys with request 'how to return'.   I also only now have noted that Terrys main business is blinds and curtains.  Throws are not listed on their main advertising.  Politely? it suggests to me that throws come under their 'accessories' but, again I've just checked;  not seen 'throws' at all.   I do not ever respond with a 'useful' review; my responses are all direct and my opinion/reaction.

records.title: Love the curtains themselves but…
records.text: Love the curtains themselves but unfortunately one of the curtains seams is not at all well seen and has caused a big gather which is very noticable. Such a shame because other than that, they're great.

records.title: Good & bad
records.text: The instore Service was second to none but I am afraid That the goods ( a table cloth ) were of inferior quality I was very disappointed

records.title: Good customer service but curtain quality was not quite
records.text: It was easy to order and fast delivery however weren't impressed on the cotton fabric curtain that was paying for c£110. The quality was cheap and no weight at all. Printed jacobean design pattern were uneven and I am almost send these back but thinking to have to send back in 3 lots which caused me hassles. I am regretted to order these to be honest, thought it would be thermal or thickness slightly but none. The product itself let me down.

records.title: Bought apron as a gift which friend had…
records.text: Bought apron as a gift which friend had picked. The reason for 3 stars is the ridiculous price of postage. If my friend hadn’t chosen it I wouldn’t have bought it

records.title: Really nice curtains however the…
records.text: Really nice curtains however the plastic containing the package was heavily damaged and ripped. Thankfully, the curtains were fine and the tiebacks were still in there but looking at the damage, this couldn't have been done by the carrier, it must have been sent out already damaged.

records.title: Poorer filmsy quality product
records.text: Staff were very friendly and efficient via email during all communication, however quite disappointed with the quality of purchased item (made to measure curtains). Bought new curtains for our baby daughters’ nursery, fabric is  lovely Sophie Allport make and indeed is a very nice design. However our issue is with the overall quality of the product. Paid additional for blackout/thermal layer and for a product costing £450 - very thin flimsy curtains, much inferior to the set which we were replacing. A real shame as the fabric design is lovely but we will now need to buy a thick thermal blind to accompany or her room will be too cold. Given the poorer flimsy quality of the curtains ordered, we wouldn’t order from this company again.

records.title: Disappointed !
records.text: I gave accurate measurements in width based on existing blinds but the blinds purchased were both at least 5cms  less in width which has caused problems  with fitting and aesthetically .

records.title: The curtains arrived quickly
records.text: The curtains arrived quickly, and were as described.  Unfortunately,  the colour on the website was very different from the actual curtains, which were much pinker than the terracotta l thought l would be getting

records.title: quality curtains
records.text: loads of choice found what I was looking for, and size good price very good quality curtains easy ordering and fast delivery 👍

records.title: Beautiful colour
records.text: Curtains are very nice, lovely colour and well made, although  the fabric is a lighter-weight than I had hoped.  They arrived VERY creased with the tie backs particularly poor, hopefully all will drop out.  Delivery was disappointing as the courier left parcel on pavement outside the house and it took a while and message to Evri to track the parcel down.  Having said this, I'm pleased with the curtains overall.

records.title: I ordered 2 lots of bedding
records.text: I ordered 2 lots of bedding. One was love6 very good quality. The other not as good. Having said that I have had some lovely bedding from here and will continue to order.

records.title: The service was better than the blind quality
records.text: The service was very good. I thought the blind quality was slightly disappointing.  The material itself was quite thin and the fixings were not great quality.  Only two screws which have to be really tight to keep them from opening and releasing the sprung blind. Also the plastic covers are so tight to the brackets that they also press the sprung core of the blind inwards so that it is more likely to spring out. I threw them away. The colour etc was accurate and I like the visual impression   .

records.title: You get what you pay for !!!!!
records.text: The price appeared very reasonable, hence me purchasing the curtains , when I opened them I realised you only get what you pay for ! They are cheap for a reason ! Very poor quality very thin and look absolutely dreadful on hanging ! A complete waste of money

records.title: Good website, swift delivery
records.text: Very swift delivery but I felt that the buttonholes on the duvet covers were badly done. This was probably down to the manufacturer's and not Terry's.

records.title: Process easy. Marked down on colour of visible thread.
records.text: Easy to order sample of fabric.Once ordered, very good communication, with regular updates of progress.Delivered both blinds before due date.Fitting the blinds all good.My only disappointment is the colour of thread used on the two Roman blinds.  I will have to restitch when I have some spare time with matching colour thread to the fabric.

records.title: I thought that the curtains would be…
records.text: I thought that the curtains would be much thicker as it said thermal and energy saving but I supose for the price they are ok

records.title: Delivery was pretty fast but the…
records.text: Delivery was pretty fast but the quality of the curtains aren't great, the sewing of the seams are a little off , pleased I only paid the offer price,  wouldn't like to think I'd paid the supposed full price

records.title: Ok but had an issue
records.text: Fairly quick delivery. Blind had the pull cord on the wrong side which we only realised after we put it up.Customer service were quite short and didn't seem too apologetic. We had to take it back down (damaging paintwork) and swap the ends around.Decent quality but shame the end brackets don't come in other colours as the white stands out against our decor.

records.title: I have used Terrys for most of my…
records.text: I have used Terrys for most of my window furnishings as I had a large house to decorate over the last seven years.Their blind kits are very good value.Materials on sale are quite often sub standard, which is only obvious when cutting or trying to match patterns.By that time it’s too late to return, which is why there is a very red letter attached to every delivery!Delivery time is average.

records.title: Received damaged bedding (hole in…
records.text: Received damaged bedding (hole in pillow) reported issue same day as delivery and was told I would receive a replacement, this was nearly 4 weeks ago and nothing. Super disappointed as I always buy my bedding from here.

records.title: Curtains
records.text: Bought in sale but would have been extremely disappointed had I paid full price as not what I expected. In addition although instructions said curtains would have some creasing due to the nature of the fabric and would drop out or cool iron or steam. They were ridiculously creased in all directions with actual star burst patterns. Only able to hang after several days of rigorous ironing.

records.title: Had to chase for information after…
records.text: Had to chase for information after waiting past date of arrival

records.title: Sent me a used product
records.text: Product was clearly used as there were mounting screw marks on it. The packaging was damaged and it was shoddily taped back together letting in all the rainwater while it was left outside my house upon delivery.

records.title: Badly packed, customer service terrible
records.text: Cushions delivered just in a thin plastic bag which had become ripped in the delivery process and left outside on a wet day!Contacted customer service who promised to get back to me and never did!Given 2 stars for the product/price but customer service, packaging and delivery terrible, I won't use this company again, cheaper prices=cheap service

records.title: The fabric is as I expected but the…
records.text: The fabric is as I expected but the quality in the construction of the curtains are poor. They don’t hang straight.

records.title: We ordered Orla Kiely Multi Stem…
records.text: We ordered Orla Kiely Multi Stem Blackout Made to Measure Roller Blind from this company, when the blind arrived and assembled you could see white at the top of the blind which ruins the look of the blind. On their website it's almost impossible to see a white background in any of the images. Although the company offered 50% refund. After repeat emails and phone calls, they were not prepared to see from our perspective. They constantly repeat that in their T&C's it states refunds at 50% and we should have ordered a sample first...my point firstly we didn't have time to order a sample, and on their website in the description of the product it does not state the blind is white on the back, and once assembled you will see white at the top. If this was the case, we won’t have ordered the blind. Unfortunately, they are not prepared to listen to any feedback

records.title: Poorly made curtains
records.text: Poorly made curtains. Spent ages trying to work out why the pattern appeared longer on one side than the other. Eventually found that the contrasting printed heading is deeper on one side than the other. This has made it a nightmare trying to take them up and the I’ve now realised the headings will not align. Two pairs of curtains like this and I’ve since read others have also had this  problem. Better quality control and machinists needed.

records.title: Roman Blind
records.text: We gave the recess size of our window for our Roman blind, assuming that the blind would be made with a reduction of 0.5-1cm off each side allowing for ease of movement of the blind, as Terry's website stipulates. Unfortunately it was made without this reduction allowance and subsequently fits too snug for the window. We are now having great difficulty getting the issue sorted, which is such a shame as it is otherwise a lovely blind.

records.title: Bought a pair of curtains?
records.text: Bought a pair of curtains. Gave 2 stars as the buying process was very efficient and arrived on time. Unfortunately the curtains were rubbish. Badly creased, stood nearly an hour carefully trying to iron them. Decided the creases may fall out when hung in a warm room. 3 days later they still look like a dish cloth. Very unhappy. Bought in sale for £44 apparently had been over £100! Terrible value for money. Will be replacing as soon as l can afford to.

description:
Pound Fabrics is the UK's 1st Ever Fabric Pound Store! We realised many fabrics are overpriced in the industry and have made it our mission to make fabrics more affordable for everyone. Many of our fabrics are reduced by as much as 90% off the RRP! We provide a range of wonderful fabrics at unbeatable prices, so you can focus on your passion of sewing. 

We are the Number 1 discount fabric brand for dressmakers and are hugely grateful to serve customers all over the UK. We appreciate the 15000+ wonderful customers who have been so kind to review us on Trustpilot and are proud to hold our 5 Star rating.

Pound Fabrics is dedicated to offering an increasing selection of fabrics from only £1 per metre! We will always offer you the very best prices across our range of fabrics, so you can order with confidence. Remember to sign up to our emails and follow us on social media to be the first to hear of our special offers and promotions.

records.title: The order was delivered quickly with…
records.text: The order was delivered quickly with updates on processing and dispatch.  The fabric exceeded my expectations for the price and my husband really likes the hat I made for him with it. I will definitely order again when I need more.

records.title: Ever hopeful. Every item I purchase is exactly as…
records.text: Every item I purchase is exactly as described and well packaged and delivered on time. I see, and covet may of your fabrics ,but aged 90 I do not sew as much as I once did !

records.title: Very good!!
records.text: Fabric arrived in very good time, and they're both beautiful! The fleece is soft but holds its shape, and the Christmas fabric is just so beautiful, the design on it doesn't change the texture too much either.

records.title: In my opinion
records.text: I have ordered fabric from other places and l can honestly say that Pound Fabrics is the best.lt is great to see what people have made with the fabric you are interested in.I won't be going anywhere else from now on.Kind regards Darlene

records.title: Useful website filter when looking for…
records.text: Useful website filter when looking for fabrics. Good choice, swift delivery and good that a limited number of swatches is free.

records.title: Good prices, fast delivery times.
records.text: Every time I have purchased fabric from Pound Fabrics the company could not be faulted in terms of my expectations of the fabrics bought, and the speed of delivery. Their prices are very good.

records.title: Good shopping experience
records.text: Good shopping experience. The navy cuffingI bought is good quality and made up well. Overall very happy.

records.title: Great customer service, great value for money
records.text: Great customer service, very fast responses when the courier lost my parcel and replacement arranged and sent in time for Christmas projects still. Could not have asked for more. Fabric nice and vibrant colours, for the price it is great quality. Would recommend and would shop here again. Thank you!

records.title: Good quality
records.text: Lovely fast service and good quality cotton used for backing duvet covers and pillowcases. Washed and ironed really well. 6 meters made two duvets and 12 pillowcase backings. No shrinkage occurred

records.title: Fabulous fabrics at really good prices
records.text: Fabulous fabrics at really good prices. Processing and shipping times really good. Very happy with my recent purchases from Pound Fabrics.

records.title: Great service.
records.text: I ordered a couple of fabrics and very quickly was notified that my order was being processed and dispatched.  Unfortunately the courier let me down but PF came to the rescue and my parcel was delivered. I'm looking forward to locking myself away over the Christmas period and deciding what to make . Thank you PF for all your help.

records.title: Good selection of quality fabrics
records.text: Good selection of fabrics and although cheap to buy the fabrics are not cheap, good quality stuff. My only bugbear is that you have to buy by the metre, so i find i end up with lots of 1/2 metre leftovers.

records.title: The quality of the fabric is great for…
records.text: The quality of the fabric is great for the price. A lovely range of prints and materials. The postage did take a little big longer than expected so don’t be in a furry when ordering!

records.title: Giving is always rewarded.
records.text: I make a lot of things for charity so it was great to find material that was in my price range. Everything has become very expensive. I wish them every success in their business aimed at helping people like me help others with greater needs.

records.title: Bought discounted fabrics
records.text: They were cheap so ie was happy with my my purchase but there was an odd wet slightly sticky substance on one of the fabrics . I didn’t complain as I only use them for scraps and rug wreaths Overall the cheapest I found for the quantity I bought

records.title: Definitely will use again!
records.text: Over several years I have placed many orders and very rarely have any issues with their products.Recently I did have an issue with the colours and quality of a piece of union jack fabric, which I queried with them via email as soon as I opened the package.I received a response on the same day and received a replacement piece of fabric within two days that was to the standards I had originally expected. I consider this fantastic customer service.

records.title: Would use this company again.
records.text: Great fabric, good price, a little slow to arrive, but arrived well packaged in good condition.

records.title: Good quality
records.text: Quick delivery, lovely red and green fabric the riendear fabric is OK as I made cushions but pictures on fabric do not run in a straight line, probably why it was so cheap.

records.title: Good for backing a quilt.
records.text: The fabric arrived in good time and was true to the picture on the website. I used it to back a quilt.

records.title: Customer service second to none.
records.text: Bought 4 mtrs of plaid fabric to make a dressing gown.  Stupidly didn’t check it before pinning and cutting pattern. Very large fault right in the centre back!  Contacted pound fabrics who immediately sent me out a replacement 2mtrs!  Amazing service, will certainly buy from them again.

records.title: Delivered on time
records.text: Delivered on time, packaged securely, unfortunately the delivery persons delivered next door as could not get reply.  They delivered it to next door and put it in their garage without letting addressee know. but did not leave note for addressee. This happened to me previously and had it delivered by a stranger at 9pm at night after they spent considerable time  looking for me.  ~Check your delivery people

records.title: soft cotton canvas
records.text: I used the soft cotton canvas in terracotta to make a pair of Cargo Trousers for my almost 11 year old granddaughter. The colour is true to photos on website. I pre-washed with no shrinkage or colour loss. The fabric cuts well, with some fraying which was expected. It sews up beautifully,  although it does appear to wrinkle a little when garment is made. I would buy again,  great value.

records.title: Fab Fleece Fabric
records.text: I wanted some contrasting fabrics to try a new pattern out and the selection of fabric was great, the delivery was very quick and the quality of the fabric lovely.

records.title: Overall happy with my purchase
records.text: Good value for money fabrics and a big range. I am happy with my order, the fabrics arrived nicely cut & tidy. I only wish the processing time was a little faster.

records.title: Good delivery
records.text: Good delivery.  Fabric (brushed cotton) was thinner than I expected, but easy to handle and sew.  Not sure it will wear well, but time will tell.  Fleece also much lighter weight than I thought, maybe I just need to read the descriptions more thoroughly.

records.title: Already a firm favourite! Will return frequently.
records.text: Clear information and photos on the website. A large selection of fabrics available at various prices, some extremely affordable. Reasonable selection of haberdashery, again at very good prices. Altogether a welcome change to other websites with unreasonable costs.  Easy payment, reasonable postage costs. Postal packaging secure and eco friendly.Website easy and quick to use. Altogether very good.I haven’t tried the samples option yet but the descriptions are very accurate and the fabrics I have bought are very good quality.

records.title: Great Products, sketchy choice of Delivery Agent
records.text: The products I received are great, the calico bolt was a fabulous deal that I couldn't miss.  The canvas I ordered is a lovely quality so I'm pleased with my haul. This is my first time ordering from Pound Fabrics and I'm put off slightly by the carrier being Evri.  The lead time given for the order influenced my choice of delivery address, so when the package turned up much faster than estimated, I wasn't home.  Evri dumped the parcel in my front garden with a 10 minutes notice of delivery.  Thankfully my lovely neighbour was home and ran out and grabbed the goods before someone else did.  I will order again but I'll need to be mindful of the delivery address.

records.title: The service is second to none
records.text: The service is second to none, the fabric bundles you get have more shiffon than any thing else which I found disappointing. I ordered the cotton bundle.and got so much taffeta and one piece of cotton material. The pictures of the bundles are a bit deceiving and i feel a little cheated out of my 50 pounds because i thought i was getting something like the pictures i cannot quilt with this so i uave had to put away till i find a use for it. On the other hand the materials you buy separate are of good quality. And there is a variety of choice. I love the site. But the bundles.need to be better.

records.title: Fast delivery
records.text: Fast delivery, fabric as was described. Prices are amazing! Will definitely use pound fabrics again.

records.title: As always quick delivery
records.text: As always quick delivery. Material, as described   good quality. Pound fabrics my choice for all my sewing needs.

records.title: Good quality fabric but the colour was…
records.text: Good quality fabric but the colour was very different to the photographs.

records.title: A short cut
records.text: First of all, my wife loved the fabrics.  Unfortunately, though 2 were measured correctly, the third which was a fleece, was not.  If the exact measurement had been required then it would have been a problem.  However, your company took about a week to respond and then with a miserly 30p refund.  Quite frankly, this was abysmal.  Hopefully, in the future you can update your response times as well as the Customer Service refunds.

records.title: The poly cotton material was far too…
records.text: The poly cotton material was far too stiff to use for clothe making. I’m disappointed. I tried washing it to soften it but that didn’t make any difference. I’d researched that poly cotton was the fabric to use too.

records.title: The service was very good
records.text: The service was very good, fabric arrived promptly. All communication great.The quality of the fabric I purchased wasn't very good. (5metre pack)The dye was inconsistent and there were faded lines as though the edge of the fold was exposed to light.Didn't realise until the fabric was washed dried and partially cut out for my garment. Luckily I had bought the 5m length so had spare to re-cut pattern pieces. My take is you get what you pay for.

records.title: Very different colour from that shown.
records.text: I ordered 2 metres of the purple/gold brocade, but it is a very definite pink/gold brocade.  I really like the pink, but it doesn't match my purple project, so I don't want to return it.  Please be aware when ordering this fabric. Otherwise, excellent quality and value for money!

records.title: my views
records.text: Excellent prompt delivery service. The fabric however was not very good quality. I bought it on Previous Reviews online but alas it was not as expect. Have used the company before and usually happy with the fabric.

records.title: The material fantastic, delivery bad
records.text: The material fantastic. I am very pleased with cost and quality but I have an issue with Evri/ Hermes, five out of six parcels gone to wrong address and I'm housebound so getting the parcels has proved very difficult. I now am hesitant to order with any company that uses them, I have complained to them, no reply ever, I would love to re-order but very afraid too

records.title: When ordering online I entered 1.5…
records.text: When ordering online I entered 1.5 metres into the amount, but when I received my cloth there was only 1 metre of each, which is insufficient for the projects I had in mind. I wish someone from the company had contacted me to tell me that half metres cannot be cut, as I would have been able to change my order.

records.title: Disappointed this time
records.text: I ordered 2 MTRS of blue anchor polycotton to make a shirt.Did prewash as usual but also got blue hands from handling it sewing it up.Took me 4 hrs to sew it up and yes really pleased with it untill it was washed after wearing, It faded and the fabric surface lifted to look like a brushed cotton . Awful only fit for the bin!!!I have been buying fabric from pound fabrics for a few years and every time really pleased with both the fabrics, the colours on their photos and the quality of fabrics.Not this time wasted 4 hrs making it up.Disappointed

records.title: It took a while for my parcel to…
records.text: It took a while for my parcel to arrive. When I did receive notification from Evri, I redirected to a local Tesco but my request was ignored. Not the fault of Pound Fabrics as such but I would have preferred them to have provided me with options for delivery when I ordered. Shipping charge was very expensive. Product was very well wrapped.

records.title: I would have liked the opportunity to purchase a sample.
records.text: I would have liked the opportunity to order a sample as the onscreen colour is different to the fabric received. I ordered Denim Blue, but it looks more like a light Teal to me, I don't dislike the colour, but it wasn't what I would call a Denim Blue.

records.title: The delivery and service were very…
records.text: The delivery and service were very good. The fabric was suspiciously cheap and although it looked fine on the surface the synthetic, glittery fibres shed everywhere as soon as I tried to sew with it. It was impossible to work with, In the end I felt very guilty about sending it to landfill.

records.title: First order - mixed feelings!
records.text: This was my first order with Poundfabrics … I ordered some lining for a skirt & that was as expected. The linen/cotton fabric I ordered however was not! On all devices I viewed the website on, the fabric was a lovely pale pink - when it arrived: coral! And not pale at all. Definitely not a cookout I wanted :( … Poundfabrics sent me a returns email through Evri - once I’d forwarded the details onto them they immediately actioned the refund :)… so I was very impressed with that - no quibble! Still would’ve liked the fabric as pictured, but hey ho it was not to be :(

records.title: Good fabric, bad courier
records.text: The fabric was great quality, especially for the price, however the colour was quite different from the picture so it's a bit risky not being able to order a sample first. That's not a big deal, my main issue is with this courier used. Evri is absolutely awful and I don't know anyone who would recommend them. They were so slow delivering my parcel that it arrived 2 days late and I had to buy fabric elsewhere as I was working under a time limit.I would recommend Pound Fabrics if you're not too picky about the colour of the fabric you need, and if you're willing to wait a while to receive it.

records.title: I was disappointed with the quality of…
records.text: I was disappointed with the quality of my purchase , I do not think you should say the fabric is good quality when it’s obviously a cheap fabric at a cheap price. Really not worth my time and effort to make a dress that looks like it came from a cheap shop on the beach in a holiday resort.

records.title: Mixed review
records.text: Loved the Navy with white polka dot material but disappointed in the yellow daisy printed poly cotton.  Much thinner than I expected and the print looks washed out.

records.title: 10 metres fusible stiffner
records.text: I ordered 10 metres of fusible interlining/fabric stiffner.  It arrived promptly.Sadly it didn't fuse to my polycotton fabric as well as I had hoped.

records.title: Thin cotton
records.text: The linen pattern was printed on cotton which was very thin.  I should have bought actual linen for my table cloth.  This is the problem with buying online.

records.title: The service was great but the fabric…
records.text: The service was great but the fabric wasn’t what I wanted I wanted cotton water resistance it was like a plastic bag type

records.title: I wanted to purchase more of the…
records.text: I wanted to purchase more of the material only to find it is unavailable which has put me in a muddle as I need more and it will be very difficult to get the same red shade.

records.title: Waited 4 days for sample
records.text: Ordered a sample it took 4 days to arrive instead of 1 , sample great but I was on a tight timeline,  so had to order local

records.title: I bought variety of fabrics from this…
records.text: I bought variety of fabrics from this supplier but none of the fabrics were suitable for making fashion clothes. They are either too thin or too stiff. You will have to pay more for more quality fabrics. The cheap ones are more suitable for homeware items, craft or costumes but not fashion in my experience.

records.title: Being unable yo touch the fabrics I was…
records.text: Being unable yo touch the fabrics I was disappointed with one of the fabrics. The brocade fabric was not the colour why I thought so I have needed to rethink buying on line

records.title: Disappointing transaction.
records.text: Ordering was easy 12mtr of fabric.  Delivery fast. packaging excellent.I am disappointed as I had purposely, measured the lengths I needed. And there was not 12 mtrs.i emailed and basically was told when cutting small lengths it will always be shorter,Really you state a price per metre I expect 12mtrs not 23 inches short.for this reason I would not recommend or buy from this company again.

records.title: After more than two weeks I am still…
records.text: After more than two weeks I am still waiting for the fabric to arrive. Even though the shop knew the courier lost the parcel they did not conract me I contacted them twice before they replied. Not great!

records.title: This is not about "Pound Fabrics " they…
records.text: This is not about "Pound Fabrics " they are amazing... I already did my 5* review.This one is about the delivery company "Elvi"... every time I have something by them they always just throw the parcels in our main entrance where we have people coming and going 24/7.. When all they have to do is ring the bell for whoever it is for...we all agreed we would come and collect it but no they still just chuck them on the floor.. also as our front door is often open a lot of parcels go missing... I usually don't buy from companies that use them but your fabric keeps tempting me ....

records.title: The second lot of velvet is faulty and…
records.text: The second lot of velvet is faulty and totally unusable.   Why was it sent without checking?

records.title: DISAPPOINTED
records.text: The fabric itself is fine but in my opinion, fabric should always be sent on a roll. Once folded it’s impossible to get the creases out so for this reason I will not use this company again. I have ordered a lot of fabric in my lifetime and it is the first time I have ever experienced this problem.

records.title: The grey material is very see through
records.text: Date of experience: 30 January 2023

records.title: Will use this company again - but please sort out the couriers.
records.text: I love the fabric, but the delivery did not to well - I was contacted by the courier company and told that my postcode was invalid.  I then had to wait a couple of days before it could be delivered to the same postcode.

description: We produce guitar tools and guitar parts in the UK and have been established for over 10 years. Parts are optimised for tone quality and playability. Tools are proven tested designs. Our products are based on many years of playing, fixing, and setting up guitars. All items go through a complete quality control check following manufacture.

records.title: Nice hand made tools
records.text: Nice hand made tools. Good price and excellent delivery. Included instructions, cleaning rubbers and protective guards. Very impressed. As were other guitarists I showed them to. I particularly liked the fact that they were diamond files that leave a smooth finish.

records.title: Greatly improved sound of an old nylon…
records.text: Greatly improved sound of an old nylon string thanks to a perfectly made bridge. Precise fit and finish.Box package filled with tools and instructions. Perfect!

records.title: Expert Knowledge and Honest Dealings
records.text: I first came across Chris Alsop's advertisement about two weeks before ordering some of his hand made fret rounding tools.  I was struck by his thorough approach and depth of knowledge regarding fret levelling and crowning.  As an occasional guitar maker I wanted some equipment and with all the free advice I had no hesitation in ordering. Finally Chris gave me a refund because his prices were reduced around the time of my order hence the ref. to Honest in the title.  Many thanks to you Chris

records.title: What a great business
records.text: What a great business. Good hand made product, arrived promptly, well packed, really thoughtful usage advice guide included.Thanks!

records.title: Take the worry out of fret crowning...
records.text: Great product. Chris's fret crowning tool is the best I've ever used. Easy to hold with a very well designed ergonomic grip, and a good diamond cutting surface. He even supplies instructions and a tool to clean it after use. It's under half the price of the leading Japanese one too.Okay, I can get results as good as those (if not better) by using my old trusty triangular file, but then I have many years' experience. For those who are inexperienced or without too much mechanical aptitude, this tool, if used in accordance with the instructions, will give excellent results without worry.I highly recommend it. Thanks Chris!

records.title: Always top service
records.text: Always top service. Great resource and fast shipping for busy luthiers

records.title: Precision made bone saddle at a very reasonable price.
records.text: Chris has made a modified copy in bone of the 'over piezo' plastic saddle for my Epiphone electro acoustic which has resulted in a huge improvement to the sound and making the action just a tad lower, so that much easier on the fingers.It is now an actual pleasure to play.Included in the package were clearly written instructions as well as a DVD on fitting the saddle,along with sandpaper,Scotchbrite and wire wool to fine tune the length,thus ensuring a snug,polished fit in the bridge.The piezo is working fine with the saddle's necessary modification and it is a beautifully finished upgrade  for a nearly thirty year old guitar .Many thanks Chris.Happy to recommend a true craftsman.

records.title: Excellent custom saddle
records.text: I needed a new saddle for an Eastman guitar, having removed the under-saddle piezo, but couldn't find anything close to the correct size. Chris Alsop has made me a superb new bone saddle to my exact dimensions, all done and delivered to me within a few days of my order. Highly recommended.

records.title: Quality tools
records.text: Well packed, quick delivery, good clear instructions,  quality tools that work great. Have bought before and was well satisfied.

records.title: Fantastic tools, brilliant service!
records.text: Really happy with the service I received - fantastic products and great attention to detail.- Meticulously packaged- Individually packed in biodegradable bags, nice eco-friendly touch- Instructions with every tool- The tools come pre-lubricated with lemon oil so that any residue that ends up on the guitar won't harm or stain it- Beautifully crafted oak and beech handled tools that look amazing on the shelf in my workshop- They responded over a weekend to answer a list of questions I had, giving me advice and the confidence to buy the tools I needed.
