records.title: Made several orders from here most…
records.text: Made several orders from here most orders went through fine except one ordered through reverb, that never arrived till I messaged them. Who’s fault ?? Don’t know. Not used anything yet but they all seem to be of a good quality. Not the cheapest but Chinese alternatives no thanks.

records.title: Crowning tool set
records.text: The crowning tool set I ordered arrived quickly and with a comprehensive set of instructions, and everything required for the job. In use the tool seemed to leave a lot of scratches along the edges of the frets, though this is probably due to my technique being the first time I used this particular tool. My one real criticism would be the handle of the file, it’s very large and unrefined, and could do with a redesign at the least. The general fit and finish of the tools while solid, is not particularly polished. They’re not pretty, but will do the job with a little practice.

records.title: Fret Dressing file
records.text: I needed to dress the ends of the frets on the fingerboard of my Telecaster; due to contraction of the neck the fret ends protruded slightly which was uncomfortable, The tool provided by Chris Alsop is perfect for the job and comes with accessories to protect the fingerboard and polish up the job. Recommended.

records.title: The fret crown file is nicely made and works well
records.text: The fret crown file is nicely made and works well.  There was a little delay in delivery I guess because these files are made to order.  I felt the metal file holder had one sharp edge which I filed to round it off, but that is just me being picky.  All in all I am very satisfied with my purchase and will certainly by more tools from Chris Alsop.

The new saddle came with the dimensions exactly as specified and of high quality of craftsmanship and required only very few adjustments to fit it into the bridge slot. Great amount of supplementary materials (sand paper, polishing materials etc.) and documentation (instructions, tutorials) was very helpful. Parcel delivered (outside UK) within the specified time. I am happy with the purchase and do recommend Chris Alsop Guitar to all interested!

records.title: Very dissapointed
records.text: Very dissapointed with my recent contact with Chris. I approached CAG to order new nut and did seek some advise before submitting the order. First I was told they were making standard nuts (and no advise received), then I got more inforation to help me in placing the order but after a while I got a message that they were not able to make the nut I needed (even the dimensions were within the limits given on the webpage) and that they had no more time to spend on this query with me as they were very busy.. I was refused to place my order.I am very supprised and dissapointed  with such approach against client especially that this was to be my second order at CAG. Last year I ordered bone saddle for my electro-accoustic and was very happy with the results (my possitive feedback and review can be found here). Very shame as they are making good products but how you approach others is (or should be) at least as important as the quality of your craftsmanship! Well, apparently it was not in my case. Hope it will be in yours...

description: James' Home of Tone is a proudly independent UK based online guitar store specialising in the best quality, unique & boutique guitar gear as well as quality electric guitars for beginners. You'll find parts, accessories, pedals and instruments, all from someone who is passionate about guitars and quality customer service. It's run by James, and has been helping fellow guitar players find their best 'tone' since 2015!

records.title: Absolutely FIRST CLASS service snd…
records.text: Absolutely FIRST CLASS service and product.  My shipment got stuck for over a month due to the Canada Post strike and James even offered to figure put a way to issue a refund so that I could get another product faster!  This was not needed but the suggested customer care is huge!  James is truly a standout dude!  The custom harness I ordered is a thing of beauty and should be made visible behind a clear plate!  Sonically my 3 HD Z90’s never sounded this good.  Highly recommend James’ Home of Tone.  This was well worth the wait and will be my go-to for my next guitar build.

records.title: Give them a go!
records.text: Had a few orders now as a one off experience is never truly an indication of how a company can act, but every single order has been spot on and the Esquire harness I ordered has transformed the guitar it's now in! Cannot recommend enough and I'll certainly be using them in the future for my guitar needs!

records.title: Fantastic wiring loom and great aervice
records.text: Apart from just simply making a fantastic wiring loom for my Telecaster project, James was extremely helpful in shaping what I bought from him. He helped me to understand a few technical aspects so that I knew what I would be purchasing by patiently and clearly explaining the options. The loom itself is very solid and precisely built. Very impressive.

records.title: Amazing experience
records.text: Amazing experience. I bought a switch and various other parts for my first ever guitar mod. As a complete beginner with guitar electronics, I attempted to instal this switch with no luck. I sent James an email asking if there was any way he could point me in the direction of any resources that might help me online. He replied very promptly with an extremely detailed and beginner friendly explanation of exactly I needed to do, even attaching a digram he had made just for me. On top of the step by step instructions, he helped me understand exactly what each step was doing and why. As someone very new to this, it meant the world to me that he took the time to do this. I will be back for more shortly! Thank you, James.

I was a first time customer, and just stumbled across JHoT online. The full Jazzmaster harness I purchased was delivered faster than I expected, was very well packed, and is of ridiculously high quality, a work of art. I'm so happy with it. I have bought Fender Custom Shop loaded pickguards in the past, but that won't be happening again...

records.title: This is the gold standard for guitar shops
records.text: I've used James' Home of Tone on numerous occasions over the years, from smaller parts & components to pickup sets. I can't say enough good things about this shop, James puts both his passion and knowledge in music and guitars, and his warm and considerate personality into everything he does with the shop, and that's what makes it so good. James has also performed setup work on two of my guitars, unbeatable service and skill for the cost.

records.title: Bought PRS SE guitar on line

records.title: I've bought a Korg Pa600 Professional…

records.title: SX 700 keyboard
records.text: The purchase and delivery all went smoothly. records.title: Have recorded my first disc and discovered I'm not Willie Nelson!

You are getting a lot of technology for your money. I've still a way to go in discovering all that this thing has to offer,but I am more than happy and having a lot of fun with my button pressing.James

records.title: A store who looks after its customers

description: Merchant City Music is one of the UK's leading independent guitar stores. We've been in business since 1992, providing our customers with top class instruments and unbeatable customer service. We take an enormous amount of pride over every instrument we sell. Each guitar goes through a rigorous check and set-up procedure before dispatch so that it reaches you in perfect condition and ready to play. Having moved to larger premises in 2012, our shop in Glasgow city centre is packed full of all the latest guitars, amps and effects from brands such as Fender, Reverend, Marshall, Orange, BOSS, Ibanez, Guild, Yamaha, Line 6, Larrivee, Breedlove, Sigma, Charvel, EVH and hundreds more!

records.title: Bought Jet JT300 online.

records.title: Excellent Customer Service, Terrible Web Security
records.text: I bought a string winder and some strings from this company. The products arrived on time and in excellent condition, with lots of warning as to when I needed to be home. However, after completing my sign up after ordering and checking my e-mails, I noticed that a notification sent from their system contained my password in plain text.This means that not only could my password have been stolen when the email was in transit, allowing a hacker to gain confidential information, but this also indicates that the password may be stored on the database in this manner, which would allow hackers to gain access to all the passwords in the event of the breach.I made a complaint about this that hasn't been responded to.

records.title: Some areas need improvement

records.text: This is the second instrument I’ve had from Merchant City which had a less than “pro” setup, but the first one I decided to return. I’m starting to question that setup claim. Or maybe Reverend doesn’t follow this industry-wide practice, who knows. This instrument had issues with the truss rod, as I understand it, and my previous purchase had a wobbly bridge pickup and a dodgy pickup selector switch. Neither were particularly cheap instruments.

records.title: Great product,speedy service 👍🏻
records.text: Date of experience: 12 April 2020

records.title: All good
records.text: All good, no issues

records.title: It's all about patience-This was a one off experience.
records.text: First things first...I finally received my order.But it was along way/ wait until then.Got a confirmation for my order and after that....silence. It took at least 3 weeks to receive my order from England. For comparison it took Apollo 11, 8 days to get to the moon and back. So taking 3 weeks for sending a parcel from England to Germany is definitely not a feat. Thanx to the Brexit.

records.title: 3 way patchbox
records.text: I purchased the three-way patchbox for organizing cables out of my pedalboard to my amp. This model has 3 jacks: Amp Send, Amp Return and Amp Out (or amp in depending how you look at it. Its the cable that goes from your pedalboard to the input of your amp).I was dissapointed that when using a non-fx loop amp, I am not able to use the patchbox “amp return” jack to go to the amp input without connectic a patchcable that connects the “amp out” jack to the “amp send” jack. It’s the only way to have all pedals in chain in the event that the venue has a non-fxloop amp, for example. This wasn't mentioned in the info available on the website.Most patchboxes I have seen in this price range do not require this extra patchcable for this scenario, and they can do that “bridge” internally.Other than that, everything works great. You have a lot of options for customization and maling the product “yours”.

description:
Welcome to Morris Works, where quilting is more than just a craft—it's our passion! Nestled in the heart of Hove, East Sussex, our family-run quilt shop is dedicated to supporting and inspiring quilters of all levels. Whether you're a seasoned quilter or just starting your first project, we’re here to help you every step of the way.

At Morris Works, we pride ourselves on offering an extensive selection of high-quality patchwork and quilting tools, top-notch quilt waddings, and a diverse range of beautiful quilting fabrics. We believe in fair pricing, ensuring you get the best value for your money without compromising on quality.

Our friendly and knowledgeable team is always on hand to offer advice and recommendations tailored to your unique quilting needs. Whether you need help choosing the perfect fabric combination, selecting the right tools, or just some general quilting tips, we're here to make your quilting journey enjoyable and successful.

We understand that every quilt is special, and we’re committed to providing quick and reliable shipping so you can get started on your project without delay. You can shop with us online or visit our charming store in Hove. Join our quilting community today and let Morris Works be your trusted partner in creating beautiful, handcrafted quilts. We can't wait to see what you'll create!

description:
How we started,
Steve James being a gigging musician since the early 80s with the Rock n Roll band The Dogs D'amour, wanted to create the type of environment he would like to purchase instruments from, with a chilled approach to selling, no hard sell, just simply provide the best service and the best products, and give customers time to make the right choice, Steven James Guitars opened up in 2006 with 
We believe in providing the best possible customer experience when visiting our physical store or online. We make it our mission to provide as much information about our wide range of products which all of our staff are extremely knowledgeable about, ensuring you can make a purchase based on unbiased and trustworthy information.
We're an independent company which checks EVERY guitar before it is sent out for delivery. This is to ensure there's no marks or dinks and to make sure it is tuned properly and set-up
We specialize in Guitars and Amps to ensure we know exactly what we're selling to suit any of your musical preferences.
We offer great prices and excellent customer service, we'll match any UK price to provide the best possible price to you, the customer!
If you want to try out any of our products you are more than welcome to do so within the store, our experienced staff can demonstrate all of our instruments so you know exactly what you're getting.
Come and see us:
Our showrooms are open daily from 10 am - 6 pm Monday to Saturday, and every Sunday from 11 am - 4 pm. Come and browse our impressive selection of guitars, amps, effects, and accessories in a chilled out no pressure environment. You can try anything you want, just ask!

records.title: A little disappointing...
records.text: After exchanging several email enquiries and a phone call, I finally decided to purchase a Martin GPC-13E. I asked for a low-action set up and Elixir strings (just don’t like the Martin brand of strings). Guitar was dispatched with next-day delivery expected with DHL. My tracking App said they had collected the parcel but when I checked the next morning (looking for a delivery time slot), tracking said delivery was delayed for delivery on next working day. No reasons were given. Hugely disappointing. Guitar arrived the following day. Lucky it did as this was a Friday and had it not arrived, the next working day would shift to the following Monday. This is somewhat at odds with the delivery policy on the vendors website. I’ve had issues of this kind with DHL in the past. Best courier by a mile is DPD. Guitar was well packaged with outer box, some bubble-wrap and a padded soft shell case (branded). No obvious damage and when opened, all was ok. Guitar is a lovely instrument-but so it should be. It’s a Martin and not cheap (over £1300). Setup was completed although perhaps the action could have been a tad lower. All ok. The Martin branded soft shell case is in my opinion, average at best. Yes it’s padded a little better than a cheaper gigbag  but I was expecting better for the price. My disappointment centres around the “package”. For this money, I was hoping for some included accessories eg. Cleaning products, strap, etc. I know none of this is included in the website description - but neither was the gigbag. Back in January’21, I bought a Gibson G series acoustic from PMT. That came with a quality hard-shell branded case and included accessory pack (standard according to Gibson’s official site) and all at a cost £450 less than this Martin. Perhaps I was naive in thinking Martin would offer similar or a vendor would add accessories to make the product more attractive. I am not looking for “freebies” but the comparison was stark with such a cost differential. I sent an email to Steven James Guitars to check nothing had been left out, but as yet, there’s been no response. I considered strongly how to rate my experience. Whilst staff were very nice and responded promptly to my enquiries pre-purchase, nothing since.  Hence, with the delivery issues added in, I went for 3 stars. I do not plan to return the product (unless a fault develops). So I’ll just leave it there. It’s always going to be difficult to purchase a guitar online without playing it first, but this is where customer service becomes paramount. I have no comments on recommendation.

records.title: Still waiting for guitar parts ordered 5 weeks ago.
records.text: My partner ordered a Prs tremonti custom July 13th 2017. Unfortunately the store did not include the trem arm and Allen key pack for adjusting the action.  After an apology from the store and a promise they would post the parts we are still waiting to receive them. 5 weeks is extremely poor service for an item costing over £600.

records.title: Disappointed.
records.text: I ordered a brand new Fender Cabronita Telecaster (Blonde Ash) and when it arrived it was clearly not 'brand new' and factory fresh. It looked like it had been played a lot; it was covered in light scratches and had a couple of dark marks in the finish? But, worst of all it had two bad dings. One of the dings on the edge of the guitar had some sort of yellow filler in it? I phoned the shop and the guys at the shop organised a return straight away and emailed me the label to print-off. The guitar got picked-up a couple of days later and was returned to the shop without a hitch, at no extra cost to me. Once it had arrived, they phoned me the next day and I got a full refund without any hassle. They sent me two sets of strings to make up for it but it cost me two wasted days. What was annoying, is that this guitar was supposed to be inspected, restrung and have a full "expert set-up" before leaving the shop. Either, it didn't have one or the guitar technician was having a really, really bad day? I'm no expert, but I've been playing guitar for 40+ years and I could tell that the guitar was not right. The guys at Steven James Guitar & Amp were very friendly and helpful and very quick to put things right, but the fact remains, this guitar should've never been sent out in the first place. I hope it's a one-off.

records.title: Used Lefthand ESP Viper 100FM
records.text: I purchased this guitar after seeing it online described as in excellent condition. The member of staff who aided me was very helpful, and the item was well packed when it arrived. Upon receiving the instrument I was quite disappointed. I like the guitar, but the condition is anything but excellent. I would have described it as good at best. It had several scratches & dings in the body, including two dents at the bottom of it where it appears it was bashed against an amp. Anyway, I have spent the last few weeks correcting these flaws. When I removed the strings there are also scratches on the pickups. The Truss rod had to be adjusted, but the neck could have moved in transit. There was some buzzing at the first few frets, so adjusted the Truss Rod to acquire some relief in the neck. Problem fixed. I wanted to give a positive review, but the item condition is not as described. I like the guitar very much, so been working on it to restore it to almost new condition. Have two Dean USA pickups to install too. I've been playing guitar & buying them for almost twenty years, and I think this is the most misleading product I've purchased in that time. A guitar should not be advertised as excellent condition when it is in fact only good. The photograph did not show any of the blemishes. Although some of the customer service was decent, the item is not as described. Buyers beware!

records.title: fast delivery but some quality problems
records.text: Defect pickup several other things need to be changed or adjusted.

records.text: bought guitar never got delivered then told had been lost then then showed up after had replaced fron another company  as this was for christmas present told on 21 dec refund done still waiting and paypal just said be 8th jan good job dont need the money but when resolved would never deal with vender or paypal again thankssorry youve got your dates mixed up was supposed to be delivered mon 16th didnt appear to 22nd  and you told me 21st they had lost item and take it up with  paypal as they blamed you way refund had been done im still out of pocket happy new year

records.title: Not fit for purpose
records.text: Bought guitar pack and the amp was not working. After some back and forth they agreed to replace. I took the replacement guitar to my tutor who said it needed setting up properly so I took it to my LGS to be properly set up but they told me it was incapable of correct intonation. I sought refund but no-joy. Would definitely recommend you look elsewhere.

Packaging was just right, very well protected. Trophies themselves were better than I expected too, we had 17 wooden eco ones, and they were beautifully inscribed. We will be back next year, thanks team Jaycee!

records.title: We ordered trophies for our boxing…
records.text: We ordered trophies for our boxing show. Arrived when they said they would, so this was good. However, the plaques on the trophies did not say what was ordered. I don’t think I will be using them again. Shame, as good in the past, but we need a company we can rely on.

records.title: 4 Trophies, 2 good, 2 poor
records.text: I ordered 4 trophies which was easy to do on the website and were delivered very quickly. 2 of the trophies are good and look pleasing to the eye but sadly two of the trophies are of poor quality and look cheap.The two trophies that were of poor quality and look were the Typhoon Code RF16093B.

records.title: service was good no problems and came …
records.text: service was good no problems and came well packaged, thought the trophies looked a little cheap, the engraved plate looked thin and just never really did the job well,  and should have gone for a smaller ones or another type, these were the tall gold and the silver/blue... have no idea why there was no just silver option. would i use the company again.. most likely but need to try and keep away from the plastic ones...

records.title: Trophy arrived quite quickly
records.text: Trophy arrived quite quickly, but not as quick as the continuous requests fro reviews (very irritating). It was well packaged and what I ordered actually arrived with no 'typos'.5 stars for quality an service, negative stars for pestering me for a review.

records.title: Responsive to Delivery Issues
records.text: Unfortunately my medals didn't arrive. However Jacycee trophies did everything they could to track them down, responded quickly and politely to my emails, let me know what was going on, and offered a full refund. The delivery issue was outside of Jaycee trophies control, and despite not getting the medals, I would recommend this company as they are responsible and easy to deal with.

records.title: Ordered two trophies with different…
records.text: Ordered two trophies with different message to engrave on plaque. But, both were sent with the same message. Had to call back the customer service team. They are going to send another plaque to stick at the base. This delayed our presentation programme and caused unnecessary hassale. Not impressed.

records.title: Tennis Medals
records.text: The medals themselves were an acceptable quality although the engraving was not fantastic. However it took about 2 weeks for them to arrive & I received no communication as to why they were late. This was only forthcoming when I rang to find out what had happened. To add insult to injury when they were delivered there was no card, no delivery detail - it was just thrown over my back gate. Not a service I can recommend.....

records.title: Top service shame about the delivery …

records.title: No quite what i expected

I then got an email telling me that the particular medal I had ordered did not attach to a ribbon; I replied to cancel the ribbon. The order came in two deliveries, first the ribbon and box and secondly the medal - So I have a ribbon and box that are useless and cost me £5.99 over all - disappointing!

records.title: Quick delivery but quality not 100%

records.text: I bought 2 trophies from you and the trophies are fine but I orded one to say ‘most improved’ and the other ‘best player’ and when they both come they both say best player.

I chased them up towards the end of the afternoon and found their answerphone on and without calling me back which seemed like they had decided to bury their head in the sand rather than help. The engraving was not done on the back of the medal, it seemed to be on a square plaque that was glued or fixed to the back of the medal in some way.  Altogether not a happy experience.

records.text: 2 of the medals we ordered had the wrong words engraved (I have checked and they were entered correctly on website)in addition to this a lot of the medals were scratched.Have ordered from Jaycee Trophies before but will be looking for alternatives for our next awards presentation.

records.title: Not as good as the first time
records.text: Ordered 5 medals & a pen set for a small society golf competition. One of the medals was out of stock, which initially was not a problem as a suitable replacement was offered. When this was also out of stock I was concerned we would not receive everything on time. Then the pen set was out of stock. When the medals finally arrived on the morning of the competition they had been engraved on the back whereas when I previously ordered medals they had impressively been engraved on a plate on the presentation box. Not impressed this time & will probably now shop elsewhere.

records.title: Not happy
records.text: I was quite disapointed with my purchase.Presentation box hard a mark on it and also the plaque had a few scratches which could not be removed.I was quite surprised as well that the plaque was not even centered correctly.Overall not very happy.

records.title: Ordered 2 no Engraved Medals
records.text: Ordered 2 no Engraved Medals. Very disappointed in the condition of the Medals, one was really scratched to the point where it effected being able to read the engraving. Very Poor .

records.title: Useless delivery company - your trophy may not arrive on time!
records.text: The medals were engraved promptly and sent off via DX services.   I have had previous experience of this company who value security above getting the product delivered.   We had to wait in on 3 separate days before the delivery finally arrived (on the one occasion that it was not forecast by email!).   The delivery company uses low-quality self-employed drivers (customer service said  "some have SatNavs - some not!").   I know from previous occasions that they will not deliver without a signature, causing great inconvenience to the receiver.I would strongly urge Jaycee Trophies to move to a more flexible and efficient delivery company.   Engrave trophies are often required at short notice and a delivery company that delivers the product 6 days late is worse than useless.

records.title: Sports Day medals
records.text: The goods were fine but arrived too late for the Sports Day for which they were requested. I will not use Jaycee again.
